"""Literal-only v3-to-v4 provenance migration; source review is not acceptance."""
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import fingerprint
from holdout_provenance import (TOP_FIELDS, full_anchor, read, sealed, semantic_projection,
                                source_binding)


ARCHIVE_V3 = Path("evaluation/knowledge/archive/holdout-v3-before-bound-source-review-20261017")
MIGRATION_V4 = Path("evaluation/knowledge/holdout-provenance-migration-v4.json")
BASE_COMMIT = "82235890470e0cc4464414be6d9223ed33623084"
EXPECTED_REVISIONS = {
    "NATIONAL": "rev-54a85427f0fe78c051faa026",
    "F18": "rev-e41c61067fe70ce4ce221dbf",
    "WINDOW": "rev-49ae68807f33bf53dbbec739",
}
ARCHIVE_NAMES = {"holdout-business-reference-draft.json", "holdout-business-questions-draft.json",
                 "holdout-semantic-screening.json", "holdout-draft-integrity.json"}


def archive_v3(root):
    manifest = read(root/ARCHIVE_V3/"manifest.json")
    if (not sealed(manifest) or manifest.get("source_commit") != BASE_COMMIT
            or {Path(item["path"]).name for item in manifest["files"]} != ARCHIVE_NAMES
            or len(manifest["files"]) != len(ARCHIVE_NAMES)):
        raise ValueError("Expected complete, sealed v3 archive")
    for item in manifest["files"]:
        path = (root/item["path"]).resolve()
        if path.parent != (root/ARCHIVE_V3).resolve() or fingerprint(path.read_bytes()) != item["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Archived v3 bytes differ")
    before = read(root/ARCHIVE_V3/"holdout-business-reference-draft.json")
    if not sealed(before) or before.get("draft_revision") != 3:
        raise ValueError("Expected intact v3 reference")
    return before, manifest


def validate_v4_semantics(before, after):
    changed = {k for k in before.keys() | after.keys() if before.get(k) != after.get(k)}
    if (before.get("draft_revision") != 3 or after.get("draft_revision") != 4
            or not changed <= TOP_FIELDS or semantic_projection(before) != semantic_projection(after)
            or len(before["cases"]) != 30 or len({case["id"] for case in before["cases"]}) != 30
            or after.get("freeze_blockers") != before.get("freeze_blockers")
            or any(after.get(k) is not False for k in ("independent_acceptance_ready", "independence_certified",
                    "human_review_completed", "ready_for_business_publication"))
            or any(after.get(k) is not None for k in ("reference_frozen_at", "snapshot_binding", "observed_run"))):
        raise ValueError("v4 provenance cannot change questions, oracles, blockers or acceptance")


def literal_anchors(db, before_case, after_sources, source_keys=None):
    anchors = []
    for original in before_case["background_source_anchors"]:
        if original != full_anchor(db, original["source_key"], original["revision"], original["locator"]):
            raise ValueError("Expected an intact complete historical source span")
        anchor = deepcopy(original)
        if anchor["source_key"] in (EXPECTED_REVISIONS if source_keys is None else source_keys):
            revision = after_sources[anchor["source_key"]]["revision"]
            matches = [row for row in db.execute("SELECT ordinal,locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=?", (revision,))
                       if row["locator"] == anchor["locator"] and fingerprint(row["text"].encode()) == anchor["parent_text_sha256"]
                       and fingerprint(row["text"][anchor["start"]:anchor["end"]].encode()) == anchor["span_sha256"]]
            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Each v4 anchor requires one unchanged literal parent and span")
            anchor.update(revision=revision, ordinal=matches[0]["ordinal"])
        anchors.append(anchor)
    return anchors


def v4_evidence(store, db, before, after):
    validate_v4_semantics(before, after)
    if (set(before["sources"]) != set(after["sources"])
            or any(before["sources"][key] != after["sources"][key] for key in before["sources"] if key not in EXPECTED_REVISIONS)):
        raise ValueError("Only NATIONAL, F18 and WINDOW provenance may migrate")
    comparisons = {}
    for key, revision in EXPECTED_REVISIONS.items():
        old, new = before["sources"][key], after["sources"][key]
        if (new["revision"] != revision or (old["source_id"], old["url"]) != (new["source_id"], new["url"])
                or old["original_sha256"] != new["original_sha256"]
                or source_binding(store, db, new["source_id"], new["url"], revision) != new
                or new["business_approval"] is not True):
            raise ValueError("Migrated source requires its actual scoped review and original")
        old_row, old_chunks = store._content(db, old["revision"])
        new_row, new_chunks = store._content(db, revision)
        store._verify(db, old_row["id"], require_review=False)
        if key == "NATIONAL":
            if (len(old_chunks) != 11 or len(new_chunks) != 10
                    or [c for c in old_chunks if c["locator"] != "第七十六条"] != new_chunks):
                raise ValueError("Only the unreferenced national window clause may be removed")
            watch, watch_chunks = store._content(db, "rev-84412d6b0b512caf0cbe1a01")
            store._verify(db, watch["id"], require_review=False)
            if (watch["state"] != "pending_review" or watch["sha256"] != old_row["sha256"]
                    or watch_chunks != [c for c in old_chunks if c["locator"] == "第七十六条"]):
                raise ValueError("The unresolved national window clause must remain separately pending")
            comparisons[key] = {"kind": "same_original_ten_complete_clauses", "removed_unreferenced_locator": "第七十六条",
                                "pending_window_watch_revision": watch["id"]}
        else:
            if old_chunks != new_chunks or len(new_chunks) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Fee and service-window literal selections must remain identical")
            comparisons[key] = {"kind": "same_original_same_complete_paragraph", "locator": new_chunks[0]["locator"]}
        comparisons[key].update(before_revision=old["revision"], after_revision=revision,
            original_sha256=new["original_sha256"], before_body_sha256=old_row["body_sha256"], after_body_sha256=new_row["body_sha256"],
            actual_review_digest=new["recorded_review"]["digest"])
    cases = []
    for old, new in zip(before["cases"], after["cases"], strict=True):
        expected = literal_anchors(db, old, after["sources"])
        relevant = [] if old["proposed_outcome_after_qualified_publication"] == "stop" else [{"revision":a["revision"], "locator":a["locator"]} for a in expected]
        if new["background_source_anchors"] != expected or new["proposed_relevant_evidence"] != relevant:
            raise ValueError("v4 cannot insert, remove or alter evidence spans")
        cases.append({"id":old["id"], "before_sha256":fingerprint(old), "after_sha256":fingerprint(new),
                      "changed_fields":sorted(k for k in old.keys() | new.keys() if old.get(k) != new.get(k))})
    return {"before_reference_sha256":before["content_sha256"], "after_reference_sha256":after["content_sha256"],
            "case_semantics_sha256":fingerprint(semantic_projection(after)), "sources":comparisons, "cases":cases,
            "literal_span_changes":0, "evidence_insertions_or_removals":0}


def validate_v4_migration(root, store, db, reference):
    if reference.get("provenance_migration") != {"path":MIGRATION_V4.as_posix()} or not sealed(reference):
        raise ValueError("Expected explicitly bound v4 migration")
    before, manifest = archive_v3(root)
    from holdout_provenance import validate_migration
    historical_baseline = validate_migration(root, store, db, before)
    stale_path = ARCHIVE_V3/"holdout-draft-integrity.json"
    stale = read(root/stale_path)
    ledger = read(root/MIGRATION_V4)
    if (not sealed(ledger) or ledger.get("kind") != "holdout_provenance_migration_not_acceptance"
            or ledger.get("base_archive_manifest_sha256") != manifest["content_sha256"]
            or ledger.get("human_review_completed") is not False or ledger.get("acceptance_authorized") is not False
            or ledger.get("reviewer") != "Codex AI"
            or ledger.get("previous_integrity_report") != {"path":stale_path.as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint((root/stale_path).read_bytes())}
            or stale.get("draft_integrity_passed") is not False
            or sorted(k for k,v in stale["checks"].items() if not v) != sorted(["latest_originals_and_literal_anchor_spans_match", "actual_export_contains_both_drafts_and_preserves_empty_approvals"])
            or ledger.get("evidence") != v4_evidence(store, db, before, reference)):
        raise ValueError("v4 ledger differs from the actual scoped reviews or unchanged semantics")
    return historical_baseline

def archive_v4(root):
    manifest = read(root/ARCHIVE_V4/"manifest.json")
    if (not sealed(manifest) or manifest.get("source_commit") != BASE_COMMIT
            or {Path(item["path"]).name for item in manifest["files"]} != ARCHIVE_NAMES
            or len(manifest["files"]) != len(ARCHIVE_NAMES)):
        raise ValueError("Expected complete, sealed v4 archive")
    for item in manifest["files"]:
        path = (root/item["path"]).resolve()
        if path.parent != (root/ARCHIVE_V4).resolve() or fingerprint(path.read_bytes()) != item["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Archived v4 bytes differ")
    before = read(root/ARCHIVE_V4/"holdout-business-reference-draft.json")
    if not sealed(before) or before.get("draft_revision") != 4:
        raise ValueError("Expected intact v4 reference")
    return before, manifest

"""Fetch two official normative PDFs as unapproved candidates; keep effectivity unresolved."""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import schedule, worker_once


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SPECS = [
    ("NDRC-FEE-2003", "国家发展改革委 财政部关于居民身份证收费标准及有关问题的通知", "2022101017594886.pdf", "发改价格〔2003〕2322号", "2003-12-30"),
    ("NDRC-FEE-2005", "国家发展改革委 财政部 公安部关于规范居民身份证工本费标准等有关问题的通知", "2022101016343695.pdf", "发改价格〔2005〕436号", "2005-03-18"),
]


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update")
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    basis = ("Official administrative normative text; limited private archive and attributed excerpts under Copyright Law Article 5(1). "
             "No website media or design redistribution, no assertion of present effectivity. "
             "https://www.ncac.gov.cn/xxfb/flfg/flfg_532/202103/t20210309_50530.html")
    for source_id, title, filename, number, signed in SPECS:
        path = "/upload/images/202210/"+filename
        config = {"id": source_id, "label": title, "origin": "https://zfxxgk.ndrc.gov.cn", "enabled": True,
            "allowed_paths": [path], "seeds": ["https://zfxxgk.ndrc.gov.cn"+path], "interval_seconds": 86400,
            "delay_seconds": 5, "discover_links": False, "page_kind": "document",
            "metadata": {"title": title, "region": "national", "matter": "demo-id-renewal", "document_type": "administrative_norm",
                "issuer": "国家发展改革委、财政部" + ("、公安部" if source_id.endswith("2005") else ""),
                "document_number": number, "published_at": None, "effective_from": None, "effective_to": None,
                "usage_basis": basis, "business_review": "pending", "collection_role": "fee_candidate",
                "initial_page_observations": {"signed_at_pdf": signed, "storage_directory_date_is_not_effective_date": True},
                "conflict": source_id.endswith("2003"),
                "unresolved_notes": ["Verify present validity, subsequent amendments/exemptions and branch-specific applicability before publication"] +
                    (["A 2017 proposed-repeal list also mentions this document. A proposal is not proof of repeal; resolve against subsequent official decisions and current normative catalog."] if source_id.endswith("2003") else [])},
            "access_review": {"approved": True, "reviewer": "codex_automated_technical_access_screen", "actor_kind": "machine",
                "checked_at": stamp, "usage_basis": basis, "business_review_completed": False,
                "purpose": "private_engineering_candidates_only", "robots_url": "https://zfxxgk.ndrc.gov.cn/robots.txt",
                "screening_note": "Every actual request remains conditional on the Fetcher robots, rate, public-IP and redirect checks"}}
        store.register(config)
    lead = {"id": "HN-NORM-XY-LEAD", "label": "河南省公安机关户口居民身份证管理工作规范（试行）官方转载线索",
        "origin": "https://gaj.xinyang.gov.cn", "enabled": False, "allowed_paths": ["/2025/04-25/600324.html"],
        "seeds": ["https://gaj.xinyang.gov.cn/2025/04-25/600324.html"], "interval_seconds": 86400, "delay_seconds": 5,
        "metadata": {"title": "河南省公安机关户口居民身份证管理工作规范（试行）", "region": "河南省", "matter": "demo-id-renewal",
            "document_type": "administrative_norm", "effective_from": None, "effective_to": None, "usage_basis": None,
            "collection_role": "core_candidate", "business_review": "pending"},
        "access_review": {"approved": False, "reason": "Read-only web tool returned page HTTP 403; no automated body acquisition or bypass attempted"}}
    store.register(lead)
    with store.db() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=? WHERE id=?", ("Official page returned HTTP 403 during read-only discovery; disabled", lead["id"]))
    schedule(store)
    for _ in SPECS:
        worker_once(store, owner="fee-intake")
    with store.db() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE workers SET progress='completed' WHERE id='fee-intake'")
        configs = [json.loads(r[0]) for r in db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites ORDER BY id")]
        rows = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT r.id,r.sha256,r.state,d.site_id,d.url FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id IN ('NDRC-FEE-2003','NDRC-FEE-2005')")]
        jobs = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT site_id,state,attempts,error FROM jobs WHERE site_id IN ('NDRC-FEE-2003','NDRC-FEE-2005')")]
    (store.root / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": configs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    report = {"captured_at": stamp, "revisions": rows, "jobs": jobs, "counts": store.status()["counts"],
        "provincial_lead": {"id": lead["id"], "status": "disabled_after_page_403", "new_body_acquired": False},
        "validity_issue_source": "https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/yjzxDownload/fgsfzwjt20170801t02.pdf",
        "business_review_completed": False, "official_knowledge_published": 0,
        "note": "Historic fee-related administrative documents, not new 2026 rules; current validity/fee conclusions unresolved"}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/fee-intake.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    if len(rows) != 2 or any(job["state"] != "done" for job in jobs):
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            "body_ingested": False, "automatic_monitoring_enabled": False, "business_review_completed": False}
        try:

            report.update(status=status, content_type=headers.get("content-type"), final_url=final)
            expected = ("application/pdf",) if target.get("media_type") == "application/pdf" else ("text/html", "application/xhtml+xml")

            archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            archive.write_bytes(raw)
            report.update(body_acquired=True, bytes=len(raw), raw_sha256=fingerprint(raw))
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            report.update(error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error)[:250])
            with store.db() as db:
                db.execute("UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=? WHERE id=?", (str(error)[:250], target["id"]))

        report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        if not report["body_acquired"]:
            raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Register two narrowly scoped official normative texts and run an audited candidate intake.

Access screening is automated and limited to private engineering storage. It is not a
human business review, a publication approval, or a blanket license for website media.
"""

import json
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, encode
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import schedule, worker_once


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
COPYRIGHT_BASIS = "https://www.ncac.gov.cn/xxfb/flfg/flfg_532/202103/t20210309_50530.html"
BASE = "https://www.beijing.gov.cn"
SPECS = [
    {"id": "MPS-NORM-01", "title": "公安部关于印发《户口居民身份证管理工作规范（试行）》的通知",
     "path": "/zhengce/zhengcefagui/202211/t20221116_2860246.html", "document_type": "administrative_norm",
     "issuer": "公安部", "document_number": "公通字〔2021〕12号",
     "initial_page_observations": {"published_at_field": "2021-07-30", "effective_from_field": "2021-10-01", "signed_at_body": "2021-07-24",
         "date_note": "PubDate meta concatenates two dates; URL date is not an effective date; business review pending"},
     "include_articles": ["第一条", "第二条", "第十条", "第十二条", "第七十六条", "第七十八条", "第七十九条", "第八十条", "第八十一条", "第九十六条", "第九十七条"],
     "article_categories": {"第七十六条": "eligibility", "第七十八条": "identity"}},
    {"id": "MPS-USE-01", "title": "关于规范居民身份证使用管理的公告",
     "path": "/zhengce/zhengcefagui/201905/t20190522_59419.html", "document_type": "official_announcement",
     "issuer": "公安部、中央综治办等八部门", "document_number": None,
     "initial_page_observations": {"published_at_field": "2016-08-11", "effective_from_field": "2016-07-15", "signed_at_body": "2016-07-15",
         "date_note": "Body says effective upon publication but page publication differs from signed/effective field; resolve before business publication"}},
]


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update")
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    basis = ("Official normative/administrative text screened against Copyright Law Article 5(1); "
             "private engineering archive and attributed excerpts only; no website images/layout/news redistribution; "
             "current applicability and business publication remain unapproved. Basis: " + COPYRIGHT_BASIS)
    before = store.status()["counts"]
    for spec in SPECS:
        config = {"id": spec["id"], "label": spec["title"], "origin": BASE,
                  "allowed_paths": [spec["path"]], "seeds": [BASE+spec["path"]], "enabled": True,
                  "interval_seconds": 86400, "delay_seconds": 5, "content_selector": {"id": "mainText"},
                  "metadata_selectors": {"document_fields": {"class": "doc-info"}},
                  "discover_links": False, "page_kind": "document",
                  "metadata": {"title": spec["title"], "region": "national", "matter": "demo-id-renewal",
                      "document_type": spec["document_type"], "issuer": spec["issuer"], "document_number": spec["document_number"],
                      "published_at": None, "effective_from": None, "effective_to": None, "usage_basis": basis,
                      "business_review": "pending", "scope_confirmed": True,
                      "collection_role": "core_candidate", "initial_page_observations": {"recorded_at": stamp, **spec["initial_page_observations"]}},
                  "access_review": {"approved": True, "reviewer": "codex_automated_technical_access_screen", "actor_kind": "machine",
                      "checked_at": stamp, "usage_basis": basis, "business_review_completed": False,
                      "purpose": "private_engineering_candidates_only", "robots_url": BASE+"/robots.txt",
                      "screening_note": "robots and normal GET previously returned 200; rules are rechecked by every fetch; no blanket permission inferred"}}
        for option in ("include_articles", "article_categories"):
            if option in spec:
                config[option] = spec[option]
        store.register(config)
    # Preserve once-observed failures rather than retrying or changing identity to evade them.
    probe_results = {"ID-LAW-01": "robots request denied (AccessStopped); no body requested in this run",
                     "ID-GUIDE-01": "robots request denied (AccessStopped); no body requested in this run",
                     "ID-NORM-01": "robots request timed out; no PDF requested in this run"}
    with store.db() as db:
        for source_id, reason in probe_results.items():
            db.execute("UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=? WHERE id=?", (reason, source_id))
            store.log(db, "source_access_probe_recorded", {"id": source_id, "result": reason, "checked_date": "2026-10-15",
                "provenance": "Observed direct Fetcher probe output earlier in this task; this statement makes no new request"})
    schedule(store)
    for _ in SPECS:
        worker_once(store, owner="official-intake")
    with store.db() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE workers SET progress='completed' WHERE id='official-intake'")
    status = store.status()
    with store.db() as db:
        configs = [json.loads(r[0]) for r in db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites ORDER BY id")]
        jobs = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT site_id,url,state,attempts,error FROM jobs WHERE site_id IN ('MPS-NORM-01','MPS-USE-01')")]
        revisions = []
        for row in db.execute("SELECT r.*,d.site_id,d.url FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id IN ('MPS-NORM-01','MPS-USE-01')"):
            revisions.append({"revision_id": row["id"], "source_id": row["site_id"], "url": row["url"], "sha256": row["sha256"],
                              "state": row["state"], "chunks": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=?", (row["id"],)).fetchone()[0]})
    (store.root / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": configs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    report = {"captured_at": stamp, "before_counts": before, "after_counts": status["counts"], "jobs": jobs,
              "revisions": revisions, "other_source_probes": probe_results,
              "business_review_completed": False, "official_knowledge_published": 0,
              "scope": "Actual direct official HTML acquisition into pending candidates. No bypass, no business approval, no assertion of current legal applicability."}
    output = ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/official-intake-2026-10-15.json"
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    if not all(job["state"] == "done" for job in jobs) or len(revisions) < len(SPECS):
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from pathlib import Path

        "origin": "https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn", "allowed_paths": ["/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/203777/index.html"], "seeds": [URL],
        "enabled": False, "interval_seconds": 86400, "delay_seconds": 5, "page_kind": "document", "discover_links": False,

            "screening_note": "Prior normal robots probe returned 404; the Fetcher rechecks robots/TLS/paths/rate for this one-time request. This is not a statement of site-wide permission."}}
    with store.db() as db:
        if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE id=?", (SOURCE,)).fetchone():
            raise RuntimeError("Existing intake state must be inspected before another attempt")

              "body_acquired": False, "body_ingested": False, "business_review_completed": False, "official_publication": False}

        report.update(status=status, content_type=headers.get("content-type"), final_url=final)
        if status != 200 or headers.get("content-type", "").split(";")[0] not in ("text/html", "application/xhtml+xml"):
            raise ValueError("Expected normal official HTML body was not returned")
        directory = store.root / "intake-2026-10-16"
        directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        path = directory / "statute-traffic.html"
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        report.update(body_acquired=True, bytes=len(raw), raw_sha256=fingerprint(raw))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        report.update(error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error)[:300])
        with store.db() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=? WHERE id=?", (str(error)[:300], SOURCE))
            store.log(db, "manual_source_intake_stopped", {"source": SOURCE, "reason": str(error)[:300]})
    with store.db() as db:
        configs = [json.loads(row[0]) for row in db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites ORDER BY id")]
    (store.root / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": configs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    report["counts"] = store.status()["counts"]
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/statute-mirror-intake.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""CLI browser login with private input and redacted output, never credentials in argv."""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import subprocess

from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--session", default="m1")
    parser.add_argument("--role", default="fresh_citizen")
    parser.add_argument("--workbench", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    credentials = json.loads((RUNTIME / "m1/accounts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))[args.role]
    ensure_private_directory(ROOT / ".playwright-cli")
    ensure_private_directory(RUNTIME / "m1/browser")
    email_name = "邮箱" if args.workbench else "* 邮箱地址 * 邮箱地址"
    password_name = "密码" if args.workbench else "* 密码 * 密码"
    button_name = "登录" if args.workbench else "登 录"
    source = "async (page) => {\n" + "\n".join([
        f"await page.getByRole('textbox', {{name:{json.dumps(email_name)},exact:true}}).fill({json.dumps(credentials['email'])});",
        f"await page.getByRole('textbox', {{name:{json.dumps(password_name)},exact:true}}).fill({json.dumps(credentials['password'])});",
        f"await page.getByRole('button', {{name:{json.dumps(button_name)},exact:true}}).click();",
        "await page.getByRole('heading', {name:'事项协作工作台',exact:true}).waitFor();" if args.workbench else
        "await page.getByRole('dialog', {name:'登录',exact:true}).waitFor({state:'hidden'});",
    ]) + "\n}"
    path = RUNTIME / "m1/browser/login.js"
    path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run([shutil.which("npx.cmd") or "npx", "--yes", "--package", "@playwright/cli",
            "playwright-cli", "-s=" + args.session, "run-code", "--filename", str(path)],
            cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=60)
        output = completed.stdout + completed.stderr
        for value in credentials.values():
            if isinstance(value, str):
                output = output.replace(value, "[PRIVATE]")
        # CLI prints the evaluated function; private literals are redacted above.
        print(output)
        if completed.returncode or "### Error" in output:
            raise SystemExit(1)
    finally:
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=3001)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=RUNTIME / "m1/sidecar-ui-traces")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    state = json.loads((RUNTIME / "m1/nexent-state.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", args.port), M1Handler)
    server.daemon_threads = True
    server.output = args.output.resolve()
    server.agent_ids = set(state["agents"].values())
    server.sidecar_conversations = set()
    server.observation_lock = threading.Lock()
    print(f"M1 native UI entry: http://127.0.0.1:{args.port}; only govx runs use isolated runtime 5016.", flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()

"""Apply the reviewed v3 source migration, without running or approving a test."""

import json
import os
from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from holdout_provenance import (ARCHIVE, MIGRATION, STALE_RECEIPT, archive_reference, expected_anchors,
                                migration_evidence, semantic_projection, source_binding)
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


def main():
    reference_path = ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-business-reference-draft.json"
    question_path = ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-business-questions-draft.json"
    screen_path = ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-semantic-screening.json"
    before, manifest = archive_reference(ROOT)
    if json.loads(reference_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) != before or (ROOT / MIGRATION).exists():
        raise ValueError("Expected unchanged active v2 and a new migration record; do not replay")
    questions = json.loads(question_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    screening = json.loads(screen_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert screening == json.loads((ROOT / ARCHIVE / screen_path.name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert questions == json.loads((ROOT / ARCHIVE / question_path.name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)

"""One-shot, literal-preserving rebinding to three already reviewed sources."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from holdout_provenance import read, sealed, semantic_projection, source_binding, validate_migration
from holdout_provenance_v4 import (ARCHIVE_V3, ARCHIVE_NAMES, BASE_COMMIT, EXPECTED_REVISIONS,
                                   MIGRATION_V4, literal_anchors, v4_evidence)
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


def serialize(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n").encode("utf-8")


def main():
    if (subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip() != BASE_COMMIT
            or (ROOT/ARCHIVE_V3).exists() or (ROOT/MIGRATION_V4).exists()):
        raise ValueError("Expected the inspected v3 base commit and a new archive; do not replay")
    files = {name:ROOT/"evaluation/knowledge"/name for name in ARCHIVE_NAMES if name != "holdout-draft-integrity.json"}
    files["holdout-draft-integrity.json"] = ROOT/"evidence/knowledge-update/holdout-draft-integrity.json"
    for path in files.values():
        if path.read_bytes() != subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:"+path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()], cwd=ROOT):
            raise ValueError("Current v3 inputs must match the inspected committed bytes")
    before = read(files["holdout-business-reference-draft.json"])
    questions = read(files["holdout-business-questions-draft.json"])
    screening = read(files["holdout-semantic-screening.json"])
    assert sealed(before) and sealed(screening) and before["draft_revision"] == 3
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME/"knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    after = deepcopy(before)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    after.update(draft_revision=4, provenance_migrated_at=stamp, provenance_migration={"path":MIGRATION_V4.as_posix()})
    with store.db() as db:
        validate_migration(ROOT, store, db, before)
        for key, expected in EXPECTED_REVISIONS.items():
            old = before["sources"][key]
            after["sources"][key] = source_binding(store, db, old["source_id"], old["url"])
            assert after["sources"][key]["revision"] == expected
        for old, new in zip(before["cases"], after["cases"], strict=True):
            new["background_source_anchors"] = literal_anchors(db, old, after["sources"])
            new["proposed_relevant_evidence"] = [] if new["proposed_outcome_after_qualified_publication"] == "stop" else [
                {"revision":anchor["revision"], "locator":anchor["locator"]} for anchor in new["background_source_anchors"]]
        after["content_sha256"] = fingerprint({k:v for k,v in after.items() if k != "content_sha256"})
        evidence = v4_evidence(store, db, before, after)
    affected = [case["id"] for case in evidence["cases"] if case["before_sha256"] != case["after_sha256"]]
    assert affected == ["HB01", "HB31", "HB08", "HB11", "HB35"]
    archive = ROOT/ARCHIVE_V3
    archive.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, path in files.items():
        (archive/name).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
    manifest = {"schema":1, "source_commit":BASE_COMMIT, "created_at":stamp,
        "purpose":"Immutable v3 draft and its stale-binding receipt before literal-only v4 migration; no acceptance.",
        "files":[{"path":(ARCHIVE_V3/name).as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint(files[name].read_bytes())} for name in sorted(files)]}
    manifest["content_sha256"] = fingerprint(manifest)
    (archive/"manifest.json").write_bytes(serialize(manifest))
    stale = ARCHIVE_V3/"holdout-draft-integrity.json"
    ledger = {"schema":1, "kind":"holdout_provenance_migration_not_acceptance", "created_at":stamp,
        "reviewer":"Codex AI", "reviewer_kind":"ai", "human_review_completed":False, "acceptance_authorized":False,
        "base_archive_manifest_sha256":manifest["content_sha256"], "evidence":evidence,
        "previous_integrity_report":{"path":stale.as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint((ROOT/stale).read_bytes())},
        "limits":"All 30 question/date/oracle/outcome/prerequisite/independence judgments are unchanged. Only three source bindings and five cases' revision/ordinal pointers change. This neither certifies independence nor freezes references, establishes unresolved currentness, authorizes model execution or publishes knowledge."}
    ledger["content_sha256"] = fingerprint(ledger)
    questions["reference_draft_sha256"] = after["content_sha256"]
    screening.update(screening_revision=4, assessed_at=stamp,
        reference_contents_sha256=after["content_sha256"], reference_semantics_sha256=fingerprint(semantic_projection(after)),
        provenance_migration_sha256=ledger["content_sha256"])
    screening["actor"]["run_id"] = "manual-provenance-semantic-rebind-20261017-v4"
    screening["inputs"] += " v4 rebind: verified the five affected case anchors against three actual scoped source reviews; all parent text, character spans, questions, dates, oracles, prerequisites and per-case screening judgments remain identical. The unreferenced national clause 76 retains its own pending watch."
    screening["provenance_review"] = {"reviewer":"Codex AI", "affected_case_ids":affected, "case_semantics_unchanged":True,
        "per_case_screening_judgments_unchanged":True, "literal_span_changes":0,
        "source_truth_or_batch_independence_approved_by_this_rebind":False}
    screening["history_artifacts"] += [{"path":item["path"], "sha256":item["sha256"]} for item in manifest["files"]]
    screening["history_artifacts"] += [{"path":(ARCHIVE_V3/"manifest.json").as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint((archive/"manifest.json").read_bytes())},
        {"path":MIGRATION_V4.as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint(serialize(ledger))}]
    screening["content_sha256"] = fingerprint({k:v for k,v in screening.items() if k != "content_sha256"})
    assert screening["cases"] == read(files["holdout-semantic-screening.json"])["cases"]
    staging = store.root/"holdout-drafts/provenance-v4-20261017"
    ensure_private_directory(staging)
    payloads = [(ROOT/MIGRATION_V4, ledger), (files["holdout-business-reference-draft.json"], after),
                (files["holdout-business-questions-draft.json"], questions), (files["holdout-semantic-screening.json"], screening)]
    for destination, value in payloads:
        temporary = staging/destination.name
        if temporary.exists():
            raise ValueError("Private staging exists; inspect a partial operation rather than replay")
        temporary.write_bytes(serialize(value))
    for destination, _ in payloads:
        os.replace(staging/destination.name, destination)
    with store.db() as db:
        validate_migration(ROOT, store, db, after)
    print(json.dumps({"draft_revision":4, "affected_cases":affected, "source_bindings_updated":3,
        "questions_dates_or_oracles_changed":0, "literal_span_changes":0, "reference_frozen":False,
        "independence_certified":False, "acceptance_authorized":False}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                                   MIGRATION_V5, v5_evidence)
from holdout_provenance_v4 import literal_anchors
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


def serialize(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n").encode("utf-8")


def main():
    if (subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip() != BASE_COMMIT
            or (ROOT/ARCHIVE_V4).exists() or (ROOT/MIGRATION_V5).exists()):
        raise ValueError("Expected the inspected v4 base commit and a new archive; do not replay")
    files = {name:ROOT/"evaluation/knowledge"/name for name in ARCHIVE_NAMES if name != "holdout-draft-integrity.json"}
    files["holdout-draft-integrity.json"] = ROOT/"evidence/knowledge-update/holdout-draft-integrity.json"
    for path in files.values():
        if path.read_bytes() != subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:"+path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()], cwd=ROOT):
            raise ValueError("Current v4 inputs must match the inspected committed bytes")
    before = read(files["holdout-business-reference-draft.json"])
    questions = read(files["holdout-business-questions-draft.json"])
    screening = read(files["holdout-semantic-screening.json"])
    assert sealed(before) and sealed(screening) and before["draft_revision"] == 4
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME/"knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    after = deepcopy(before)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    after.update(draft_revision=5, provenance_migrated_at=stamp, provenance_migration={"path":MIGRATION_V5.as_posix()})
    with store.db() as db:
        validate_migration(ROOT, store, db, before)
        for key, expected in EXPECTED_REVISIONS.items():
            old = before["sources"][key]
            after["sources"][key] = source_binding(store, db, old["source_id"], old["url"])
            assert after["sources"][key]["revision"] == expected
        for old, new in zip(before["cases"], after["cases"], strict=True):
            new["background_source_anchors"] = literal_anchors(db, old, after["sources"], source_keys={"USE"})
            new["proposed_relevant_evidence"] = [] if new["proposed_outcome_after_qualified_publication"] == "stop" else [
                {"revision":anchor["revision"], "locator":anchor["locator"]} for anchor in new["background_source_anchors"]]
        after["content_sha256"] = fingerprint({k:v for k,v in after.items() if k != "content_sha256"})
        evidence = v5_evidence(store, db, before, after)
    affected = [case["id"] for case in evidence["cases"] if case["before_sha256"] != case["after_sha256"]]
    assert affected == ["HB21", "HB22", "HB38", "HB24"]
    archive = ROOT/ARCHIVE_V4
    archive.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, path in files.items():
        (archive/name).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
    manifest = {"schema":1, "source_commit":BASE_COMMIT, "created_at":stamp,
        "purpose":"Immutable v4 draft and its stale-binding receipt before literal-only v5 migration; no acceptance.",
        "files":[{"path":(ARCHIVE_V4/name).as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint(files[name].read_bytes())} for name in sorted(files)]}
    manifest["content_sha256"] = fingerprint(manifest)
    (archive/"manifest.json").write_bytes(serialize(manifest))
    stale = ARCHIVE_V4/"holdout-draft-integrity.json"
    ledger = {"schema":1, "kind":"holdout_provenance_migration_not_acceptance", "created_at":stamp,
        "reviewer":"Codex AI", "reviewer_kind":"ai", "human_review_completed":False, "acceptance_authorized":False,
        "base_archive_manifest_sha256":manifest["content_sha256"], "evidence":evidence,
        "previous_integrity_report":{"path":stale.as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint((ROOT/stale).read_bytes())},
        "limits":"All 30 question/date/oracle/outcome/prerequisite/independence judgments are unchanged. Only the USE source binding and four cases' revision/ordinal pointers change. This neither certifies independence nor freezes references, establishes unresolved currentness, authorizes model execution or publishes knowledge."}
    ledger["content_sha256"] = fingerprint(ledger)
    questions["reference_draft_sha256"] = after["content_sha256"]
    screening.update(screening_revision=5, assessed_at=stamp,
        reference_contents_sha256=after["content_sha256"], reference_semantics_sha256=fingerprint(semantic_projection(after)),
        provenance_migration_sha256=ledger["content_sha256"])
    screening["actor"]["run_id"] = "manual-provenance-semantic-rebind-20261018-v5"
    screening["inputs"] += " v5 rebind: verified the four affected case anchors against the actual scoped privacy review; all parent text, character spans, questions, dates, oracles, prerequisites and per-case screening judgments remain identical. The old sixteen privacy paragraphs remain in history; no unrelated announcement clauses are approved."
    screening["provenance_review"] = {"reviewer":"Codex AI", "affected_case_ids":affected, "case_semantics_unchanged":True,
        "per_case_screening_judgments_unchanged":True, "literal_span_changes":0,
        "source_truth_or_batch_independence_approved_by_this_rebind":False}
    screening["history_artifacts"] += [{"path":item["path"], "sha256":item["sha256"]} for item in manifest["files"]]
    screening["history_artifacts"] += [{"path":(ARCHIVE_V4/"manifest.json").as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint((archive/"manifest.json").read_bytes())},
        {"path":MIGRATION_V5.as_posix(), "sha256":fingerprint(serialize(ledger))}]
    screening["content_sha256"] = fingerprint({k:v for k,v in screening.items() if k != "content_sha256"})
    assert screening["cases"] == read(files["holdout-semantic-screening.json"])["cases"]
    staging = store.root/"holdout-drafts/provenance-v5-20261018"
    ensure_private_directory(staging)
    payloads = [(ROOT/MIGRATION_V5, ledger), (files["holdout-business-reference-draft.json"], after),
                (files["holdout-business-questions-draft.json"], questions), (files["holdout-semantic-screening.json"], screening)]
    for destination, value in payloads:
        temporary = staging/destination.name
        if temporary.exists():
            raise ValueError("Private staging exists; inspect a partial operation rather than replay")
        temporary.write_bytes(serialize(value))
    for destination, _ in payloads:
        os.replace(staging/destination.name, destination)
    with store.db() as db:
        validate_migration(ROOT, store, db, after)
    print(json.dumps({"draft_revision":5, "affected_cases":affected, "source_bindings_updated":1,
        "questions_dates_or_oracles_changed":0, "literal_span_changes":0, "reference_frozen":False,
        "independence_certified":False, "acceptance_authorized":False}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def login(self, credentials):
        data = self.call("POST", "/user/signin", credentials)["data"]
        self.token = data["session"]["access_token"]
        return self.call("GET", "/user/current_user_info")["data"]["user"]

"""Load a completed local topic adapter and classify one question; no server changes."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--question", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--save-demo-proof", action="store_true", help="Save the supplied non-private demo question and prediction as public engineering evidence")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{12}Z", args.run_id) or not 1 <= len(args.question.strip()) <= 200:
        raise ValueError("Invalid run ID or question length")
    directory = ROOT / ".runtime/training/runs" / args.run_id
    report = json.loads((directory / "result.json").read_bytes())
    if not report["training_completed"] or report.get("model_source") != "official_Qwen_ModelScope_per_file_sha256":
        raise ValueError("Expected a completed official ModelScope-base experiment")
    spec_path = ROOT / "config/training/qwen3-4b.modelscope.json"
    if hashlib.sha256(spec_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != report["model_source_spec_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Base model specification differs from training")
    for name, expected in report["adapter_files"].items():
        if Path(name).name != name or hashlib.sha256((directory / "adapter" / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise ValueError("Saved adapter fingerprint mismatch")
    from download_qwen_training_base import verify_base
    from train_qwen_topic import SYSTEM, TOPICS
    base = ROOT / ".runtime/training/base/Qwen3-4B-modelscope"
    verify_base(base, json.loads(spec_path.read_bytes()))
    os.environ["HF_HUB_OFFLINE"] = "1"
    os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY"] = "1"
    import torch
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM, BitsAndBytesConfig
    from peft import PeftModel
    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
        raise RuntimeError("CUDA GPU unavailable")
    dtype = torch.bfloat16 if torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() else torch.float16
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(base, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(base, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False,
        use_safetensors=True, device_map={"":0}, dtype=dtype, attn_implementation="sdpa",
        quantization_config=BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_4bit=True,bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4",
            bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True,bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=dtype))
    model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(model, directory / "adapter", is_trainable=False, local_files_only=True)
    model.eval()
    prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template([{"role":"system","content":SYSTEM},{"role":"user","content":args.question}],
        tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=True,enable_thinking=False)
    inputs = tokenizer(prompt,return_tensors="pt",add_special_tokens=False).to("cuda")
    if inputs["input_ids"].shape[1] + 32 > 384:
        raise ValueError("Question exceeds this experiment's token budget")
    with torch.inference_mode():
        generated = model.generate(**inputs,max_new_tokens=32,do_sample=False,pad_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id)
    text = tokenizer.decode(generated[0,inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]:],skip_special_tokens=True).strip()
    result = json.loads(text)
    if not isinstance(result,dict) or set(result)!={"topic"} or result["topic"] not in TOPICS:
        raise ValueError("Invalid classifier output; send for review rather than accepting it")
    proof = {"run_id":args.run_id,"question":args.question,"output":result,
        "base_and_adapter_reloaded":True,"weights_verified":True,"local_inference":True,
        "independent_accuracy":False,"production_model_changed":False}
    if args.save_demo_proof:
        (ROOT/"evidence/qwen-training/inference-smoke.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))


if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

              "web_sources": WEB_SOURCES, "archived_sources": local,
              "cases": cases}
    report["content_sha256"] = fingerprint(report)
    (ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/pilot-ai-reference-answers.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

"""Prepare immutable synthetic-only retrieval snapshot and private MCP config."""

import json
import secrets
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.asset_query import AssetQuery, digest
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


def main():
    runtime = RUNTIME / "asset-query"
    ensure_private_directory(runtime)
    source = json.loads((RUNTIME / "preparation/run/assets.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    embedding = json.loads((RUNTIME / "preparation/run/embedding.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    profile = json.loads((ROOT / "config/preparation/profile.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if source.get("data_class") != "synthetic":
        raise ValueError("Only synthetic input is enabled in this rehearsal")
    segments = [row for asset in source["assets"] for row in asset["segments"]]
    if {row["segment_id"] for row in embedding["ranked"]} != {row["segment_id"] for row in segments}:
        raise ValueError("Rebuild vectors after changing sources")
    if len(embedding["vectors"]) != len(segments) + 1:
        raise ValueError("Corpus vector count mismatch")
    vectors = {"model": embedding["model"], "dimension": embedding["dimension"], "query_instruction": profile["query_instruction"],
               "rows": [{"segment_id": segment["segment_id"], "vector": vector} for segment, vector in zip(segments, embedding["vectors"][1:])]}
    original_paths = []
    for asset in source["assets"]:
        path = (ROOT / asset["path"]).resolve()
        if not path.is_relative_to(RUNTIME / "preparation"):
            raise ValueError("Rehearsal originals must stay in private preparation directory")
        filename = asset["asset_id"] + path.suffix.lower()
        original_paths.append((path, filename))
        asset["snapshot_file"] = "raw/" + filename
        asset.pop("path")
    fingerprint = digest({"assets": source, "vectors": vectors})
    index = {"knowledge_version": "docs-" + fingerprint[:16], "snapshot_sha256": fingerprint}
    directory = runtime / "snapshot"
    if directory.exists():
        old = json.loads((directory / "index.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if old != index:
            raise ValueError("Existing source snapshot is immutable; use a new isolated runtime for a changed corpus")
    else:
        (directory / "raw").mkdir(parents=True)
        for path, filename in original_paths:
            shutil.copyfile(path, directory / "raw" / filename)
        for name, value in (("assets.json", source), ("vectors.json", vectors), ("index.json", index)):
            (directory / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    token_path = runtime / "mcp-token.txt"
    if not token_path.exists():
        token_path.write_text(secrets.token_urlsafe(40), encoding="ascii")
    shutil.copyfile(RUNTIME / "mcp/role-map.json", runtime / "role-map.json")
    AssetQuery(runtime).load()
    print(json.dumps({"prepared": True, "assets": len(source["assets"]), "segments": len(segments), **index}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def prepare_compose(vendor):
    overlay, _ = prepare_overlay(vendor.parent.parent)
    for file in (vendor / "deploy/docker/compose").glob("*.yml"):
        content = file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        data = yaml.safe_load(content)
        if not data or not isinstance(data.get("services"), dict):
            continue
        # Recover only our exact previous transformation. Unrelated user edits
        # must not be reset to the upstream checkout.
        relative = file.relative_to(vendor).as_posix()
        original = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(vendor), "show", f"HEAD:{relative}"]).decode("utf-8")
        if content == bind_compose_ports(original, legacy=True):
            content = original
        rewritten = mount_overlay(bind_compose_ports(content), overlay)
        yaml.safe_load(rewritten)
        file.write_text(rewritten, encoding="utf-8")

def services_only_script(content):
    # On Windows netstat also lists remote ports of established connections.
    # Check listeners only so a remote :3000 does not block the local UI.
    content = content.replace(
        'netstat -an 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "[:\\.]${port}[[:space:]]"',
        'netstat -an 2>/dev/null | grep -i "LISTEN" | grep -qE "[:\\.]${port}[[:space:]]"',
    )
    # Keep the official deployment intact except its automatic account step.
    pattern = r'(?ms)^create_default_super_admin_user\(\) \{.*?^\}\n(?=\nchoose_image_env\(\))'
    replacement = ('create_default_super_admin_user() {\n'
                   '  echo "Account creation deferred to the user-run scripts/initialize_accounts.ps1."\n'
                   '  return 0\n}\n')
    result, count = re.subn(pattern, replacement, content)
    if count != 1:
        raise ValueError('Pinned deployment account boundary was not found; refusing an automatic account deployment')
    return 'export NEXENT_DEPLOY_CONFIG_MODE=defaults DEPLOYMENT_LANGUAGE=en\n' + result

"""Enable publisher-bound attachment discovery without broadening existing source grants."""

import argparse
import copy
import json
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore
from gov_mcp.knowledge_backup import create_bundle
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import schedule, worker_once
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


PARENT = "HN-POLICY-DISCOVERY"
COLLECTORS = {"HN-OSS-PDF-DISCOVERY": "https://oss.henan.gov.cn", "HN-XCOSS-PDF-DISCOVERY": "https://xcoss.henan.gov.cn"}
EXISTING = {"HN-MEASURES-2021-PDF": "monitor", "HN-REPEAL-2020-PDF": "monitor", "HN-REPEAL-2021-PDF": "monitor",
            "HN-VALIDITY-2025-PDF": "excluded_history", "HN-REPEAL-2025B-PDF": "excluded_history"}


def collector_configs(parent):
    basis = ("Machine technical access/use screen limited to PDF normative instruments directly linked in the selected body of official Henan provincial police normative-file publications from HN-POLICY-DISCOVERY. "
        "Only the declared HTTPS origin and /typtfile/YYYYMMDD/32-hex.pdf layout; publisher identity, visible parent link and separate normal robots/IP/TLS/rate checks required. "
        "Private integrity archive and attributed normative-text analysis under Copyright Law Article 5(1); not a blanket license for object-storage contents, news, media or website design. "
        "No business applicability or effectivity approval; unknown origins, parameterized links and unsupported formats require separate review.")
    return [{"id": source_id, "label": "省厅规范PDF附件发现："+origin.split("//")[1], "origin": origin, "allowed_paths": ["/typtfile/"],
        "seeds": [], "enabled": True, "interval_seconds": 86400, "delay_seconds": 5, "page_kind": "document", "discover_links": False,
        "attachment_only": True, "attachment_parent_sources": [PARENT], "attachment_url_layout": "henan_typtfile_pdf", "attachment_max_pending": 20,
        "pdf_ocr": {"engine": "windows.media.ocr", "language": "zh-Hans-CN"}, "watch_scopes": copy.deepcopy(parent["watch_scopes"]),
        "metadata": {"title": "待核查省厅规范PDF附件", "region": "unknown", "matter": "unclassified", "scope_confirmed": False,
            "document_type": "official_normative_attachment_candidate", "effective_from": None, "effective_to": None, "published_at": None,
            "usage_basis": basis, "collection_role": "attachment_candidate", "business_review": "pending"},
        "access_review": {"approved": True, "reviewer": "Codex AI bounded official normative attachment technical screen", "actor_kind": "machine",
            "checked_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "usage_basis": basis, "business_review_completed": False,
            "purpose": "publisher_bound_normative_pdf_discovery_not_general_bucket_crawling"}} for source_id, origin in COLLECTORS.items()]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--enable-monitoring", action="store_true", required=True)
    parser.parse_args()
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update")
    with store.db() as db:
        configs = {r["id"]: json.loads(r["config"]) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,config FROM sites")}
        if any(source_id in configs for source_id in COLLECTORS) or configs[PARENT].get("attachment_discovery"):
            raise ValueError("Attachment migration already configured; use normal monitored jobs")
        if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE id=? AND paused_reason IS NOT NULL", (PARENT,)).fetchone():
            raise ValueError("Will not resume a paused publisher")
        exclusions = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT d.id AS document_id,r.id,r.sha256,r.body_sha256,e.reviewer,e.reason FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id JOIN exclusions e ON e.revision_id=r.id WHERE r.rowid IN (SELECT MAX(rowid) FROM revisions GROUP BY document_id)")]
        owners = {}
        for source_id, policy in EXISTING.items():
            config = configs[source_id]
            if len(config["seeds"]) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Exact existing attachment seed required")
            url = config["seeds"][0]
            row = db.execute("SELECT r.id,r.sha256,r.state FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? AND d.url=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (source_id, url)).fetchone()
            if not row:
                raise ValueError("Existing attachment archive required")
            store._verify(db, row["id"], require_review=False)
            owners[url] = {"source_id": source_id, "policy": policy}
            if policy == "excluded_history":
                if config["enabled"] or row["state"] != "excluded" or config["metadata"].get("collection_role") != "governance_reference":
                    raise ValueError("Historical attachment exclusion binding differs")
                owners[url]["sha256"] = row["sha256"]
    parent = copy.deepcopy(configs[PARENT])
    parent["attachment_discovery"] = {"sources": list(COLLECTORS), "owners": owners, "max_links": 5}
    parent["metadata"]["selected_content_scope"] = "Matched official normative-file directory HTML bodies; PDF bodies use separate publisher-bound reviewed attachment sources. Existing monitors are reused; explicitly excluded historical scans are not re-fetched."
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")+"-"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    create_bundle(store, store.root / "backups" / (stamp+"-before-attachment-discovery"))
    for config in collector_configs(parent):
        store.register(config)
    store.register(parent)
    schedule(store)
    for _ in range(40):
        if not worker_once(store, owner="attachment-discovery-bootstrap"):
            break
    reapplied, changed = [], []
    for previous in exclusions:
        with store.db() as db:
            latest = db.execute("SELECT * FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (previous["document_id"],)).fetchone()
            store._verify(db, latest["id"], require_review=False)
        if latest["state"] == "excluded":
            continue
        if (latest["state"] == "pending_review" and latest["sha256"] == previous["sha256"] and latest["body_sha256"] == previous["body_sha256"]
                and previous["reviewer"].startswith("Codex AI")):
            revision = store.exclude(latest["id"], "Codex AI attachment migration source-scope check",
                "新增附件来源/定位元数据；已校验原件字节和选入正文均与前次AI范围核查一致，继续保留原排除理由："+previous["reason"], True)
            reapplied.append({"previous": previous["id"], "current": revision, "original_and_body_unchanged": True})
        else:
            changed.append(latest["id"])
    with store.db() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE workers SET progress='completed' WHERE id='attachment-discovery-bootstrap'")
        all_configs = {r["id"]: json.loads(r["config"]) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,config FROM sites")}
        proof_ids = sorted({PARENT, *COLLECTORS, *(key for key, policy in EXISTING.items() if policy == "monitor"), *parent.get("discovery_document_owners", {}).values()})
        jobs = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT site_id,url,state,attempts,error FROM jobs WHERE site_id IN ("+",".join("?" for _ in proof_ids)+")", proof_ids)]
        ownership_counts = {url: db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE url=?", (url,)).fetchone()[0] for url in owners}
    if any(all_configs[key] != value for key, value in configs.items() if key != PARENT):
        raise ValueError("Unrelated source configuration changed")
    (store.root / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": list(all_configs.values())}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    status = store.status()
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": all(j["state"] == "done" for j in jobs) and all(n == 1 for n in ownership_counts.values()),

"""Verify the real provincial directory archive, then optionally enable bounded discovery.

Use after deploying the current worker. Directory dates and titles are signals,
not business approval. The initial archive is required only for this bootstrap.
"""

import argparse
import json
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_backup import create_bundle
from gov_mcp.knowledge_discovery import parse_index
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import schedule, worker_once
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


SOURCE = "HN-POLICY-DISCOVERY"
URL = "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/zfxxgk/zc/xzgfxwj/"
OWNER_URL = "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2022/08-16/2561597.html"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--enable-monitoring", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=not args.enable_monitoring)
    intake = json.loads((ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/henan-policy-index-intake.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    raw = (store.root / "intake-2026-10-16/henan-policy-index.html").read_bytes()
    if not intake["body_acquired"] or intake["url"] != URL or fingerprint(raw) != intake["raw_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Verified guarded directory archive required")
    with store.db() as db:
        config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (SOURCE,)).fetchone()[0])
        owner = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id='HN-NORM-PUBLISHER'").fetchone()[0])
        if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE id IN (?,?) AND paused_reason IS NOT NULL", (SOURCE, owner["id"])).fetchone():
            raise ValueError("Paused sources require separate access review; bootstrap will not resume them")
    if config["origin"] != "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn" or config["seeds"] != [URL] or not owner["enabled"] or owner["seeds"] != [OWNER_URL]:
        raise ValueError("Expected reviewed directory and existing normative monitor required")
    config.update(enabled=args.enable_monitoring, interval_seconds=21600, allowed_paths=["/"],
        page_kind="index", discover_links=True, content_selector={"id": "content"},
        excluded_content_selectors=[{"class": "operator"}], metadata_selectors={"page_date": {"id": "pubDate"}},
        discovery_selector={"class": "zfxxgk_zdgkc"}, discovery_keywords=["居民身份证", "身份证", "修改", "废止", "清理", "便民"],
        discovery_full_title=True, discovery_upgrade_same_host_https=True,
        discovery_max_links=15, discovery_max_pages=5, discovery_max_depth=5,
        discovery_numbered_pagination={"id": "pageDec", "total_attribute": "pagecount", "size_attribute": "pagesize", "url_pattern": "index_{page}.html"},
        discovery_document_owners={OWNER_URL: owner["id"]},
        watch_scopes=[{"region": "郑州市二七区", "matter": "demo-id-renewal"}])
    config["metadata"].update(region="unknown", matter="unclassified", document_type="official_policy_candidate", scope_confirmed=False,
        title="省厅目录发现的待核定文件", collection_role="discovery_candidate",
        selected_content_scope="Only matched normative-file directory entries and their selected HTML body; amendments/repeal lists and convenience measures included. Linked attachments are not fetched automatically.")
    config["access_review"]["purpose"] = "bounded_official_normative_directory_discovery_pending_scope_review"
    entries, truncated = parse_index(raw, "index", URL, config)
    if truncated or not any(entry["url"] == OWNER_URL for entry in entries) or not any(entry["url"].endswith("/index_1.html") for entry in entries):
        raise ValueError("Observed directory/parser contract changed; review it before enabling")
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "source_id": SOURCE,
        "initial_index_sha256": fingerprint(raw), "initial_selected_entries": entries,
        "pagination_basis": "Actual rendered next-page click on 2026-10-16 reached index_1.html and showed 2/2; raw page declares 41 records at 24/page. Reviewed pattern regenerates bounded pages from each returned total.",
        "same_host_http_links_upgraded_to_https": True, "business_review_completed": False,
        "automatic_monitoring_enabled": args.enable_monitoring,
        "scope": "Bounded declared provincial normative-file directory, not a claim of all provincial policies or attachment acquisition. Unknown applicability stays pending; the existing 14-clause monitor owns its exact URL."}
    if args.enable_monitoring:
        stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")+"-"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
        create_bundle(store, store.root / "backups" / (stamp+"-before-henan-discovery"))
        store.register(config)
        schedule(store)
        for _ in range(35):
            if not worker_once(store, owner="henan-discovery-bootstrap"):
                break
        with store.db() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE workers SET progress='completed' WHERE id='henan-discovery-bootstrap'")
            configs = [json.loads(row[0]) for row in db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites ORDER BY id")]
            report["jobs"] = [dict(row) for row in db.execute("SELECT url,state,attempts,error FROM jobs WHERE site_id=?", (SOURCE,))]
            report["index_checks"] = [json.loads(row[0]) for row in db.execute("SELECT data FROM audit WHERE action='discovery_index_checked' AND json_extract(data,'$.site')=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5", (SOURCE,))]
            report["owner_document_count"] = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE url=?", (OWNER_URL,)).fetchone()[0]
        (store.root / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": configs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        status = store.status()
        report.update(counts=status["counts"], discovery=status["discovery"], official_knowledge_published=status["counts"]["heads"])
        report["source_check_passed"] = bool(report["jobs"]) and all(job["state"] == "done" for job in report["jobs"]) and report["owner_document_count"] == 1
        (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/henan-policy-discovery.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    if args.enable_monitoring and not report["source_check_passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_discovery import parse_index
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import schedule, worker_once
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME

    parser.add_argument("--research-directory", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--verify-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    research = args.research_directory.resolve()
    raw = (research / "henan-interpretation-index.html").read_bytes()
    receipt = json.loads((research / "henan-interpretation-index-result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if receipt.get("status") != 200 or receipt["url"] != URL or fingerprint(raw) != receipt["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Earlier normal Fetcher directory receipt required")
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=args.verify_only)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    basis = "Official police policy-explanation directory. Limited private archive and attributed policy-fact analysis; no media/design redistribution. Matched convenience measures may contain multiple matters and stay unclassified pending scope review. Exact known 2026 resident-ID measure belongs to its existing bounded monitor."
    config = {"id": SOURCE, "label": "河南省公安厅政策解读目录：身份证及便民利民更新发现", "origin": "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn",
        "allowed_paths": ["/"], "seeds": [URL], "enabled": True, "interval_seconds": 21600, "delay_seconds": 5,
        "page_kind": "index", "discover_links": True, "content_selector": {"id": "content"},
        "metadata_selectors": {"page_date": {"id": "pubDate"}, "named_source": {"id": "source"}},
        "discovery_selector": {"class": "listbox"}, "discovery_keywords": ["居民身份证", "便民利民"],
        "discovery_full_title": True, "discovery_upgrade_same_host_https": True,
        "discovery_max_links": 10, "discovery_max_pages": 3, "discovery_max_depth": 3,
        "discovery_numbered_pagination": {"id": "pageDec", "total_attribute": "pagecount", "size_attribute": "pagesize", "url_pattern": "index_{page}.html"},
        "discovery_document_owners": {OWNER_URL: "HN-MEASURES-2026"},
        "watch_scopes": [{"region": "郑州市二七区", "matter": "demo-id-renewal"}],
        "metadata": {"title": "政策解读目录发现的待分类文件", "region": "unknown", "matter": "unclassified",
            "document_type": "official_policy_explanation", "collection_role": "discovery_candidate", "scope_confirmed": False,
            "effective_from": None, "effective_to": None, "published_at": None, "usage_basis": basis,
            "business_review": "pending", "selected_content_scope": "Complete selected HTML paragraphs of matched explanation pages. Other matters are not approved for resident-ID answers; future image-only or unsupported bodies quarantine normally. No automatic media download."},
        "access_review": {"approved": True, "reviewer": "Codex AI technical access/use screen", "actor_kind": "machine",
            "checked_at": stamp, "usage_basis": basis, "business_review_completed": False,
            "purpose": "bounded_official_policy_explanation_discovery_pending_scope_review"}}
    entries, truncated = parse_index(raw, "index", URL, config)
    if truncated or not any(e["url"] == OWNER_URL for e in entries) or not any(e["kind"] == "index" for e in entries):

    if not args.verify_only:
        with store.db() as db:
            if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE id=?", (SOURCE,)).fetchone():
                raise ValueError("Already registered; use normal monitoring or --verify-only")
        store.register(config)
        schedule(store)
        # A finite bootstrap; durable background work owns anything not done here.
        for _ in range(12):
            with store.db() as db:
                active = db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE site_id IN (?,?) AND state='queued'", (SOURCE, "HN-MEASURES-2026")).fetchone()
            if not active or not worker_once(store, owner="henan-interpretation-intake"):
                break
    with store.db() as db:

"""Prepare a source-bound 30-scenario draft, with independence and release open.

import json
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_review import development_registry, question_fingerprint
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


SOURCES = {
    "NORM": ("HN-NORM-PUBLISHER", None), "NATIONAL": ("MPS-NORM-01", None),
    "D26": ("HN-MEASURES-2026", None),
    "D25": ("HN-INTERPRETATION-DISCOVERY", "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2026/01-05/3282174.html"),
    "D24": ("HN-INTERPRETATION-DISCOVERY", "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2024/05-27/2998889.html"),
    "F07": ("MOF-FEE-2007", None), "F18": ("MOF-FIRST-ISSUE-2018", None),
    "USE": ("MPS-USE-01", None), "LAW": ("ID-LAW-01", None), "WINDOW": ("HN-UPDATE-GS-01", None),
}
# question, planned answer/stop, source-based draft oracle, background locators,
# unresolved prerequisite, nearest development topics, new decision distinction
CASES = [
    ("我在二七区本人办理到期换领，已经与父母分户，窗口电子证照能查到我的户籍。系统查到信息，是否就表示可以不核验原件、也不准备其他材料？", "answer",
     "只能说明省级第7条的免纸质前提与身份核验不是一回事，分户也不自行改变到期换领材料。国家、省级和区级材料关系未核定前，不给无条件免材料清单。",
     [("NORM","第七条"),("NORM","第一百五十九条"),("NATIONAL","第七十八条")], "现行本地材料组合及共享条件落地", ["KQ02","KQ09"], "电子共享、纸质提交和现场核验三者的关系；不是泛问是否带户口簿。"),
    ("为缩短本人到期换领的窗口停留时间，同事想让群众先在空白申领登记表签名，之后再补录资料，也不再请本人核对。原文中的核对和签名顺序允许这样处理吗？", "answer",
     "按国家第78条和河南第159条区分资料审核、采集、核对无误、本人或监护人签名及发凭证的顺序；空白表预签不能由此当作已核对完整资料的确认。不推断具体受理机关已实施该做法或裁定个案责任。",
     [("NATIONAL","第七十八条"),("NORM","第一百五十九条")], "当前登记表确认程序及国家、省级条款的本地适用", ["KQ01","KQ07","KQ08"], "不是列材料或问是否采指纹，而是资料尚未填写时的签名能否代替后续核对。"),
    ("上次申请时旧证只是交验，这次我还想在领到新证后把剪角旧证留作纪念。申请时核验、领新证时交回和最后保留旧证，是同一个环节吗？", "answer",
     "按省级第159、161条分别说明申请交验、领取新证交回、剪角处理及群众提出留存纪念的条件；不能把这些环节混为提交时立即收走，也不保证每种个案的处理结果。",
     [("NORM","第一百五十九条"),("NORM","第一百六十一条")], "当前本地旧证处理实施关系", ["KQ03","KQ17"], "加入剪角后纪念留存，判断三个不同环节，超出旧题的提交或核验二选一。"),
    ("换领登记时，群众旧表上的公民身份号码与当前登记记录相差一位，姓名和照片看起来相同。同事认为只是识别错误，想直接按旧表覆盖号码再让本人签名；可以跳过身份信息冲突核查吗？", "stop",
     "停止替主管机关选择或覆盖号码。姓名照片相似不足确定哪条号码记录正确，识别错误也只是未经核实的解释；需按实际记录和正式核查程序解决冲突，不能先改号再以签名补充正当性。",
     [("LAW","第三条"),("NORM","第一百五十九条")], "冲突记录的真实来源、主管机关号码核查及更正规程", ["KQ01","KQ19","KQ28"], "个人身份数据互相冲突时能否自动改号，区别于政策文本冲突或缺少某种证明。"),
    ("旧证即将到期、外观和印字都完整，但一台自助设备反复读不了。我能让你据此确认芯片已经失效，直接把办证原因改成严重损坏吗？", "stop",
     "不能仅凭一台设备的读取结果作证件故障诊断或代定办证原因。区分视读、机读功能和设备读卡失败的事实，需由实际核验确定证件状态及适用分支；不凭外观完整反推机读正常，也不保证受理结果。",
     [("LAW","第六条"),("NORM","第一百五十七条")], "读卡异常的实际核验、证件状态与本地办证原因认定", ["KQ03","KQ25","KQ28"], "故障原因未定时的证据充分性；与已知丢失或明知仅到期却借用损坏入口不同。"),
    ("旧海报写25个自然日，2026省厅网页又分别介绍普通办证和考生绿色通道。更新窗口说明时，能写成所有人最短5个工作日、最长25个自然日吗？", "answer",
     "不拼成统一区间。分别说明2024的25自然日、2026本省户籍普通办证15工作日，以及特殊时期急需用证考生绿色通道5工作日；保留各自来源、条件和起止环节，不把数字当作可直接比较的保证。",
     [("D24","正文段落1"),("D26","正文段落1"),("D26","正文段落2")], "精确施行日和本地当前承诺", ["KQ13"], "把不同年代、不同单位、不同人群拼接为统一服务区间的模板错误。"),
    ("我现在已经年满26周岁，旧证是十年期，办到期换领的新证是否必须沿用十年有效期？新证有效期和15个工作日办证时限是一回事吗？", "answer",
     "依据法律第5条分别说明年龄对应的证件有效期，不能仅沿用上一张证的十年期限；证件有效期与省级措施的制作发放时限是不同概念。原文对26至45周岁列二十年，当前适用及个案登记日期仍须核定，不计算未知日期边界。",
     [("LAW","第五条"),("D26","正文段落1")], "法律版本现行性、申请人实际年龄及登记日期的认定", ["KQ13","KQ24"], "证件自身有效年限按年龄分档，区别于办理等待天数和未成年人是否属试点。"),
    ("一位本地成年群众在到期前五个月已获窗口受理，同事查到旧规范写三个月，想据此撤销申请；六个月更新说明还没找到原调整文件。你能直接判断应撤销吗？", "stop",
     "停止给出撤销受理的行政判断。不能仅凭旧三个月条款忽略六个月更新信号，也不能凭转载日期推定调整起始日；需要原调整依据、当前适用关系和真实受理记录。",
     [("NORM","第一百五十七条"),("WINDOW","正文段落3")], "六个月调整原文件、起止日期及过渡规则", ["KQ04","KQ28"], "已经受理后的追溯处理，与申请前能否提前换领是不同决定。"),
    ("我选择自费邮寄并担心邮路耽误，能否把文件中的受理到领证改成受理到寄出，直接替我算出最迟收到新证的日期？", "stop",
     "不擅自改变时限终点，也不计算缺少依据的个案最迟到达日。需要当前受理承诺、起算日期、工作日安排及具体邮寄服务规则。",
     [("D26","正文段落1"),("D24","正文段落2")], "当前邮寄环节、日期计算及个案受理信息", ["KQ13","KQ14"], "时限终点与运输到达保证，不能仅回答可否邮寄。"),
    ("我正在为去年已受理的群众补打一份依据说明，系统现在搜到的是2026最新时限解读。能直接把最新15个工作日写成去年办理时已经适用的规则吗？", "stop",
     "不能把较新说明自动追溯为过去申请的适用依据。应查当时已核定的历史版本、政策施行及过渡关系；没有历史依据时停止确定结论。",
     [("D26","正文段落1"),("D24","正文段落1")], "历史受理日期及当时已核定版本", ["KQ20","KQ21"], "补打历史依据的追溯适用，不是未来新规是否适用于当前的原题改写。"),
    ("我第一次领证没交工本费，这次是成年后的到期换领。首次申领停征条款是否让我这次仍免费，还是说换领一律按40元？", "answer",
     "区分首次申领停征、普通换领和遗失补领或损坏换领。2007原文列20/40的不同分支，2018第一条只停征首次申领；不由此承诺本次无条件免费或一律40元，现行减免另核。",
     [("F07","正文段落4"),("F18","正文段落4")], "现行减免与地方收费执行关系", ["KQ12"], "首次免费经历与再次到期、损坏收费分支的组合判断。"),
    ("内部收费表把20元、40元和10元都写成居民身份证法第二十一条直接规定的金额，并只引用这一条。法律原文与主管部门收费文件在金额出处上应怎样分别标注？", "answer",
     "法律第21条规定工本费及主管部门核定标准，并未直接列20、40、10的金额。金额应绑定具体收费文件的对应分支，再核对2018首次申领停征及现行关系，不能将部门金额文字伪装为法律条文的直接引文。",

def collect_questions(value, result):
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        for key,item in value.items():
            if key == "question" and isinstance(item,str):result[question_fingerprint(item)] = item
            else:collect_questions(item,result)
    elif isinstance(value,list):
        for item in value:collect_questions(item,result)
