"""Retain three inspected official corroborating originals, outside pilot answers.

This one-time, fingerprint-bound intake uses earlier normal Fetcher receipts. It
does not add a general spreadsheet parser or a second monitoring mechanism.
"""

import argparse
import json
import re
import unicodedata
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from zipfile import ZipFile

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import IndexLinks, allowed_url, validate_config
from gov_mcp.knowledge_pdf import extract_document
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


SPECS = {
    "HN-NORM-XICHUAN-PDF": {
        "url": "https://www.xichuan.gov.cn/ifile/20251229/1766973939411PxhOsju6.pdf",
        "file": "henan-norm.pdf", "sha256": "fbb7d6383dc63131fa70cbacac85b6585cb9827a15c806533abf22176d1f5b9c",
        "probe": "HN-NORM-XICHUAN-PROBE", "receipt": "probe-results.json",
        "label": "河南户口居民身份证规范2022通知原件：淅川政府公开副本",
        "reason": "保留文件身份及第159、236条对照证据。已有省厅正文来源承担监测；本副本只选3页，不自动采集64页户口业务，不据官方副本存在核定2026年现行效力。",
    },
    "HN-FEE-CATALOG-PAGE-2025": {
        "url": "https://czt.henan.gov.cn/2025/12-30/3280093.html",
        "file": "fee-dec2025.html", "sha256": "a74116dd13b8a1f88fc51c6bc59563eb1790f0d2e47d5cd350845a08024b5ab5",
        "probe": "HN-FEE-DEC2025-PROBE", "receipt": "fee-dec2025-result.json",
        "label": "河南财政厅行政事业性收费目录附件入口",
        "reason": "目录附件来源链留档。页面显示日期、元数据与URL目录日期分别保留，不把目录更新当作收费政策施行日；不将整站目录或附件标题作为业务答案。",
    },
    "HN-FEE-CATALOG-XLSX-2025": {
        "url": "https://xcoss.henan.gov.cn/typtfile/20250318/fdace0fca875409fa1338179dd218530.xlsx",
        "file": "henan-fee-catalog.xlsx", "sha256": "4aaddf9c385df36a3c53bd964b803a5c6d7ecca5d186cb8aee96a0e7d6e9562c",
        "probe": "HN-FEE-WORKBOOK-PROBE", "receipt": "fee-workbook-result.json",
        "label": "河南财政厅目录附件：居民身份证收费行及表头",
        "reason": "仅保留目录标题、公安部门及收费行相关表头和原单元格值。收费标准列列文号而非金额；不能据此虚构20元单元格、目录有效期、现行减免证明或二七区额外收费。普通采集器尚未配置Excel自动解析，本附件不启用监测。",
    },
}
SHEET_NS = {"s": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}
CELL_SELECTION = ("A1", "D4", "E4", "F4", "G4", "B17", "D36", "E36", "F36", "G36")


def compact(text):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text))


def workbook_cells(path):
    """Read exact selected literal string cells of this pinned, inspected XLSX."""
    with ZipFile(path) as z:
        if any(i.file_size > 5 * 1024 * 1024 for i in z.infolist()) or sum(i.file_size for i in z.infolist()) > 20 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise ValueError("Unexpected oversized workbook members")
        book = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
        sheet = book.find("s:sheets/s:sheet", SHEET_NS)
        relationship = sheet.attrib["{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"]
        links = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
        target = next(e.attrib["Target"] for e in links if e.attrib["Id"] == relationship)
        if sheet.attrib["name"] != "行政事业性收费" or target not in ("worksheets/sheet1.xml", "/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"):
            raise ValueError("Inspected worksheet relationship changed")
        strings = ["".join(n.itertext()) for n in ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml")).findall("s:si", SHEET_NS)]
        values = {}
        for cell in ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml")).findall(".//s:c", SHEET_NS):
            if cell.attrib["r"] not in CELL_SELECTION:
                continue
            if cell.attrib.get("t") != "s" or cell.find("s:f", SHEET_NS) is not None:
                raise ValueError("Expected original literal string cell")
            values[cell.attrib["r"]] = strings[int(cell.find("s:v", SHEET_NS).text)]
    if set(values) != set(CELL_SELECTION):
        raise ValueError("Missing inspected cells")
    return [{"locator": "Excel工作表行政事业性收费!"+cell, "category": "fee", "text": values[cell]} for cell in CELL_SELECTION]


def selected_chunks(source_id, path):
    if source_id == "HN-NORM-XICHUAN-PDF":
        parsed = extract_document(path)
        if len(parsed["chunks"]) != 64:
            raise ValueError("Inspected 64-page document required")
        return [parsed["chunks"][i-1] for i in (1, 45, 64)]
    if source_id == "HN-FEE-CATALOG-XLSX-2025":
        return workbook_cells(path)
    parser = IndexLinks()
    parser.feed(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    selected = [title for href, title in parser.links if href == SPECS["HN-FEE-CATALOG-XLSX-2025"]["url"]]
    if selected != ["河南省执行的全国性中央部门和单位行政事业性收费目录清单.xlsx"]:
        raise ValueError("Inspected directory attachment changed")
    return [{"locator": "目录正文附件链接标题", "category": "fee", "text": selected[0]}]


def anchor(db, source_id, revision, ordinal):
    row = db.execute("SELECT locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? AND ordinal=?", (revision, ordinal)).fetchone()
    return {"source_id": source_id, "revision": revision, "chunk_ordinal": ordinal, "locator": row["locator"],
            "start": 0, "end": len(row["text"]), "text_sha256": fingerprint(row["text"].encode()),
            "span_sha256": fingerprint(row["text"].encode())}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="保存已正常取得并检查的官方对照原件；不发布知识")
    parser.add_argument("--research-directory", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    research = args.research_directory.resolve()
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update")
    probe = KnowledgeStore(research / "probe", read_only=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    records = {}
    for source_id, spec in SPECS.items():
        path = research / spec["file"]
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        receipt = json.loads((research / spec["receipt"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if isinstance(receipt, list):
            receipt = next(r for r in receipt if r["source_id"] == spec["probe"])
        with probe.db() as db:
            config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (spec["probe"],)).fetchone()[0])
        validate_config(config)
        allowed_url(config, spec["url"])
        if (fingerprint(raw) != spec["sha256"] or receipt.get("sha256") != spec["sha256"]
                or receipt.get("status", receipt.get("http_status")) != 200 or receipt["url"] != spec["url"]
                or receipt["final_url"] != spec["url"] or config["seeds"] != [spec["url"]]):
            raise ValueError("Normal acquisition receipt or inspected original differs")
        chunks = selected_chunks(source_id, path)
        with store.db() as db:
            current = db.execute("SELECT r.* FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (source_id,)).fetchone()
        if current:
            if current["sha256"] != spec["sha256"] or current["state"] != "excluded":
                raise ValueError("Existing reference changed; separate review required")
            revision = current["id"]
        else:
            config.update(id=source_id, label=spec["label"], enabled=False, discover_links=False, page_kind="document")
            metadata = {"title": spec["label"], "region": "unknown", "matter": "unclassified",
                "document_type": "official_corroborating_reference", "collection_role": "governance_reference",
                "effective_from": None, "effective_to": None, "published_at": None, "scope_confirmed": False,
                "business_review": "not_a_pilot_release", "human_review_completed": False,
                "usage_basis": config["metadata"]["usage_basis"], "selected_content_scope": spec["reason"],
                "source_observation": {"schema": 1, "original_sha256": spec["sha256"], "normal_fetcher_receipt": True}}
            if source_id == "HN-NORM-XICHUAN-PDF":
                metadata.update(document_number="豫公通〔2022〕77号", document_signed_at="2022-07-27",
                    extraction_method="pdf_text_layer_selected_complete_pages_1_45_64",
                    selected_pages_visually_checked_by="Codex AI", pages_not_visually_checked=61)
                metadata["source_observation"]["document_stated_start"] = "2022-09-01"
            elif source_id == "HN-FEE-CATALOG-XLSX-2025":
                metadata.update(extraction_method="exact_selected_literal_xlsx_cells_no_formula_evaluation", discovered_from=SPECS["HN-FEE-CATALOG-PAGE-2025"]["url"])
            else:
                metadata.update(extraction_method="exact_official_attachment_link_title")
                metadata["source_observation"].update(displayed_page_date="2025-12-01", meta_pubdate="2025-12-01 17:06:05.0", meta_lastmodified="2025-12-30 17:07", url_directory_date="2025-12-30")
            config["metadata"] = metadata
            store.register(config)
            revision = store.ingest(source_id, spec["url"], raw, metadata, chunks)
            revision = store.exclude(revision, "Codex AI source identity and fee-reference analysis", spec["reason"], confirmed=True)
        store.propose_classification(revision)
        records[source_id] = {"revision": revision, "original_sha256": spec["sha256"], "url": spec["url"],
            "selected_chunks": len(chunks), "state": "excluded", "automatic_monitoring_enabled": False,
            "normal_fetcher_acquisition": True, "scope": spec["reason"]}
    with store.db() as db:
        for source_id in ("MOF-FEE-2007", "MOF-FIRST-ISSUE-2018", "HN-NORM-PUBLISHER"):
            row = db.execute("SELECT r.*,d.url FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (source_id,)).fetchone()
            store._verify(db, row["id"], require_review=False)
            records[source_id] = {"revision": row["id"], "original_sha256": row["sha256"], "url": row["url"], "state": row["state"]}
        norm_id = records["HN-NORM-XICHUAN-PDF"]["revision"]
        norm_text = db.execute("SELECT text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? AND ordinal=1", (norm_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        original_159 = re.search(r"第一百五十九条.*?(?=第一百六十条)", norm_text, re.S).group()
        publisher_159 = db.execute("SELECT text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? AND locator='第一百五十九条'", (records["HN-NORM-PUBLISHER"]["revision"],)).fetchone()[0]
        if compact(original_159) != compact(publisher_159):
            raise ValueError("Article 159 text differs after NFKC and whitespace comparison")
        facts = [
            ("norm_identity", "原件首页文号豫公通〔2022〕77号，盖章日期2022-07-27；不以2025路径判断发文时间。", [("HN-NORM-XICHUAN-PDF", 0)]),
            ("renewal_branch_corroborated", "原件第45页完整第159条与省厅HTML第159条经NFKC及去空白对照一致，未修改任何原文。", [("HN-NORM-XICHUAN-PDF", 1), ("HN-NORM-PUBLISHER", 5)]),
            ("commencement_not_current_validity", "原件末页载2022-09-01施行及2022-07-27印发；未取得现行效力或延期依据，不能设定两年失效。", [("HN-NORM-XICHUAN-PDF", 2)]),
            ("directory_attachment_chain", "河南财政厅目录入口直接链接本Excel原件；显示日和元数据/URL日期不一致，目录无另行核定施行日。", [("HN-FEE-CATALOG-PAGE-2025", 0)]),
            ("directory_fee_references", "目录身份证行F36/G36引用财综〔2007〕34号和财税〔2018〕37号；G36没有金额。", [("HN-FEE-CATALOG-XLSX-2025", 6), ("HN-FEE-CATALOG-XLSX-2025", 8), ("HN-FEE-CATALOG-XLSX-2025", 9)]),
            ("historical_fee_branches", "2007通知第一条分别载换领20、遗失补领/损坏换领40、临时证10元；其中首次申领收费须另读2018条款。", [("MOF-FEE-2007", 1)]),
            ("first_issue_boundary", "2018第一条自2018-04-01停征首次申领工本费，不能扩大为到期换领、遗失补领或损坏换领免费。", [("MOF-FIRST-ISSUE-2018", 0)]),
            ("extra_charge_limits", "2007通知禁止违规收费；自愿邮寄服务与该通知用语及后来措施的关系仍须分别核查，未宣称所有邮费均免费或均应收取。", [("MOF-FEE-2007", 1), ("MOF-FEE-2007", 2), ("MOF-FEE-2007", 3)]),
        ]
        findings = [{"id": key, "finding": text, "business_approval": False,
            "anchors": [anchor(db, source, records[source]["revision"], ordinal) for source, ordinal in refs]} for key, text, refs in facts]
        configs = [json.loads(r[0]) for r in db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites ORDER BY id")]
    (store.root / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": configs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    images = {str(n): fingerprint((research / f"norm-page-{n}.png").read_bytes()) for n in (1, 45, 64)}
    assessment = {"schema": 1, "captured_at": stamp, "reviewer_kind": "ai", "reviewer": "Codex AI",
        "human_review_completed": False, "business_release_ready": False, "current_erqi_applicability": "not_established",
        "sources": records, "findings": findings, "norm_pdf": {"pages": 64, "pages_visually_inspected": [1,45,64],
            "rendered_page_sha256": images, "original_not_edited": True, "text_layer_artifacts_not_repaired": True},
        "first_2018_tax_site_access": {"url": "https://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201804/t20180416_2868702.htm",
            "stopped": "robots redirected outside approved origin to http://www.mof.gov.cn/404.htm; body not acquired, no policy bypass", "gazette_source_separately_checked": True},
        "remaining": ["现行二七区材料组合及材料关系", "河南试行规范现行效力及六个月调整依据", "当前减免证明及自愿邮费规则", "独立30题评测与正式两端发布验收"],
        "policy_file_sha256": fingerprint((store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()),
        "preserved_development_files": json.loads((ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/material-branch-assessments.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["preserved_development_files"]}
    assessment["assessment_sha256"] = fingerprint(assessment)
    output = ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/fee-norm-identity-assessments.json"
    output.write_text(json.dumps(assessment, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"reference_originals": len(SPECS), "findings": len(findings), "counts": store.status()["counts"], "business_release_ready": False}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Archive two manually inspected scans as AI transcriptions, excluded from pilot answers.

No OCR/text-layer claim, human attestation, current-validity decision or automatic
PDF monitoring is manufactured. All 18 rendered pages were inspected on this run.
"""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from intake_henan_sources import TARGETS


FINDINGS = {
    "validity-pdf": {"sha256": "f6a32e4bf55d2148b498bd00c3451912d1405bc3ca72566dc356e7fca4afbe51", "pages": 16,
        "number": "豫公通〔2019〕141号", "signed_at": "2019-06-16", "locator": "PDF第1页（AI视觉转录）",
        "text": "各省辖市公安局、厅直有关单位：\n按照省政府关于规范性文件管理的有关规定及要求，近期，省公安厅对73件行政规范性文件进行了清理，决定继续有效50件，废止23件，现予以公布。决定废止的行政规范性文件自公布之日起废止。\n附件：1.继续有效的行政规范性文件目录\n2.废止的行政规范性文件目录",
        "parent": "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2025/10-21/3237047.html",
        "reason": "AI逐页检查16页扫描件，通知文号和盖章日期为2019年，不是2025年作出的现行效力清理。不能用它核定2022年出台规范在2026年的效力。作为历史沿革留档，排除本试点正式回答；目录页日期与文件日期分别保留。",
        "facts": {"continued_valid_count_at_issue": 50, "repealed_count_at_issue": 23, "listed_items_end_at_year": 2018}},
    "repeal-pdf": {"sha256": "20f76fbc3bfe78bfd205e415879c15a5185ce3d07ad0e20f4114835a5f77f603", "pages": 2,
        "number": "豫公通〔2022〕86号", "signed_at": "2022-08-02", "locator": "PDF第1至2页（AI视觉转录）",
        "text": "各省辖市公安局、济源产城融合示范区公安局：\n依据《河南省行政规范性文件管理办法》（省政府令〔2015〕169号），按照行政规范性文件动态清理和清理兜底要求，经审查研究，省公安厅部分文件已不适应当前全面深化改革和治安、网安等工作需要，现决定对以下文件予以废止，废止文件自即日起不再执行。\n1.河南省公安厅关于印发《河南省公共娱乐服务场所治安监督管理规定》的通知（豫公通〔2002〕465号）\n2.河南省公安厅关于贯彻落实《公安部加强自行车安全管理工作的通知》的通知（豫公通〔2008〕14号）\n3.河南省公安厅关于印发《河南省公安机关网安系统行政执法裁量标准（修订）》（豫公通〔2014〕23号）",
        "parent": "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2025/10-21/3237046.html",
        "reason": "AI检查2页扫描件，正文为2022年8月2日的3件文件废止通知，涉及娱乐场所、自行车安全和网安执法裁量，不是2025年新作决定，也未列本试点2022户口居民身份证规范。排除本试点正式回答，仅留沿革证据；不据此反推其他文件全部有效。",
        "facts": {"repealed_document_numbers": ["豫公通〔2002〕465号", "豫公通〔2008〕14号", "豫公通〔2014〕23号"]}},
}

HTML_EXCLUSIONS = {
    "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2022/03-18/2417195.html": "已逐段检查20段正文，十项措施涉及新生儿入户、无犯罪记录、保安/金融许可、外国人居留、交通和平台服务，未提供本试点到期换领规则。不能把其他业务时限/材料移作身份证要求。",
    "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2025/05-08/3155683.html": "已检查8段全文，废止5件文件涉及特种行业、娱乐场所、民爆、交通代收和交通事故，无本试点规范。排除试点问答，但继续监测该通知页面变化。",
    "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2026/01-22/3312600.html": "已检查14段全文，修改保安服务登记及2021便民措施的旅馆业许可项，废止旅馆治安信息系统通知。未修改本试点居民身份证条款；不能因名称泛化判定所有便民措施或身份证规范已废止。",
}
INSPECTED_HTML_SHA256 = {
    "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2022/03-18/2417195.html": "a56c6128bafa7fb75e8486ceb6f234f58fcc222056a35d141a9e43e51c6ddfae",
    "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2025/05-08/3155683.html": "45aaa93c4aaaf8cfa6bc62284a751b6a4dfcd754e21064f94a56cdd2d9981c9c",
    "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2026/01-22/3312600.html": "e10b1eda14a0c3a9a105c40da88eae25a802d7bafc87cd9a948e9b4eea00677b",
    "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2025/10-21/3237046.html": "40fb56ed8ca0d01e8af060f698ff1bda046907b6d3db5eac8707d3985558c68f",
    "https://hnga.henan.gov.cn/2025/10-21/3237047.html": "56a9ac6c631485da5700e39f7c000e8c0680966f0203d9d72a9273a06efb0291",
}


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update")
    records = []
    for key, finding in FINDINGS.items():
        target = TARGETS[key]
        intake = json.loads((ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update" / target["report"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        raw = (store.root / "intake-2026-10-16" / target["archive"]).read_bytes()
        if fingerprint(raw) != finding["sha256"] or intake["raw_sha256"] != finding["sha256"] or not intake["body_acquired"]:
            raise ValueError("Inspected PDF fingerprint differs")
        with store.db() as db:
            config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (target["id"],)).fetchone()[0])
            existing = db.execute("SELECT r.id,r.sha256,r.state FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (target["id"],)).fetchone()
        if config["enabled"] or config["seeds"] != [intake["url"]]:
            raise ValueError("Expected disabled exact-attachment source required")
        if existing:
            if existing["sha256"] != finding["sha256"] or existing["state"] != "excluded":
                raise ValueError("Existing attachment requires separate review; will not overwrite it")
            revision = existing["id"]
        else:
            config["label"] = target["label"]
            config["metadata"].update(title=target["label"], region="unknown", matter="unclassified", scope_confirmed=False,
                document_number=finding["number"], document_signed_at=finding["signed_at"], collection_role="governance_reference",
                extraction_method="ai_visual_transcription", text_layer_available=False, human_review_completed=False,
                selected_content_scope=finding["locator"]+"；通知正文视觉转录，目录全部项目未转录；原PDF完整保存",
                source_observation={"schema": 1, "media_type": "application/pdf", "raw_sha256": finding["sha256"],
                    "parent_page_observed_date": "2025-10-21", "document_signed_at": finding["signed_at"], "date_mismatch": True},
                discovered_from=finding["parent"])
            store.register(config)
            revision = store.ingest(target["id"], intake["url"], raw, config["metadata"],
                [{"locator": finding["locator"], "category": "procedure", "text": finding["text"]}])
            revision = store.exclude(revision, "Codex AI visual source analysis", finding["reason"], confirmed=True)
        records.append({"source_id": target["id"], "url": intake["url"], "revision": revision,
            "raw_sha256": finding["sha256"], "pages_rendered_and_visually_inspected": list(range(1, finding["pages"]+1)),
            "rendered_page_hashes": {p.name: fingerprint(p.read_bytes()) for p in (store.root / "intake-2026-10-16" / ("validity-pages" if key == "validity-pdf" else "repeal-pages")).glob("*.png")},
            "document_number": finding["number"], "document_signed_at": finding["signed_at"],
            "text_layer_available": False, "transcription_author_kind": "ai", "human_attestation_created": False,
            "finding": finding["reason"], "facts": finding["facts"], "automatic_attachment_monitoring_enabled": False})
    for url, reason in dict(HTML_EXCLUSIONS, **{finding["parent"]: finding["reason"] for finding in FINDINGS.values()}).items():
        with store.db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT r.id,r.state,r.sha256 FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id='HN-POLICY-DISCOVERY' AND d.url=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (url,)).fetchone()
        if not row or row["sha256"] != INSPECTED_HTML_SHA256[url]:
            raise ValueError("Directory candidate changed since inspection; do not reuse its old scope exclusion")
        if row["state"] != "excluded":
            store.exclude(row["id"], "Codex AI source-scope analysis", reason, confirmed=True)
    with store.db() as db:
        configs = [json.loads(row[0]) for row in db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites ORDER BY id")]
    (store.root / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": configs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "author_kind": "ai", "records": records,
        "html_scope_exclusions": HTML_EXCLUSIONS, "counts": store.status()["counts"], "business_publication_approved": False,
        "note": "Page/storage dates are not document issue dates. Historical exclusions do not certify that every other instrument remains valid. Scans are retained with explicit AI visual transcription provenance, not automatic OCR or human approval."}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/henan-visual-source-check.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"scan_archives": len(records), "pages_visually_inspected": sum(len(r["pages_rendered_and_visually_inspected"]) for r in records),
        "html_candidates_excluded_from_pilot": 5, "counts": report["counts"], "human_attestations_created": 0}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Export verified latest-revision summaries; policy review remains separate."""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore
from gov_mcp.knowledge_impact import duplicate_candidates, revision_impact


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    with store.db() as db:
        rows = [dict(row) for row in db.execute("SELECT d.site_id,r.id FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE r.rowid IN (SELECT MAX(rowid) FROM revisions GROUP BY document_id) ORDER BY d.site_id")]
    records = [dict(revision_impact(store, row["id"]), source_id=row["site_id"]) for row in rows]
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "records": records,
              "possible_duplicates": duplicate_candidates(store), "business_review_completed": False,
              "scope": "Actual archived candidate differences and potential mirror signals; no policy effectivity decision or automatic consolidation"}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/revision-impacts.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"records": len(records), "metadata_deltas": sum("metadata_change" in record["change_kinds"] for record in records),
                      "duplicate_groups": len(report["possible_duplicates"]["groups"]), "publications_changed": False}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Record real maintenance state and whether an unchanged later tick stayed quiet."""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    status = store.status()
    state = status["maintenance"]
    with store.db() as db:
        changed_events = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit WHERE action='maintenance_state_changed'").fetchone()[0]
    sample = {"last_checked": state["last_checked"], "signal": state["signal"], "change_event_count": changed_events}
    baseline_path = store.root / "maintenance-observation-baseline.json"
    if baseline_path.exists():
        baseline = json.loads(baseline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    else:
        baseline = sample
        baseline_path.write_text(json.dumps(baseline, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    elapsed = sample["last_checked"]-baseline["last_checked"]
    quiet = (sample["change_event_count"] == baseline["change_event_count"]) if elapsed >= 60 and sample["signal"] == baseline["signal"] else None
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "backup_day": state.get("backup_day"),
        "restore_week": state.get("restore_week"), "last_backup": state.get("last_backup"),
        "last_restore": state.get("last_restore"), "current_alerts": state.get("alerts"),
        "workers": [{"id": row["id"], "stale": row["stale"], "progress": row["progress"]} for row in status["workers"]],
        "baseline_sample": baseline, "latest_sample": sample, "elapsed_between_maintenance_ticks_seconds": elapsed,
        "unchanged_state_kept_quiet": quiet, "natural_full_week_observed": False,
        "scope": "First real backup/recovery run and bounded unchanged-state observation; not a long-term unattended or production-deployment acceptance"}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/maintenance-first-run.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"backup_day": report["backup_day"], "restore_week": report["restore_week"],
                      "observed_tick_gap_seconds": elapsed, "unchanged_state_kept_quiet": quiet}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Record actual browser maintenance denial and match each response to service audit."""

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from nexent_api import NexentAPI, ROOT, RUNTIME


def main():
    proc = subprocess.run([shutil.which("npx.cmd") or "npx", "--yes", "--package", "@playwright/cli", "playwright-cli",
        "-s=workbench", "run-code", "--filename", "scripts/m1_citizen_maintenance.js"], cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=60)
    if proc.returncode or "### Error" in proc.stdout:
        print(proc.stdout)
        raise RuntimeError("Actual browser maintenance operations failed")
    value = json.loads(proc.stdout.split("### Result", 1)[1].split("###", 1)[0].strip())
    assert value["passed"]
    api = NexentAPI()
    try:
        user = api.login(json.loads((RUNTIME / "m1/accounts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["fresh_citizen"])
    finally:
        api.close()
    principal = hashlib.sha256(f"{user['tenant_id']}\0{user['user_id']}".encode()).hexdigest()
    entries = [json.loads(line) for line in (RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/tool-audit.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    index = {a["request_id"]: a for a in entries}
    for entry in value["trace"]:
        entry["audit"] = index[entry["result"]["data"]["request_id"]]
        assert entry["audit"]["principal_sha256"] == principal and entry["audit"]["result"] == entry["result"]
        entry["screenshot_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256((ROOT / entry["screenshot"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    value.update(captured_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), source="agent-operated real workbench UI", principal_sha256=principal)
    (ROOT / "evidence/m1-citizen-maintenance-ui.json").write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print("BT11 browser: citizen prepare/publish denied; screenshots and actual response/audit IDs matched.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Archive/assess a completed native UI trace against actual govx tool audits."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from m1_assessment import assess_m1
from verify_native_faults import root_final
from nexent_api import NexentAPI, ROOT, RUNTIME


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--conversation", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--screenshot", default="output/playwright/m1-BT03.png")
    parser.add_argument("--trace-dir", type=Path, default=RUNTIME / "m1/ui-traces")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / "evidence/m1-native-ui-citizen.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    trace_dir = args.trace_dir.resolve()
    output_path = args.output.resolve()
    if not trace_dir.is_relative_to(RUNTIME / "m1") or not output_path.is_relative_to(ROOT / "evidence"):
        raise ValueError("Private M1 trace directory and public evidence output required")
    trace_path = trace_dir / f"conversation-{args.conversation}.json"
    trace = json.loads(trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert trace["conversation_id"] == args.conversation
    screenshot = (ROOT / args.screenshot).resolve()
    if not screenshot.is_relative_to(ROOT / "output/playwright") or not screenshot.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Actual screenshot required within output/playwright")
    api = NexentAPI()
    try:
        user = api.login(json.loads((RUNTIME / "m1/accounts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["fresh_citizen"])
    finally:
        api.close()

"""Validate and record user-operated native UI screenshots and real SSE traces."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.acceptance import assess
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--role", choices=("developer", "citizen", "staff"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--screenshot", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--trace", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark", required=True, help="The evidence/native-* directory name")
    parser.add_argument("--operator", choices=("user", "agent"), default="user",
                        help="Record actual UI operator; agent use requires prior user authorization")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    summary_path = ROOT / "evidence" / args.benchmark / "summary.json"
    if summary_path.parent.parent != ROOT / "evidence" or not args.benchmark.startswith("native-"):
        raise ValueError("Benchmark must be an evidence/native-* directory")
    summary = json.loads(summary_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not summary.get("core_chain_accepted"):
        raise ValueError("Complete the core benchmark before recording UI acceptance")
    screenshot = args.screenshot.read_bytes()
    if not (screenshot.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n') or screenshot.startswith(b'\xff\xd8\xff')):
        raise ValueError("A real PNG or JPEG screenshot is required")
    trace = json.loads(args.trace.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    ephemeral_debug = (args.role == "developer" and trace.get("is_debug") is True
                       and trace.get("conversation_id") is None)
    expected_keys = {"conversation_id", "events", "is_debug"} if ephemeral_debug else {"conversation_id", "events"}
    if set(trace) != expected_keys or (not ephemeral_debug and (
            not isinstance(trace["conversation_id"], int) or isinstance(trace["conversation_id"], bool)
            or trace["conversation_id"] <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("Trace must identify a real conversation or an explicit ephemeral developer debug run")
    state = json.loads((RUNTIME / "nexent-state.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    principal = hashlib.sha256(f"{state['tenant_id']}\0{state['accounts'][args.role]['user_id']}".encode()).hexdigest()
    role = "staff" if args.role == "staff" else "citizen"
    finals = [e["content"] for e in trace["events"] if e.get("type") == "final_answer" and not e.get("depth", 0)]
    final = finals[0] if len(finals) == 1 and isinstance(finals[0], dict) else json.loads("".join(finals))
    request_id = final["data"]["request_id"]
    audit = [json.loads(line) for line in (RUNTIME / "mcp/tool-audit.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]
    matches = [i for i, row in enumerate(audit) if row.get("request_id") == request_id]
    if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0] < 1:
        raise ValueError("UI final answer is not correlated to the actual tool audit")
    actual = audit[matches[0]-1:matches[0]+1]
    assessment = assess(trace["events"], actual, role, principal,
                        child_id=state["agents"]["staff_assistant" if role == "staff" else "citizen_assistant"])
    if not assessment["passed"]:
        raise ValueError("UI trace failed: " + ", ".join(assessment["stop_reasons"]))
    if args.operator == "user" and input("确认已用该账号在原生界面完成本次操作、截图对应本会话。输入 VERIFIED：").strip() != "VERIFIED":
        raise SystemExit("UI acceptance was not confirmed; no receipt saved.")
    dest = ROOT / "evidence/native-ui" / args.benchmark
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    image_file = dest / (args.role + args.screenshot.suffix.lower())
    trace_file = dest / (args.role + "-trace.json")
    if args.screenshot.resolve() != image_file.resolve():
        shutil.copyfile(args.screenshot, image_file)
    trace_file.write_text(json.dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    path = ROOT / "evidence/native-ui.json"
    report = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else {}
    if report.get("benchmark_reference") != args.benchmark:
        report = {"benchmark_reference": args.benchmark, "records": {}}
    report["records"][args.role] = {"passed": True, "source": args.operator + "-operated native UI",
        "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "conversation_id": trace["conversation_id"],
        "screenshot": image_file.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "screenshot_sha256": hashlib.sha256(screenshot).hexdigest(),
        "trace": trace_file.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "trace_sha256": hashlib.sha256(trace_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    if ephemeral_debug:
        report["records"][args.role].update(run_mode="debug", debug_request_id=request_id)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(args.role, "UI evidence recorded.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Export source-only receipts and compact traces, without HTTP or model calls."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'src'))
from gov_mcp.regional_preview import read, write, source_digest, check_context, SCENARIOS

RUNTIME = ROOT / '.runtime/regional-native-preview'
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'evidence/regional-native-preview'


def main():
    reports = [(p, read(p)) for p in sorted(OUTPUT.glob('20*.json'))]
    traces = []
    for path, report in reports:
        events = read(RUNTIME / (path.stem + '-events.json'))
        tools = [{'event_index': index, 'name': e.get('tool_name'), 'depth': e.get('depth', 0)}
                 for index, e in enumerate(events) if e.get('type') == 'tool']
        steps = []
        for e in events:
            if e.get('type') == 'token_count':
                value = json.loads(e['content'])
                steps.append({k: value.get(k) for k in ('step_number', 'step_input_tokens', 'step_output_tokens',
                             'output_finish_reason', 'compression_calls')} | {'depth': e.get('depth', 0)})
        traces.append({'evidence': path.name, 'scenario_id': report['scenario_id'], 'run_id': report['run_id'],
            'passed_at_execution': report['passed'], 'stop_reasons': report.get('stop_reasons'),
            'duration_ms': report['duration_ms'], 'tools': tools, 'observed_usage_steps': steps,
            'child_starts': sum(e.get('type') == 'subagent_start' for e in events),
            'contains_unexecuted_dsml': any('DSML' in str(e.get('content', '')) for e in events if e.get('type') == 'final_answer'),
            'action_source': [{'depth': e.get('depth', 0), 'code': e.get('content')} for e in events if e.get('type') == 'parse'],
            'usage_scope': 'Observed native token_count events; child model usage may be missing, not total model cost',
            'execution_source_sha256': report.get('source_sha256')})
    write(OUTPUT / 'trace-summary.json', traces)
    with sqlite3.connect((RUNTIME / 'preview.sqlite3').as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True) as db:
        runs = [{'ordinal': r[0], 'status': r[1], 'scenario_id': r[2], 'repair_note': r[3]}
                for r in db.execute('SELECT ordinal,status,scenario_id,repair_note FROM runs JOIN scenario_runs ON id=run_id ORDER BY ordinal')]
        tasks = [json.loads(r[0]) for r in db.execute('SELECT payload FROM tasks')]
        flags = dict(db.execute('SELECT name,value FROM flags'))
        reserved = db.execute("SELECT value FROM counters WHERE name='jev_reserved'").fetchone()[0]
    receipts = []
    contexts, _, _ = check_context(RUNTIME)
    for task in tasks:
        identifier = task['scenario_id']
        path = RUNTIME / (task['task_id'] + '-jev.json')
        if path.exists():
            record = read(path)
            write(OUTPUT / (identifier + '-verification-input-output.json'), record)
            english = record.get('english_input') or (record.get('result') or {}).get('english_input')
            receipts.append({'scenario_id': identifier, 'task_id': task['task_id'],
                             'jev_receipts': record['jev_receipts'], 'translation_receipts': record['translation_receipts'],
                             'full_english_input_saved': bool(english)})
        if task['answer']:
            write(OUTPUT / (identifier + '-result.json'), task['answer'])
        elif task['facts']:
            write(OUTPUT / (identifier + '-unverified-source-facts.json'), {
                'task_id': task['task_id'], 'scenario_id': identifier, 'status': 'not_verified',
                'error_code': task.get('error_code'), 'source_facts': task['facts'],
                'source_context': contexts[identifier], 'published': False, 'formal_approval': False})
    baseline = read(RUNTIME / 'baseline.json')
    preserved = {}
    for name, item in baseline.items():
        filename = 'preview.sqlite3' if name == 'public-native-preview' else 'knowledge.sqlite3'
        path = ROOT / '.runtime' / name / filename
        preserved[name] = source_digest(path.read_bytes()) == item['database_sha256']
    native = read(RUNTIME / 'native-drafts.json')
    summary = {'status': 'PARTIAL_BLOCKED', 'scenarios': {
            key: {'question': spec['question'], 'passed': flags.get('passed:' + key) == 'true'}
            for key, spec in SCENARIOS.items()}, 'native_runs': runs, 'native_run_budget': 3,
        'jev_reserved': reserved, 'jev_physical_attempts': sum(len(r['jev_receipts']) for r in receipts),
        'successful_jev_responses': sum(r.get('http_status') == 200 for item in receipts for r in item['jev_receipts']),
        'external_block': flags.get('external_block'), 'no_additional_live_requests_permitted': True,
        'receipts': receipts, 'old_databases_unchanged': preserved, 'agents': native['agents'],
        'old_agent_signatures_preserved_during_each_run': True, 'drafts_disabled_unpublished': True,
        'final_code_sha256': {p: source_digest((ROOT / p).read_bytes()) for p in (
            'src/gov_mcp/regional_preview.py', 'src/gov_mcp/regional_preview_server.py',
            'scripts/provision_regional_native_preview.py', 'scripts/verify_regional_native_preview.py',
            'config/skills/govkb-regional-preview/SKILL.md', 'tests/test_regional_native_preview.py')},
        'inference_during_export': 0, 'cost_amount': None, 'business_publication': False,
        'limitations': ['Beijing did not pass: transport failure without HTTP response or score.',

if __name__ == '__main__':

"""Bounded AI scope review of the observed metadata-only refresh, with offline replay.

No automatic future exclusion rule is installed. These ten inspected revisions
are individually pinned; changed bytes/body/fields require another review.
"""

import argparse
import copy
import json
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_attachments import discover_attachments
from gov_mcp.knowledge_backup import create_bundle, restore_bundle
from gov_mcp.knowledge_impact import revision_impact
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


REASONS = {
    "rev-060d2e3a458b69be7cd82fa2": "保安登记、旅馆许可及治安系统通知，不提供本试点到期换领条款",
    "rev-0a2cd4b66a6c6c1e5a0d6538": "2019年清理通知的已核原件入口，不能据此判定2022规范在2026年的效力",
    "rev-477237f4f11bb3b1e9180233": "2022年三件废止文件涉及娱乐场所、自行车和网安裁量，未列试点规范",
    "rev-b4e27a0baa07b04b2033aa5d": "五件废止文件涉及特行、民爆、交通等，不是本试点身份证条款",
    "rev-571462a796240be516bd509c": "十项措施涉及新生儿、记录证明、许可、外国人及交通等，未提供试点到期换领规则",
    "rev-542383b9685ff607d29b6ea2": "HTML只作已归档2021废止通知PDF入口，不充当重复正文；PDF范围判断保留",
    "rev-80b25a42abaf5893115d827d": "HTML只作2021便民措施PDF入口，正文另在待核PDF；不能推定该PDF当前全部适用",
    "rev-b816053b4ba69f8b83ebf63e": "HTML只作已归档2020废止通知PDF入口，不充当额外政策正文",
    "rev-6938de360787a1cf06a2b03e": "2020废止通知PDF仍未列试点规范；原OCR日期错误不修写，不反推其他文件全部有效",
    "rev-455ffba059929543e9bd3fe7": "2021废止通知PDF仍未列试点规范，文件日期与网页日期分开保留，未新增视觉核查声明",
}
ALLOWED_SCOPE_FIELDS = {"_excluded_after_revision", "selected_content_scope", "source_observation.fields.meta:lastmodifiedtime",
                        "source_observation.discovery_signal.hints.parent_revision"}
NORM = "rev-dfede4448f8bccedf15a59ec"


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def state(store):
    with store.db() as db:
        return {"latest": [list(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT document_id,id,state FROM revisions WHERE rowid IN (SELECT MAX(rowid) FROM revisions GROUP BY document_id) ORDER BY document_id")],
            "configs": fingerprint([list(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,config,paused_reason FROM sites ORDER BY id")]),
            "policy": fingerprint((store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()),
            "formal": {t: db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "+t).fetchone()[0] for t in ("reviews", "snapshot_evaluations", "versions", "heads")}}


def apply_plan(store, plan, expected=None):
    results = {}
    for case in plan["cases"]:
        with store.db() as db:
            row, _ = store._verify(db, case["revision"], require_review=False)
            latest = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            if expected and latest == expected[case["revision"]]:
                store._verify_exclusion(db, latest)
                decision = db.execute("SELECT reason FROM exclusions WHERE revision_id=?", (latest,)).fetchone()[0]
                if decision != case["reason"]:
                    raise ValueError("A different review decision already exists")
                results[case["revision"]] = latest
                continue
            if latest != row["id"] or row["sha256"] != case["original_sha256"] or row["body_sha256"] != case["body_sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("A pinned candidate changed during review")
        result = store.exclude(case["revision"], "Codex AI observation refresh review", case["reason"], confirmed=True)
        store.propose_classification(result)
        results[case["revision"]] = result
    norm = plan["norm"]
    with store.db() as db:
        row, _ = store._verify(db, norm["revision"], require_review=False)
        latest = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
    if expected and latest == expected[NORM]:
        with store.db() as db:
            current, _ = store._verify(db, latest, require_review=False)
            if json.loads(current["metadata"]) != norm["metadata"] or current["state"] != "pending_review":
                raise ValueError("The interpreted-date candidate was modified or approved")
        result = latest
    elif latest == NORM:
        result = store.amend(NORM, norm["metadata"])
        store.propose_classification(result)
    else:
        raise ValueError("The dated normative source changed during review")
    results[NORM] = result
    if expected and results != expected:
        raise ValueError("Actual review revisions differ from the inspected offline results")
    return results


def replay(store, plan, results):
    parents = [case for case in plan["cases"] if case["site_id"] == "HN-POLICY-DISCOVERY"]
    with store.db() as db:
        targets = {r[0] for case in parents for r in db.execute("SELECT target_site_id FROM attachment_edges WHERE parent_document_id=? AND target_site_id IS NOT NULL", (case["document_id"],))}
    def observation():
        with store.db() as db:
            return {"pdf_revisions": [list(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT d.site_id,r.id,r.state,r.metadata FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id ORDER BY r.rowid") if r[0] in targets],
                    "pdf_jobs": [list(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT site_id,url,state,attempts,error FROM jobs ORDER BY id") if r[0] in targets],
                    "success": [list(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,last_success FROM sites ORDER BY id") if r[0] in targets]}
    before = observation()
    with patch("socket.getaddrinfo", side_effect=AssertionError("No DNS during archived replay")) as dns, \
         patch("socket.create_connection", side_effect=AssertionError("No network during archived replay")) as network:
        for _ in range(2):
            for case in parents:
                with store.db() as db:
                    config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (case["site_id"],)).fetchone()[0])
                    row, _ = store._verify(db, results[case["revision"]], require_review=False)
                raw = (store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]).read_bytes()
                discover_attachments(store, config, row["id"], raw, time.time())
        external_calls = dns.call_count + network.call_count
    with store.db() as db:
        edges_current = all(all(r[0] == results[case["revision"]] for r in db.execute("SELECT parent_revision FROM attachment_edges WHERE parent_document_id=?", (case["document_id"],))) for case in parents)
    return {"rounds": 2, "html_parents": len(parents), "target_sources": sorted(targets), "external_calls": external_calls,
            "pdf_revisions_jobs_and_success_unchanged": before == observation(), "edges_keep_actual_review_revision": edges_current}


def prepare(store, research):
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    plan = {"schema": 1, "run_id": "observation-refresh-20261016-"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8], "prepared_at": stamp,
        "actor": {"kind": "ai", "name": "Codex AI"}, "human_review_completed": False,
        "before": state(store), "counts_before": store.status()["counts"], "cases": []}
    if any(plan["before"]["formal"].values()):
        raise ValueError("Inspect any formal review/publication before this bounded candidate review")
    with store.db() as db:
        if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE state='running'").fetchone():
            raise ValueError("Wait for the active acquisition job before capturing this plan")
        for revision, summary in REASONS.items():
            row, _ = store._verify(db, revision, require_review=False)
            previous = db.execute("SELECT * FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? AND rowid<(SELECT rowid FROM revisions WHERE id=?) ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"], revision)).fetchone()
            store._verify_exclusion(db, previous["id"])
            prior_reason = db.execute("SELECT reason FROM exclusions WHERE revision_id=?", (previous["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            document = db.execute("SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id=?", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()
            impact = revision_impact(store, revision)
            latest = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            if (row["state"] != "pending_review" or row["sha256"] != previous["sha256"] or row["body_sha256"] != previous["body_sha256"]
                    or not set(impact["changed_metadata_fields"]) <= ALLOWED_SCOPE_FIELDS
                    or latest != revision):
                raise ValueError("Candidate is outside the individually inspected metadata-only cohort")
            reason = summary+"。本次原件/正文指纹与旧排除修订"+previous["id"]+"相同，仅复核已列观察字段及内部提示；继续排除本试点答复，不判定整份文件现行效力。"
            plan["cases"].append({"revision": revision, "document_id": row["document_id"], "site_id": document["site_id"], "url": document["url"],
                "original_sha256": row["sha256"], "body_sha256": row["body_sha256"], "previous_exclusion": previous["id"],
                "previous_reason_sha256": fingerprint(prior_reason.encode()), "changed_metadata": impact["changed_metadata_fields"], "reason": reason})
        norm, _ = store._verify(db, NORM, require_review=False)
        old, _ = store._verify(db, "rev-30d1bf98f40e9acb897b37c1", require_review=False)
        if norm["sha256"] != old["sha256"] or norm["body_sha256"] != old["body_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The historical-date evidence changed")
        metadata, old_metadata = json.loads(norm["metadata"]), json.loads(old["metadata"])
        assessment = copy.deepcopy(old_metadata["source_fact_assessment"])
        body = {r["locator"]: r["text"] for r in db.execute("SELECT locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=?", (NORM,))}
        for fact in assessment["facts"]:
            evidence = fact["evidence"]
            if "locator" in evidence:
                if body[evidence["locator"]][evidence["start"]:evidence["end"]] != evidence["quote"]:
                    raise ValueError("A literal historical source fact no longer matches")
            else:
                if evidence["quote"] not in metadata["source_observation"]["fields"]["block:page_date"][0]:
                    raise ValueError("The observed historical page date differs")
                evidence["observation_sha256"] = fingerprint(metadata["source_observation"])
            evidence["revision"] = NORM
        if old_metadata["effective_from"] != "2022-09-01" or old_metadata["published_at"] != "2022-08-16":
            raise ValueError("Previously interpreted dates differ from this review")
        assessment.update(id="source-facts-observation-refresh-20261016-v2", assessed_at=stamp, base_revision=NORM,
                          revalidated_from_revision=old["id"], base_body_sha256=norm["body_sha256"])
        metadata.update(effective_from="2022-09-01", published_at="2022-08-16", source_fact_assessment=assessment,
                        business_review="pending_current_applicability")
        plan["norm"] = {"revision": NORM, "original_sha256": norm["sha256"], "body_sha256": norm["body_sha256"], "metadata": metadata,
            "basis": "Same original and body; all historical literal facts and current page-date observation rechecked. Source observations unchanged. Not current legal-effect approval."}
    preserved = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/material-branch-assessments.json")["preserved_development_files"]
    plan["preserved_development_files"] = preserved
    plan["question_hashes"] = [c["question_sha256"] for c in read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-business-reference-draft.json")["cases"]]
    backup_parent = store.root / "backups"
    restore_parent = RUNTIME / "knowledge-update-restores"
    ensure_private_directory(backup_parent)
    ensure_private_directory(restore_parent)
    backup = create_bundle(store, backup_parent / (plan["run_id"]+"-pre-review"))
    restored = restore_bundle(backup["directory"], restore_parent / (plan["run_id"]+"-offline-review"))
    clone = KnowledgeStore(restored["restored_to"])
    results = apply_plan(clone, plan)
    trial = replay(clone, plan, results)
    if not trial["pdf_revisions_jobs_and_success_unchanged"] or not trial["edges_keep_actual_review_revision"] or trial["external_calls"]:
        raise ValueError("Offline replay did not preserve PDF state and actual edge provenance")
    plan.update(expected_revisions=results, offline_replay=trial, backup=backup, restore=restored)
    plan["plan_sha256"] = fingerprint(plan)
    (research / "review-plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"prepared": True, "cases": len(plan["cases"]), "norm_dates_revalidated_not_approved": True, "offline_replay": trial}, ensure_ascii=False))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="十份指定资料的AI范围复核及历史日期重核；先离线复放，再显式应用")
    parser.add_argument("--research-directory", required=True, type=Path)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    mode.add_argument("--prepare", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    research = args.research_directory.resolve()
    if not research.is_relative_to((RUNTIME / "knowledge-update/source-research").resolve()):
        raise ValueError("Dedicated private source-review directory required")
    ensure_private_directory(research)
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update")
    plan_path = research / "review-plan.json"
    if args.prepare:
        if plan_path.exists():
            raise ValueError("Review plan already exists; inspect rather than repeat preparation")
        prepare(store, research)
        return
    plan = read(plan_path)
    if fingerprint({k:v for k,v in plan.items() if k != "plan_sha256"}) != plan["plan_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Prepared review plan changed")
    if state(store) != plan["before"]:
        raise ValueError("Canonical candidate/source/policy state changed since offline review")
    with store.db() as db:
        if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE state='running'").fetchone():
            raise ValueError("Do not apply during a live acquisition job")
    results = apply_plan(store, plan, plan["expected_revisions"])
    trial = replay(store, plan, results)
    after = state(store)
    checks = {"ten_pinned_scope_decisions_applied": len(results) == 11 and results == plan["expected_revisions"],
        "real_archived_replay_keeps_pdf_versions_jobs_and_success": trial["pdf_revisions_jobs_and_success_unchanged"],
        "actual_parent_dispositions_retained_in_edges": trial["edges_keep_actual_review_revision"],
        "no_network_in_archived_replay": trial["external_calls"] == 0,
        "source_configs_pause_and_business_policy_unchanged": after["configs"] == plan["before"]["configs"] and after["policy"] == plan["before"]["policy"],
        "no_formal_approval_evaluation_or_publication": not any(after["formal"].values()),
        "old_frozen_development_files_preserved": all(fingerprint((ROOT/path).read_bytes()) == expected for path,expected in plan["preserved_development_files"].items()),
        "working_questions_not_used_or_changed": plan["question_hashes"] == [c["question_sha256"] for c in read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-business-reference-draft.json")["cases"]]}
    report = {"schema": 1, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks,
        "actor": plan["actor"], "human_review_completed": False, "plan_sha256": plan["plan_sha256"], "cases": plan["cases"],
        "result_revisions": results, "historical_dates_revalidated_not_current_effect_approved": True,
        "offline_replay": plan["offline_replay"], "actual_archived_replay": trial, "counts_before": plan["counts_before"], "counts": store.status()["counts"],
        "business_approval_performed": False, "scope": "Individually pinned same-original scope exclusions and literal historical-date interpretation; no automatic future exclusions or current-policy approval."}
    (ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/metadata-refresh-scope-decisions.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "checks": checks, "counts": report["counts"], "archive_replay": trial}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not report["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        results[case["revision"]] = result
    norm = plan["norm"]
    with store.db() as db:
        row, _ = store._verify(db, norm["revision"], require_review=False)
        latest = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
    if expected and latest == expected[NORM]:
        with store.db() as db:
            current, _ = store._verify(db, latest, require_review=False)
            if json.loads(current["metadata"]) != norm["metadata"] or current["state"] != "pending_review":
                raise ValueError("The interpreted-date candidate was modified or approved")
        result = latest
    elif latest == NORM:
        result = store.amend(NORM, norm["metadata"])
        store.propose_classification(result)
    else:
        raise ValueError("The dated normative source changed during review")
    results[NORM] = result
    if expected and results != expected:
        raise ValueError("Actual review revisions differ from the inspected offline results")
    return results

def prepare(store, research):
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    plan = {"schema": 1, "run_id": "observation-refresh-20261016-"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8], "prepared_at": stamp,
        "actor": {"kind": "ai", "name": "Codex AI"}, "human_review_completed": False,
        "before": state(store), "counts_before": store.status()["counts"], "cases": []}
    if any(plan["before"]["formal"].values()):
        raise ValueError("Inspect any formal review/publication before this bounded candidate review")
    with store.db() as db:
        if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE state='running'").fetchone():
            raise ValueError("Wait for the active acquisition job before capturing this plan")
        for revision, summary in REASONS.items():
            row, _ = store._verify(db, revision, require_review=False)
            previous = db.execute("SELECT * FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? AND rowid<(SELECT rowid FROM revisions WHERE id=?) ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"], revision)).fetchone()
            store._verify_exclusion(db, previous["id"])
            prior_reason = db.execute("SELECT reason FROM exclusions WHERE revision_id=?", (previous["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            document = db.execute("SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id=?", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()
            impact = revision_impact(store, revision)
            latest = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            if (row["state"] != "pending_review" or row["sha256"] != previous["sha256"] or row["body_sha256"] != previous["body_sha256"]
                    or not set(impact["changed_metadata_fields"]) <= ALLOWED_SCOPE_FIELDS
                    or latest != revision):
                raise ValueError("Candidate is outside the individually inspected metadata-only cohort")
            reason = summary+"。本次原件/正文指纹与旧排除修订"+previous["id"]+"相同，仅复核已列观察字段及内部提示；继续排除本试点答复，不判定整份文件现行效力。"
            plan["cases"].append({"revision": revision, "document_id": row["document_id"], "site_id": document["site_id"], "url": document["url"],
                "original_sha256": row["sha256"], "body_sha256": row["body_sha256"], "previous_exclusion": previous["id"],
                "previous_reason_sha256": fingerprint(prior_reason.encode()), "changed_metadata": impact["changed_metadata_fields"], "reason": reason})
        norm, _ = store._verify(db, NORM, require_review=False)
        old, _ = store._verify(db, "rev-30d1bf98f40e9acb897b37c1", require_review=False)
        if norm["sha256"] != old["sha256"] or norm["body_sha256"] != old["body_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The historical-date evidence changed")
        metadata, old_metadata = json.loads(norm["metadata"]), json.loads(old["metadata"])
        assessment = copy.deepcopy(old_metadata["source_fact_assessment"])
        body = {r["locator"]: r["text"] for r in db.execute("SELECT locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=?", (NORM,))}
        for fact in assessment["facts"]:
            evidence = fact["evidence"]
            if "locator" in evidence:
                if body[evidence["locator"]][evidence["start"]:evidence["end"]] != evidence["quote"]:
                    raise ValueError("A literal historical source fact no longer matches")
            else:
                if evidence["quote"] not in metadata["source_observation"]["fields"]["block:page_date"][0]:
                    raise ValueError("The observed historical page date differs")
                evidence["observation_sha256"] = fingerprint(metadata["source_observation"])
            evidence["revision"] = NORM
        if old_metadata["effective_from"] != "2022-09-01" or old_metadata["published_at"] != "2022-08-16":
            raise ValueError("Previously interpreted dates differ from this review")
        assessment.update(id="source-facts-observation-refresh-20261016-v2", assessed_at=stamp, base_revision=NORM,
                          revalidated_from_revision=old["id"], base_body_sha256=norm["body_sha256"])
        metadata.update(effective_from="2022-09-01", published_at="2022-08-16", source_fact_assessment=assessment,
                        business_review="pending_current_applicability")
        plan["norm"] = {"revision": NORM, "original_sha256": norm["sha256"], "body_sha256": norm["body_sha256"], "metadata": metadata,
            "basis": "Same original and body; all historical literal facts and current page-date observation rechecked. Source observations unchanged. Not current legal-effect approval."}
    preserved = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/material-branch-assessments.json")["preserved_development_files"]
    plan["preserved_development_files"] = preserved
    plan["question_hashes"] = [c["question_sha256"] for c in read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-business-reference-draft.json")["cases"]]
    backup_parent = store.root / "backups"
    restore_parent = RUNTIME / "knowledge-update-restores"
    ensure_private_directory(backup_parent)
    ensure_private_directory(restore_parent)
    backup = create_bundle(store, backup_parent / (plan["run_id"]+"-pre-review"))
    restored = restore_bundle(backup["directory"], restore_parent / (plan["run_id"]+"-offline-review"))
    clone = KnowledgeStore(restored["restored_to"])
    results = apply_plan(clone, plan)
    trial = replay(clone, plan, results)
    if not trial["pdf_revisions_jobs_and_success_unchanged"] or not trial["edges_keep_actual_review_revision"] or trial["external_calls"]:
        raise ValueError("Offline replay did not preserve PDF state and actual edge provenance")
    plan.update(expected_revisions=results, offline_replay=trial, backup=backup, restore=restored)
    plan["plan_sha256"] = fingerprint(plan)
    (research / "review-plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"prepared": True, "cases": len(plan["cases"]), "norm_dates_revalidated_not_approved": True, "offline_replay": trial}, ensure_ascii=False))

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="十份指定资料的AI范围复核及历史日期重核；先离线复放，再显式应用")
    parser.add_argument("--research-directory", required=True, type=Path)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    mode.add_argument("--prepare", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    research = args.research_directory.resolve()
    if not research.is_relative_to((RUNTIME / "knowledge-update/source-research").resolve()):
        raise ValueError("Dedicated private source-review directory required")
    ensure_private_directory(research)
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update")
    plan_path = research / "review-plan.json"
    if args.prepare:
        if plan_path.exists():
            raise ValueError("Review plan already exists; inspect rather than repeat preparation")
        prepare(store, research)
        return
    plan = read(plan_path)
    if fingerprint({k:v for k,v in plan.items() if k != "plan_sha256"}) != plan["plan_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Prepared review plan changed")
    if state(store) != plan["before"]:
        raise ValueError("Canonical candidate/source/policy state changed since offline review")
    with store.db() as db:
        if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE state='running'").fetchone():
            raise ValueError("Do not apply during a live acquisition job")
    results = apply_plan(store, plan, plan["expected_revisions"])
    trial = replay(store, plan, results)
    after = state(store)
    checks = {"ten_pinned_scope_decisions_applied": len(results) == 11 and results == plan["expected_revisions"],
        "real_archived_replay_keeps_pdf_versions_jobs_and_success": trial["pdf_revisions_jobs_and_success_unchanged"],
        "actual_parent_dispositions_retained_in_edges": trial["edges_keep_actual_review_revision"],
        "no_network_in_archived_replay": trial["external_calls"] == 0,
        "source_configs_pause_and_business_policy_unchanged": after["configs"] == plan["before"]["configs"] and after["policy"] == plan["before"]["policy"],
        "no_formal_approval_evaluation_or_publication": not any(after["formal"].values()),
        "old_frozen_development_files_preserved": all(fingerprint((ROOT/path).read_bytes()) == expected for path,expected in plan["preserved_development_files"].items()),
        "working_questions_not_used_or_changed": plan["question_hashes"] == [c["question_sha256"] for c in read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-business-reference-draft.json")["cases"]]}
    report = {"schema": 1, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks,
        "actor": plan["actor"], "human_review_completed": False, "plan_sha256": plan["plan_sha256"], "cases": plan["cases"],
        "result_revisions": results, "historical_dates_revalidated_not_current_effect_approved": True,
        "offline_replay": plan["offline_replay"], "actual_archived_replay": trial, "counts_before": plan["counts_before"], "counts": store.status()["counts"],
        "business_approval_performed": False, "scope": "Individually pinned same-original scope exclusions and literal historical-date interpretation; no automatic future exclusions or current-policy approval."}
    (ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/metadata-refresh-scope-decisions.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "checks": checks, "counts": report["counts"], "archive_replay": trial}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not report["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)

"""Exercise the offline decision foundation with explicitly synthetic materials."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/"src"))
from gov_mcp.decision import DecisionService
from gov_mcp.decision.service import MAINTENANCE_MESSAGE
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory

FIXTURE = ROOT/"config/decision/synthetic.snapshot.json"
FACTS = {"reason":"expiry","age_group":"adult","self_service":True,"electronic_verified":False}


def write_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")


def all_items(answer):
    return [item for stage in answer["stages"] for item in stage["items"]]


def ids(answer):
    return {row["requirement_id"]for row in all_items(answer)}


def make_markdown(examples, checks):
    lines=["# Agent 第一阶段：模拟规则演练", "", "全部资料和复核记录均为工程模拟；未调用模型、Jev 或官网。", "",
           "本阶段验证知识对象、条件判定、原文关联和返回前暂停检查，三角色 Agent 编排及前端页面尚待后续接入。", ""]
    for label,answer in examples.items():
        lines.extend(["## "+label,"",f"状态：`{answer['status']}`；已确认 {answer['counts']['confirmed']}，待确认 {answer['counts']['pending']}，暂停 {answer['counts']['paused']}。", "",
                      "| 环节 | 材料 | 提供动作 | 原文依据 |","| --- | --- | --- | --- |"])
        for stage in answer["stages"]:
            for item in stage["items"]:
                direct=[e for e in item["evidence"] if e["id"] in next(edge["evidence_ids"]for edge in item["path"]if edge["relation"]=="has_requirement")]
                quotes="；".join(e["quote"]for e in direct)
                lines.append(f"| {stage['label']} | {item['material']} | {item['action']} | {quotes} |")
        if answer["follow_up"]["enabled"]:
            lines.extend(["","可选择“补充情况”："+"、".join(field["label"]for field in answer["follow_up"]["fields"])])
        if answer["paused"]:
            lines.extend(["",MAINTENANCE_MESSAGE+"。仅暂停受影响项目，其余内容见上表。"])
        if answer["pending"]:
            lines.extend(["","待确认："+"、".join(row["material"]for row in answer["pending"])+"。这些项目未加入确定清单。"])
        lines.extend(["",f"资料版本：`{answer['versions']['documents']}`；知识快照：`{answer['snapshot_sha256']}`。",""])
    lines.extend(["## 检查结果","",f"{sum(checks.values())}/{len(checks)} 项通过。",""])
    for name,passed in checks.items():lines.append(f"- {'通过' if passed else '失败'}：{name}")
    return "\n".join(lines)+"\n"


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    group=parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    group.add_argument("--facts",help="Run one custom JSON facts object; output stays private")
    group.add_argument("--facts-file",type=Path,help="Read a facts JSON file without shell quoting; output stays private")
    parser.add_argument("--branch",default="branch-adult-self")
    parser.add_argument("--as-of",help="Explicit ISO date; defaults to the fixed simulation date")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    custom=bool(args.facts is not None or args.facts_file is not None or args.as_of or args.branch!="branch-adult-self")
    run_id=datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
    runtime=ROOT/".runtime/decision-demo"/run_id
    ensure_private_directory(runtime)
    report={"captured_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"mode":"synthetic_engineering_only",
            "model_calls":0,"real_policy_advice":False,"agents_executed":False,"passed":False}
    try:
        service=DecisionService.from_file(FIXTURE)
        if custom:
            if args.facts_file is not None:
                if args.facts_file.stat().st_size>32768:raise ValueError("FACTS_FILE_TOO_LARGE")
                facts=json.loads(args.facts_file.read_bytes())
            else:
                facts=json.loads(args.facts)if args.facts is not None else FACTS
            as_of=date.fromisoformat(args.as_of)if args.as_of else None
            answer=service.answer(facts,args.branch,as_of=as_of)
            write_json(runtime/"answer.json",answer)
            print(json.dumps({"status":answer["status"],"counts":answer["counts"],"answer_file":str(runtime/"answer.json")},ensure_ascii=False))
            return
        paper=service.answer(FACTS,"branch-adult-self")
        electronic=service.answer({**FACTS,"electronic_verified":True},"branch-adult-self")
        unknown=service.answer({**FACTS,"electronic_verified":None},"branch-adult-self")
        task=service.prepare(FACTS,"branch-adult-self")
        service.availability.suspend("ev-card-apply",change_id="demo-conflict",reason="模拟申请环节交验要求发生冲突")
        paused=service.finalize(task)
        unsupported=DecisionService.from_file(FIXTURE).answer({**FACTS,"age_group":"minor"},"branch-minor-self")
        incomplete=DecisionService.from_file(FIXTURE).answer({"reason":"expiry"},"branch-adult-self")
        examples={"电子表不可验证：采用纸质表":paper,"电子表可验证：采用电子表":electronic,
                  "电子表状态未知：保留独立已确认要求":unknown,"生成途中发现冲突：返回前暂停":paused}
        providers=json.loads((ROOT/"config/decision/providers.template.json").read_bytes())
        checks={
            "same_material_stage_specific_actions":{(r["stage_id"],r["action"])for r in all_items(paper)if r["material_id"]=="material-old-card"}=={("application","交验"),("collection","交回")},
            "paper_selected_when_electronic_unverified":"req-paper"in ids(paper)and"req-electronic"not in ids(paper),
            "electronic_selected_without_paper":"req-electronic"in ids(electronic)and"req-paper"not in ids(electronic),
            "unknown_exception_does_not_force_paper":not {"req-paper","req-electronic"}&ids(unknown),
            "unknown_preserves_independent_items":unknown["counts"]["confirmed"]==3,
            "optional_followup_only_for_missing_condition":unknown["follow_up"]["optional"]and[field["id"]for field in unknown["follow_up"]["fields"]]==["electronic_verified"],
            "unconfirmed_fact_only_in_pending":"req-residence"not in ids(paper)and"req-residence"in{r["requirement_id"]for r in paper["pending"]},
            "multiple_document_evidence_present":{e["asset_id"]for r in all_items(paper)if r["requirement_id"]=="req-paper"for e in r["evidence"]}>={"asset-core","asset-exception"},
            "all_business_edges_have_evidence":all(edge["evidence_ids"]for row in all_items(paper)for edge in row["path"]),
            "fixed_snapshot_current_suspension_checked":paused["snapshot_sha256"]==paper["snapshot_sha256"]and{r["requirement_id"]for r in paused["paused"]}=={"req-card-apply"},
            "unaffected_collection_still_available":"req-card-collect"in ids(paused),
            "configured_public_maintenance_message":paused["paused"][0]["message"]==MAINTENANCE_MESSAGE,
            "candidate_alias_not_applied":[a["label"]for a in paper["confirmed_aliases"]]==["旧演练卡"],
            "uncovered_branch_no_adult_fallback":unsupported["status"]=="no_confirmed_requirements"and not ids(unsupported),
            "branch_selection_does_not_invent_facts":not ids(incomplete)and incomplete["branch_result"]=="unknown",
            "api_fields_remain_empty":not providers["enabled"]and all(value is None for role in providers["roles"].values()for value in role.values()),
        }
        code_paths=["src/gov_mcp/decision/logic.py","src/gov_mcp/decision/models.py","src/gov_mcp/decision/service.py",
                    "scripts/build_decision_fixture.py","scripts/run_decision_demo.py"]
        report.update(snapshot_sha256=paper["snapshot_sha256"],fixture_file_sha256=hashlib.sha256(FIXTURE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      source_files_sha256={p:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()for p in code_paths},
                      checks=checks,passed=all(checks.values()),examples={label:{"counts":value["counts"],"status":value["status"]}for label,value in examples.items()})
        for index,(label,answer)in enumerate(examples.items(),1):write_json(runtime/f"example-{index}.json",answer)
        markdown=make_markdown(examples,checks)
        (runtime/"模拟规则演练.md").write_text(markdown,encoding="utf-8")
        public=ROOT/"evidence/decision-foundation"
        public.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        write_json(public/"verification.json",report)
        for index,answer in enumerate(examples.values(),1):write_json(public/f"example-{index}.json",answer)
        (public/"模拟规则演练.md").write_text(markdown,encoding="utf-8")
        write_json(runtime/"verification.json",report)
        print(json.dumps({"passed":report["passed"],"checks":f"{sum(checks.values())}/{len(checks)}","model_calls":0,"report":str(public/"模拟规则演练.md")},ensure_ascii=False))
        if not report["passed"]:raise SystemExit(1)
    except Exception as error:
        report.update(failure_class=type(error).__name__,passed=False)
        write_json(runtime/"verification.json",report)
        if not custom:write_json(ROOT/"evidence/decision-foundation/verification.json",report)
        raise


if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
