def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    group=parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    group.add_argument("--facts",help="Run one custom JSON facts object; output stays private")
    group.add_argument("--facts-file",type=Path,help="Read a facts JSON file without shell quoting; output stays private")
    parser.add_argument("--branch",default="branch-adult-self")
    parser.add_argument("--as-of",help="Explicit ISO date; defaults to the fixed simulation date")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    custom=bool(args.facts is not None or args.facts_file is not None or args.as_of or args.branch!="branch-adult-self")
    run_id=datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
    runtime=ROOT/".runtime/decision-demo"/run_id
    ensure_private_directory(runtime)
    report={"captured_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"mode":"synthetic_engineering_only",
            "model_calls":0,"real_policy_advice":False,"agents_executed":False,"passed":False}
    try:
        service=DecisionService.from_file(FIXTURE)
        if custom:
            if args.facts_file is not None:
                if args.facts_file.stat().st_size>32768:raise ValueError("FACTS_FILE_TOO_LARGE")
                facts=json.loads(args.facts_file.read_bytes())
            else:
                facts=json.loads(args.facts)if args.facts is not None else FACTS
            as_of=date.fromisoformat(args.as_of)if args.as_of else None
            answer=service.answer(facts,args.branch,as_of=as_of)
            write_json(runtime/"answer.json",answer)
            print(json.dumps({"status":answer["status"],"counts":answer["counts"],"answer_file":str(runtime/"answer.json")},ensure_ascii=False))
            return
        paper=service.answer(FACTS,"branch-adult-self")
        electronic=service.answer({**FACTS,"electronic_verified":True},"branch-adult-self")
        unknown=service.answer({**FACTS,"electronic_verified":None},"branch-adult-self")
        task=service.prepare(FACTS,"branch-adult-self")
        service.availability.suspend("ev-card-apply",change_id="demo-conflict",reason="模拟申请环节交验要求发生冲突")
        paused=service.finalize(task)
        unsupported=DecisionService.from_file(FIXTURE).answer({**FACTS,"age_group":"minor"},"branch-minor-self")
        incomplete=DecisionService.from_file(FIXTURE).answer({"reason":"expiry"},"branch-adult-self")
        examples={"电子表不可验证：采用纸质表":paper,"电子表可验证：采用电子表":electronic,
                  "电子表状态未知：保留独立已确认要求":unknown,"生成途中发现冲突：返回前暂停":paused}
        providers=json.loads((ROOT/"config/decision/providers.template.json").read_bytes())
        checks={
            "same_material_stage_specific_actions":{(r["stage_id"],r["action"])for r in all_items(paper)if r["material_id"]=="material-old-card"}=={("application","交验"),("collection","交回")},
            "paper_selected_when_electronic_unverified":"req-paper"in ids(paper)and"req-electronic"not in ids(paper),
            "electronic_selected_without_paper":"req-electronic"in ids(electronic)and"req-paper"not in ids(electronic),
            "unknown_exception_does_not_force_paper":not {"req-paper","req-electronic"}&ids(unknown),
            "unknown_preserves_independent_items":unknown["counts"]["confirmed"]==3,
            "optional_followup_only_for_missing_condition":unknown["follow_up"]["optional"]and[field["id"]for field in unknown["follow_up"]["fields"]]==["electronic_verified"],
            "unconfirmed_fact_only_in_pending":"req-residence"not in ids(paper)and"req-residence"in{r["requirement_id"]for r in paper["pending"]},
            "multiple_document_evidence_present":{e["asset_id"]for r in all_items(paper)if r["requirement_id"]=="req-paper"for e in r["evidence"]}>={"asset-core","asset-exception"},
            "all_business_edges_have_evidence":all(edge["evidence_ids"]for row in all_items(paper)for edge in row["path"]),
            "fixed_snapshot_current_suspension_checked":paused["snapshot_sha256"]==paper["snapshot_sha256"]and{r["requirement_id"]for r in paused["paused"]}=={"req-card-apply"},
            "unaffected_collection_still_available":"req-card-collect"in ids(paused),
            "configured_public_maintenance_message":paused["paused"][0]["message"]==MAINTENANCE_MESSAGE,
            "candidate_alias_not_applied":[a["label"]for a in paper["confirmed_aliases"]]==["旧演练卡"],
            "uncovered_branch_no_adult_fallback":unsupported["status"]=="no_confirmed_requirements"and not ids(unsupported),
            "branch_selection_does_not_invent_facts":not ids(incomplete)and incomplete["branch_result"]=="unknown",
            "api_fields_remain_empty":not providers["enabled"]and all(value is None for role in providers["roles"].values()for value in role.values()),
        }
        code_paths=["src/gov_mcp/decision/logic.py","src/gov_mcp/decision/models.py","src/gov_mcp/decision/service.py",
                    "scripts/build_decision_fixture.py","scripts/run_decision_demo.py"]
        report.update(snapshot_sha256=paper["snapshot_sha256"],fixture_file_sha256=hashlib.sha256(FIXTURE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      source_files_sha256={p:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()for p in code_paths},
                      checks=checks,passed=all(checks.values()),examples={label:{"counts":value["counts"],"status":value["status"]}for label,value in examples.items()})
        for index,(label,answer)in enumerate(examples.items(),1):write_json(runtime/f"example-{index}.json",answer)
        markdown=make_markdown(examples,checks)
        (runtime/"模拟规则演练.md").write_text(markdown,encoding="utf-8")
        public=ROOT/"evidence/decision-foundation"
        public.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        write_json(public/"verification.json",report)
        for index,answer in enumerate(examples.values(),1):write_json(public/f"example-{index}.json",answer)
        (public/"模拟规则演练.md").write_text(markdown,encoding="utf-8")
        write_json(runtime/"verification.json",report)
        print(json.dumps({"passed":report["passed"],"checks":f"{sum(checks.values())}/{len(checks)}","model_calls":0,"report":str(public/"模拟规则演练.md")},ensure_ascii=False))
        if not report["passed"]:raise SystemExit(1)
    except Exception as error:
        report.update(failure_class=type(error).__name__,passed=False)
        write_json(runtime/"verification.json",report)
        if not custom:write_json(ROOT/"evidence/decision-foundation/verification.json",report)
        raise

"""Acquire two fixed official sources once, then replay isolated candidate retrieval offline."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import ssl
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import Fetcher, AccessStopped, BOT, MAX_BYTES
from gov_mcp.knowledge_landing import TARGETS, URLS, verified_chunks, retrieve
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory

RUNTIME = ROOT / ".runtime/new-knowledge-experiment-20261018"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "evidence/new-knowledge-experiment"


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, *args, **kwargs):
        return None


def configured_proxy_request(url, headers):
    # Only fixed public HTTPS URLs are admitted. DNS resolution occurs at the
    # user's explicit proxy; never send arbitrary hosts or private input here.
    allowed = set(URLS.values()) | {f"https://{urlsplit(u).netloc}/robots.txt" for u in URLS.values()}
    if url not in allowed:
        raise AccessStopped("Outside fixed proxy experiment allowlist")
    proxies = urllib.request.getproxies()
    proxy = proxies.get("https") or proxies.get("http")
    if not proxy:
        raise AccessStopped("Configured proxy required")
    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({"https": proxy}), NoRedirect(),
                                        urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=ssl.create_default_context()))
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": BOT + "/0.1 (public-document research)",
                                               "Accept-Encoding": "identity", **headers})
    try:
        response = opener.open(req, timeout=20)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        response = error
    with response:
        raw = response.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
        if len(raw) > MAX_BYTES:
            raise AccessStopped("Response too large")
        return response.status, {k.lower(): v for k, v in response.headers.items()}, raw


def acquire(repair_proxy=False):
    # An attempt marker prevents an offline replay or accidental repeated command
    # from re-requesting blocked origins or destroying a prior observation.
    if repair_proxy:
        previous = json.loads((RUNTIME / "snapshot.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if (RUNTIME / "proxy-repair.json").exists() or previous["bindings"] or not all(
                not a["requests"] and a.get("access_failure") == {"phase": "robots", "http_status": None}
                for a in previous["acquisitions"]):
            raise ValueError("Proxy repair only permitted after a local pre-request stop")
        write(RUNTIME / "direct-attempt.json", previous)
        write(RUNTIME / "proxy-repair.json", {"reason": "Local fake-IP DNS blocks direct fetch; fixed public destinations via existing user proxy"})
    elif (RUNTIME / "attempt.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Acquisition already attempted; use offline replay")
    store = KnowledgeStore.initialize(RUNTIME)
    ensure_private_directory(RUNTIME)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    proxies = urllib.request.getproxies()
    use_proxy = repair_proxy or bool(proxies.get("https") or proxies.get("http"))
    write(RUNTIME / "attempt.json", {"started_at": stamp, "uses_configured_proxy": use_proxy})
    catalog_raw = (ROOT / "data/knowledge/candidate-catalog.json").read_bytes()
    catalog = json.loads(catalog_raw)
    documents = {(d["source_id"], d["url"]): d for d in catalog["documents"]}
    specs = [s for p in sorted((ROOT / "data/knowledge/expansion-batches").glob("*.json"))
             for s in json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["sources"] if s["source_id"] in TARGETS]
    if len(specs) != 2 or {s["source_id"] for s in specs} != set(TARGETS):
        raise ValueError("Two fixed sources required")
    snapshot = {"captured_at": stamp, "catalog_sha256": hashlib.sha256(catalog_raw).hexdigest(),
                "bindings": [], "acquisitions": [], "cloud_calls": 0, "formally_published": False}
    for spec in specs:
        if spec["url"] != URLS[spec["source_id"]]:
            raise ValueError("Fixed official URL required")
        document = documents[(spec["source_id"], spec["url"])]
        target = urlsplit(spec["url"])
        basis = "Official public service text; private attributed engineering preview; no business approval or republication of website assets"
        metadata = dict(document["metadata"], effective_from=None, effective_to=None,
                        usage_basis=basis, scope_confirmed=False, business_review="pending")
        config = {"id": spec["source_id"], "label": metadata["title"], "enabled": True,
                  "origin": f"{target.scheme}://{target.netloc}", "allowed_paths": [target.path],
                  "seeds": [spec["url"]], "interval_seconds": 86400, "delay_seconds": 5,
                  "content_selector": spec["selector"], "metadata": metadata,
                  "access_review": {"approved": True, "reviewer": "codex_automated_technical_access_screen",
                      "actor_kind": "machine", "checked_at": stamp, "usage_basis": basis,
                      "business_review_completed": False, "purpose": "private_engineering_candidates_only"}}
        store.register(config)
        receipt = {"source_id": spec["source_id"], "url": spec["url"], "checked_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                   "method": "normal_configured_proxy_fixed_https_tls_robots" if use_proxy else "normal_direct_public_http_checked_ip_tls_robots", "requests": []}
        fetcher = Fetcher(store)
        request = configured_proxy_request if use_proxy else fetcher._request

        def observe(url, headers):
            status, response_headers, raw = request(url, headers)
            receipt["requests"].append({"url": url, "http_status": status,
                "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
            if urlsplit(url).path == "/robots.txt":
                (RUNTIME / (spec["source_id"] + "-robots.txt")).write_bytes(raw)
            return status, response_headers, raw

        fetcher._request = observe
        try:
            status, _, raw, final_url = fetcher.fetch(config, spec["url"])
            receipt["http_status"] = status
            if status != 200 or final_url != spec["url"]:
                raise ValueError("Expected exact official document URL and HTTP 200")
            # Preserve observed original even if its selected text has drifted.
            (RUNTIME / (spec["source_id"] + ".html")).write_bytes(raw)
            selected = verified_chunks(raw, spec, document)
            revision = store.ingest(spec["source_id"], spec["url"], raw, metadata, selected)
            receipt.update(status="ingested_pending_review", original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                catalog_original_sha256=spec["original_sha256"],
                raw_matches_catalog=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == spec["original_sha256"],
                all_selected_quotes_match=True, selected_chunks=len(selected), revision_id=revision)
            snapshot["bindings"].append({"spec": spec, "document": document, "revision_id": revision})
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            receipt.update(status="stopped", error_type=type(error).__name__)
            if isinstance(error, AccessStopped):
                receipt["access_failure"] = error.detail()
            # Never store remote error bodies or automatically retry a block.
        snapshot["acquisitions"].append(receipt)
        write(RUNTIME / "snapshot.json", snapshot)
    return snapshot


CASES = [
    ("beijing_materials", "北京市", "resident-id-renewal", "身份证期满换领需要哪些材料？"),
    ("nanjing_cycle", "南京市", "resident-id-renewal", "身份证到期换证，省内和省外户籍分别多久？考生怎么办？"),
    ("erqi_isolation", "郑州市二七区", "resident-id-renewal", "身份证换领材料和时限"),
    ("passport_isolation", "北京市", "ordinary-passport-first-application", "首次申领护照材料"),
    ("online_branch", "北京市", "resident-id-renewal", "到期换领可以直接网上办理吗？损坏换领有什么条件？"),
]


def replay(snapshot):
    if snapshot["catalog_sha256"] != hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "data/knowledge/candidate-catalog.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest():
        raise ValueError("Catalog changed; old experiment must not be silently reused")
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME, read_only=True)
    results = [{"case_id": key, "question": query, "result": retrieve(store, snapshot["bindings"], query, region, matter)}
               for key, region, matter, query in CASES]
    checks = {
        "two_sources_acquired": len(snapshot["bindings"]) == 2,
        "beijing_has_real_quotes": bool(results[0]["result"]["citations"]),
        "nanjing_has_real_quotes": bool(results[1]["result"]["citations"]),
        "region_isolation": all(c["source_id"] == "BJ-ID-RENEWAL-2025" for c in results[0]["result"]["citations"])
            and all(c["source_id"] == "NJ-ID-RENEWAL-CYCLE-2026" for c in results[1]["result"]["citations"]),
        "erqi_blocked": results[2]["result"]["status"] == "OUT_OF_SCOPE" and not results[2]["result"]["citations"],
        "other_matter_blocked": results[3]["result"]["status"] == "OUT_OF_SCOPE" and not results[3]["result"]["citations"],
        "business_conclusions_paused": all(r["result"]["business_conclusion_status"] == "PAUSED_UNREVIEWED" for r in results),
        "online_conditions_preserved": any(
            {"正文段落24", "正文段落25"} <= {c["locator"] for c in context["selected_clauses"]}
            for context in results[4]["result"]["source_context"]),
    }
    with store.db() as db:
        counts = {t: db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM " + t).fetchone()[0]
                  for t in ("sites", "documents", "revisions", "chunks", "reviews", "versions", "heads")}
    checks["no_review_or_publication"] = counts["reviews"] == counts["versions"] == counts["heads"] == 0
    report = {"status": "PASS_SOURCE_LANDING" if all(checks.values()) else "INCOMPLETE",
              "checks": checks, "counts": counts, "snapshot": snapshot, "queries": results,
              "limits": "Real acquisition and deterministic candidate retrieval only; no new Nexent run, cloud model, formal business approval or publication"}
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write(OUTPUT / "result.json", report)
    print(json.dumps({"status": report["status"], "counts": counts, "checks": checks}, ensure_ascii=False))
    return all(checks.values())


def ingest_saved():
    """Repair parser settings using saved bytes, without another HTTP request."""
    snapshot = json.loads((RUNTIME / "snapshot.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (RUNTIME / "saved-ingest.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Saved ingestion already completed; use replay")
    write(RUNTIME / "before-saved-ingest.json", snapshot)
    if (OUTPUT / "result.json").exists():
        write(OUTPUT / "before-parser-fix.json", json.loads((OUTPUT / "result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    catalog = json.loads((ROOT / "data/knowledge/candidate-catalog.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    specs = [s for p in sorted((ROOT / "data/knowledge/expansion-batches").glob("*.json"))
             for s in json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["sources"] if s["source_id"] in TARGETS]
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME)
    for receipt in snapshot["acquisitions"]:
        if receipt["status"] != "stopped" or receipt.get("error_type") != "ValueError" or receipt.get("http_status") != 200:
            continue
        spec = next(s for s in specs if s["source_id"] == receipt["source_id"])
        document = next(d for d in catalog["documents"] if d["source_id"] == spec["source_id"] and d["url"] == spec["url"])
        raw = (RUNTIME / (spec["source_id"] + ".html")).read_bytes()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        if digest != spec["original_sha256"] or not any(r["url"] == spec["url"] and r["sha256"] == digest for r in receipt["requests"]):
            raise ValueError("Saved original does not match captured and shared fingerprints")
        selected = verified_chunks(raw, spec, document)
        with store.db() as db:
            metadata = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (spec["source_id"],)).fetchone()[0])["metadata"]
        revision = store.ingest(spec["source_id"], spec["url"], raw, metadata, selected)
        snapshot["bindings"].append({"spec": spec, "document": document, "revision_id": revision})
        receipt.update(status="ingested_pending_review", previous_stop="ValueError: paragraph layout; short headings now retained",
                       original_sha256=digest, catalog_original_sha256=spec["original_sha256"], raw_matches_catalog=True,
                       all_selected_quotes_match=True, selected_chunks=len(selected), revision_id=revision,
                       offline_parser_repair=True)
    write(RUNTIME / "saved-ingest.json", {"parser_min_text_length": 1, "network_requests": 0})
    write(RUNTIME / "snapshot.json", snapshot)
    return snapshot


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--acquire", action="store_true", help="One bounded live public acquisition; no model calls")
    parser.add_argument("--repair-proxy", action="store_true", help="Once only after local fake-IP pre-request stop; no remote denial retry")
    parser.add_argument("--ingest-saved", action="store_true", help="Offline parser repair from exact saved originals; no HTTP")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if sum((args.acquire, args.repair_proxy, args.ingest_saved)) > 1:
        parser.error("Choose one operation")
    snapshot = (ingest_saved() if args.ingest_saved else acquire(args.repair_proxy) if args.acquire or args.repair_proxy
                else json.loads((RUNTIME / "snapshot.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    raise SystemExit(0 if replay(snapshot) else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def ingest_saved():
    """Repair parser settings using saved bytes, without another HTTP request."""
    snapshot = json.loads((RUNTIME / "snapshot.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (RUNTIME / "saved-ingest.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Saved ingestion already completed; use replay")
    write(RUNTIME / "before-saved-ingest.json", snapshot)
    if (OUTPUT / "result.json").exists():
        write(OUTPUT / "before-parser-fix.json", json.loads((OUTPUT / "result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    catalog = json.loads((ROOT / "data/knowledge/candidate-catalog.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    specs = [s for p in sorted((ROOT / "data/knowledge/expansion-batches").glob("*.json"))
             for s in json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["sources"] if s["source_id"] in TARGETS]
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME)
    for receipt in snapshot["acquisitions"]:
        if receipt["status"] != "stopped" or receipt.get("error_type") != "ValueError" or receipt.get("http_status") != 200:
            continue
        spec = next(s for s in specs if s["source_id"] == receipt["source_id"])
        document = next(d for d in catalog["documents"] if d["source_id"] == spec["source_id"] and d["url"] == spec["url"])
        raw = (RUNTIME / (spec["source_id"] + ".html")).read_bytes()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        if digest != spec["original_sha256"] or not any(r["url"] == spec["url"] and r["sha256"] == digest for r in receipt["requests"]):
            raise ValueError("Saved original does not match captured and shared fingerprints")
        selected = verified_chunks(raw, spec, document)
        with store.db() as db:
            metadata = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (spec["source_id"],)).fetchone()[0])["metadata"]
        revision = store.ingest(spec["source_id"], spec["url"], raw, metadata, selected)
        snapshot["bindings"].append({"spec": spec, "document": document, "revision_id": revision})
        receipt.update(status="ingested_pending_review", previous_stop="ValueError: paragraph layout; short headings now retained",
                       original_sha256=digest, catalog_original_sha256=spec["original_sha256"], raw_matches_catalog=True,
                       all_selected_quotes_match=True, selected_chunks=len(selected), revision_id=revision,
                       offline_parser_repair=True)
    write(RUNTIME / "saved-ingest.json", {"parser_min_text_length": 1, "network_requests": 0})
    write(RUNTIME / "snapshot.json", snapshot)
    return snapshot

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--acquire", action="store_true", help="One bounded live public acquisition; no model calls")
    parser.add_argument("--repair-proxy", action="store_true", help="Once only after local fake-IP pre-request stop; no remote denial retry")
    parser.add_argument("--ingest-saved", action="store_true", help="Offline parser repair from exact saved originals; no HTTP")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if sum((args.acquire, args.repair_proxy, args.ingest_saved)) > 1:
        parser.error("Choose one operation")
    snapshot = (ingest_saved() if args.ingest_saved else acquire(args.repair_proxy) if args.acquire or args.repair_proxy
                else json.loads((RUNTIME / "snapshot.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    raise SystemExit(0 if replay(snapshot) else 1)

def prepare():
    ensure_private_directory(DIRECTORY)
    sources = []
    with httpx.Client(trust_env=True, timeout=30, follow_redirects=False) as client:
        for identifier, url in SOURCES.items():
            with client.stream("GET", url) as response:
                response.raise_for_status()
                raw = bytearray()
                for chunk in response.iter_bytes():
                    raw.extend(chunk)
                    if len(raw) > 1024 * 1024:
                        raise ValueError("SOURCE_TOO_LARGE")
            parser = Sections()
            parser.feed(raw.decode("utf-8"))
            if len(parser.sections) != 9:
                raise ValueError("SOURCE_SECTIONS_CHANGED")
            (DIRECTORY / (identifier + ".html")).write_bytes(raw)
            sources.append({"source_id": identifier, "url": url, "data_class": "public",
                "raw_sha256": digest(raw), "sections": parser.sections,
                "published_at": None, "effective_at": None,
                "date_note": "Page has no verified publication/effective date; retrieval is not a legal validity decision."})
    snapshot = {"schema_version": 1, "retrieved_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "data_class": "public", "case": CASE, "sources": sources,
                "source_reading_expectation": EXPECTED, "review_status": "pending_professional_review"}
    write(DIRECTORY / "snapshot.json", snapshot)
    print(json.dumps({"prepared_sources": len(sources), "snapshot": str(DIRECTORY / "snapshot.json")}))

"""Generate a hash-guarded SDK overlay for the blank MCP connection boundary."""

import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BASE_SHA256 = "1a7dee94e05f7d41ffc4f53570fbeb25b402c5ef45172d049e7b4f75edfbb0b5"
TARGET = "/opt/backend/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/nexent/core/agents/run_agent.py"
OVERLAY = ROOT / ".runtime/overlays/run_agent.py"
HELPERS = '''
def _blank_mcp_connection_failure(mcp_host, error):
    """Classify only transport connection failures for the blank MCP service."""
    urls = [host if isinstance(host, str) else host.get("url")
            for host in (mcp_host or []) if isinstance(host, (str, dict))]
    if not urls or len(urls) != len(mcp_host) or any(
            url != "http://gov-blank-mcp:8765/sse" for url in urls):
        return False

    def matches(current, visited):
        if id(current) in visited:
            return False
        visited = visited | {id(current)}
        if isinstance(current, BaseExceptionGroup):
            return bool(current.exceptions) and all(matches(child, visited) for child in current.exceptions)
        if isinstance(current, (httpx.ConnectError, httpx.ConnectTimeout)) or getattr(
                current, "_nexent_mcp_connection_timeout", False):
            return True
        cause = current.__cause__ or current.__context__
        return matches(cause, visited) if cause is not None else False

    return matches(error, set())


'''
MAPPING = '''    if _blank_mcp_connection_failure(mcp_host, error):
        return json.dumps({"status": "ERROR", "items": [], "citations": [],
                           "knowledge_version": None, "message_code": "CONNECTION_TIMEOUT",
                           "data": {"attempts": 1, "phase": "mcp_connection"}}, ensure_ascii=False)
'''


def patched_source(original):
    if hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() != BASE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("SDK source differs from the pinned v2.7.0 error boundary")
    source = original.decode("utf-8")
    function = next(node for node in ast.parse(source).body
                    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "_agent_run_error_message")
    lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
    # The first body node is the docstring. Keep all existing fallback mappings.
    insert_at = function.body[0].end_lineno
    lines.insert(insert_at, MAPPING)
    lines.insert(function.lineno - 1, HELPERS)
    result = "".join(lines)
    compile(result, TARGET, "exec")
    return result.encode("utf-8")


def prepare_overlay(root=ROOT):
    source = root / "vendor/nexent/sdk/nexent/core/agents/run_agent.py"
    destination = root / ".runtime/overlays/run_agent.py"
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = patched_source(source.read_bytes())
    destination.write_bytes(data)
    return destination, hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def mount_overlay(content, source):
    # Only this known SDK module is mounted; official source and SQL stay intact.
    mount = f'      - "{source.as_posix()}:{TARGET}:ro" # ICT connection error overlay\n'
    if mount in content:
        return content
    anchor = "  nexent-runtime:\n"
    start = content.find(anchor)
    if start < 0:
        return content
    end = content.find("\n  nexent-", start + len(anchor))
    end = len(content) if end < 0 else end
    pos = content.find("    volumes:\n", start, end)
    if pos < 0:
        raise ValueError("Pinned runtime volume boundary is missing")
    pos += len("    volumes:\n")
    return content[:pos] + mount + content[pos:]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="Apply to the existing runtime and restart it")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    destination, digest = prepare_overlay()
    if args.apply:
        code = "import hashlib;from pathlib import Path;print(hashlib.sha256(Path(" + repr(TARGET) + ").read_bytes()).hexdigest())"
        actual = subprocess.check_output(["docker", "exec", "nexent-runtime", "python", "-c", code], text=True, timeout=10).strip()
        if actual not in (BASE_SHA256, digest):
            raise ValueError("Running SDK module differs from both the pinned base and approved overlay")
        if actual != digest:
            subprocess.run(["docker", "cp", str(destination), "nexent-runtime:" + TARGET], check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
            subprocess.run(["docker", "restart", "nexent-runtime"], check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        verified = subprocess.check_output(["docker", "exec", "nexent-runtime", "python", "-c", code], text=True, timeout=10).strip()
        if verified != digest:
            raise RuntimeError("Runtime overlay verification failed")
        record = {"base_sdk_sha256": BASE_SHA256, "overlay_sha256": digest, "runtime_verified": True,
                  "scope": "Blank MCP connection failures only; existing routes, success path and cleanup are preserved",
                  "target": TARGET, "source": "scripts/runtime_error_overlay.py"}
        (ROOT / "evidence/runtime-error-overlay.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print("SDK connection error overlay prepared:", digest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def inspect_sandbox(docker):
    result = subprocess.run([docker, "container", "inspect", NAME], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    if result.returncode:
        # A missing container is normal before the first Agent run. Engine errors
        # must not be mistaken for that initial state.
        if "No such container" in result.stderr or "No such object" in result.stderr:
            return None
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot inspect the runtime sandbox")
    value = json.loads(result.stdout)[0]
    labels = value["Config"].get("Labels") or {}
    if (value["Config"]["Image"] != IMAGE or labels.get("com.nexent.sandbox") != "runtime"
            or labels.get("io.nexent.sandbox.variant") != "lightweight"):
        raise RuntimeError("Runtime sandbox identity differs from the pinned deployment")
    return value

"""Seed page signals from already archived originals, making no new network/freshness claim."""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import observe_html


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update")
    records = []
    for source_id in ("MPS-NORM-01", "MPS-USE-01"):
        with store.db() as db:
            config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (source_id,)).fetchone()[0])
            rows = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT r.*,d.url FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? AND r.rowid IN (SELECT MAX(rowid) FROM revisions GROUP BY document_id)", (source_id,))]
        config["metadata_selectors"] = {"document_fields": {"class": "doc-info"}}
        # Register the changed extraction policy; subsequent checks still pass through robots/rate limits.
        store.register(config)
        for row in rows:
            raw = (store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]).read_bytes()
            if fingerprint(raw) != row["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("Stored original is corrupted")
            metadata = json.loads(row["metadata"])
            if row["state"] != "pending_review":
                raise ValueError("Do not seed observations into already decided business records")
            metadata["source_observation"] = observe_html(raw, config["metadata_selectors"])
            with store.db() as db:
                _, chunks = store._content(db, row["id"])
            target = store.ingest(source_id, row["url"], raw, metadata, chunks)
            records.append({"source_id": source_id, "previous_revision": row["id"], "revision": target,
                "sha256": row["sha256"], "observation": metadata["source_observation"]})
    with store.db() as db:
        configs = [json.loads(r[0]) for r in db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites ORDER BY id")]
    (store.root / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": configs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "real_network_requests_by_this_script": 0,
        "basis": "Previously acquired hash-verified originals, not a new website or current-effectivity check",
        "business_review_completed": False, "official_knowledge_published": 0, "records": records,
        "counts": store.status()["counts"]}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/page-observation-baseline.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"records": len(records), "counts": report["counts"], "network_requests_by_script": 0}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Register existing leads and copy two fingerprint-verified archives as unreviewed candidates."""

import json
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, encode, fingerprint
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REGION = "郑州市二七区"
MATTER = "demo-id-renewal"


def main():
    target = ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update"
    ensure_private_directory(target)
    store = KnowledgeStore.initialize(target)
    scope = json.loads((ROOT / "config/knowledge-scope.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    (target / "scope-regions.json").write_text(encode({scope["region"]: scope["applicable_regions"]}), encoding="utf-8")
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "data/discovery/2026-10-13/source_manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    sources = []
    for record in manifest["records"]:
        url = urlsplit(record["url"])
        matter = ("demo-residence-permit" if record["source_id"].startswith("RES-") else
                  "out-of-scope-temporary-id" if record["source_id"] == "ID-BOUNDARY-01" else
                  "governance-only" if record["intended_role"] == "governance_reference" else
                  "excluded" if record["intended_role"] == "excluded_from_corpus" else MATTER)
        metadata = {"title": record["title"], "region": record["region"], "matter": matter,
                    "document_type": record["document_type"], "published_at": record.get("published_at"),
                    "effective_from": record.get("effective_from"), "effective_to": None,
                    "usage_basis": None, "scope_confirmed": True,
                    "business_review": "pending", "collection_role": record["intended_role"]}
        config = {"id": record["source_id"], "label": record["title"], "enabled": False,
                  "origin": f"{url.scheme}://{url.netloc}", "allowed_paths": [url.path], "seeds": [record["url"]],
                  "interval_seconds": 86400, "delay_seconds": 5, "metadata": metadata,
                  "content_selector": {"id": "content-3394639"} if record["source_id"] == "ID-GUIDE-01" else None,
                  "discover_links": False, "page_kind": "document",
                  "access_review": {"approved": False, "reason": "Current access/usage review pending; historical access is not current authorization"}}
        with store.db() as existing_db:
            existing = existing_db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (config["id"],)).fetchone()
        existing_config = json.loads(existing[0]) if existing else None
        if existing_config and (existing_config["enabled"] or existing_config.get("access_review", {}).get("approved")):
            config = existing_config
        else:
            store.register(config)
        sources.append(config)
    with store.db() as existing_db:
        extra_sources = [json.loads(row[0]) for row in existing_db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites")
                         if json.loads(row[0])["id"] not in {source["id"] for source in sources}]
    (target / "sources.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sources": sources + extra_sources}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    imported = []
    preview = ROOT / ".runtime/m2/mcp/m2.sqlite3"
    if preview.exists():
        with sqlite3.connect(preview.resolve().as_uri()+"?mode=ro", uri=True) as db:
            db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            for sid in ("ID-LAW-01", "ID-GUIDE-01"):
                record = next(r for r in manifest["records"] if r["source_id"] == sid)
                raw = (ROOT / ".runtime/data-discovery/2026-10-13" / (sid+".html")).read_bytes()
                if fingerprint(raw) != record["private_archive"]["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("Historical original fingerprint mismatch")
                source = db.execute("SELECT sha256 FROM sources WHERE source_id=?", (sid,)).fetchone()
                if not source or source[0] != fingerprint(raw):
                    raise ValueError("Preview source does not match original")
                version = db.execute("SELECT version_id FROM chunks WHERE source_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (sid,)).fetchone()
                if not version:
                    raise ValueError("Preview contains no located chunks")
                chunks = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT locator,category,text FROM chunks WHERE source_id=? AND version_id=? ORDER BY rowid", (sid, version[0]))]
                metadata = next(c["metadata"] for c in sources if c["id"] == sid)
                # Preparation is initial seeding, never a request to revert newer observed content.
                with store.db() as target_db:
                    current = target_db.execute("SELECT r.id FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? AND d.url=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (sid, record["url"])).fetchone()
                imported.append(current[0] if current else store.ingest(sid, record["url"], raw, metadata, chunks))
    record = {"prepared_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "scope": {"region": REGION, "matter": MATTER, "confirmation": "User confirmed existing candidate scope on 2026-10-15"},
              "imported_revisions": imported, "counts": store.status()["counts"],
              "network_requests": 0, "official_publications": 0, "business_review_completed": False,
              "note": "Existing two archives copied as pending candidates; no new official documents claimed."}
    (target / "preparation.json").write_text(encode(record), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import shutil
import socket
import threading
from pathlib import Path

import uvicorn

from gov_mcp.extension_server import create_app
from gov_mcp.workbench import create_app as create_workbench
from nexent_api import RUNTIME
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


def main():
    target = RUNTIME / "m1/missing-config"
    ensure_private_directory(target)
    for port in (8768, 8769):
        with socket.socket() as probe:
            probe.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))

    threading.Thread(target=server.run, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        uvicorn.run(create_workbench(target, mcp_url="http://127.0.0.1:8768/sse"),
                    host="127.0.0.1", port=8769, access_log=False)
    finally:
        server.should_exit = True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Bootstrap the team demo without M2/private archives, Docker, or a model."""

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import venv


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="团队离线工程演示；首次初始化需要Python 3.11+和PyPI网络。")
    parser.add_argument("action", choices=["init", "check", "update", "refresh", "query", "serve"])
    parser.add_argument("--runtime", type=Path, default=ROOT / ".runtime/team-demo")
    parser.add_argument("--environment", type=Path, default=ROOT / ".runtime/team-demo-env")
    args, extra = parser.parse_known_args()
    if sys.version_info < (3, 11):
        parser.exit(1, "需要Python 3.11或以上版本。\n")
    environment = args.environment.resolve()
    runtime = args.runtime.resolve()
    if runtime == environment or runtime in environment.parents or environment in runtime.parents:
        parser.exit(1, "演示数据目录与依赖环境目录不能相互包含。\n")
    interpreter = environment / ("Scripts/python.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "bin/python")
    marker = environment / "team-demo-environment.json"
    try:
        if marker.exists():
            if json.loads(marker.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) != {"project": str(ROOT), "mode": "team-demo-environment-v1"}:
                raise ValueError("该依赖目录属于另一项目；请指定新的 --environment。")
            if not interpreter.is_file():
                raise ValueError("演示依赖环境不完整；请指定新的 --environment 后重新 init。")
        else:
            if args.action != "init":
                raise ValueError("请先运行 python scripts/team_demo.py init 初始化演示。")
            if environment.exists() and any(environment.iterdir()):
                raise ValueError("依赖环境目录非空，拒绝覆盖；请指定新的 --environment。")
            if runtime.exists() and any(runtime.iterdir()):
                raise ValueError("演示目录非空，拒绝覆盖；请选择新的 --runtime。")
            print("正在建立独立Python环境并安装项目依赖；不安装模型或注册计划任务。", flush=True)
            venv.EnvBuilder(with_pip=True).create(environment)
            log = environment / "install.log"
            with log.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                completed = subprocess.run([str(interpreter), "-m", "pip", "--disable-pip-version-check",
                    "install", "--no-cache-dir", "-e", str(ROOT)], cwd=ROOT, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            if completed.returncode:
                raise ValueError(f"依赖安装失败，详情见 {log}；修复网络后请指定新的 --environment 重试。")
            marker.write_text(json.dumps({"project": str(ROOT), "mode": "team-demo-environment-v1"}), encoding="utf-8")
            print("独立依赖环境已准备好。", flush=True)
        child = subprocess.Popen([str(interpreter), "-m", "gov_mcp.knowledge_demo", args.action,
                                  "--runtime", str(runtime), *extra], cwd=ROOT)
        try:
            code = child.wait()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            if child.poll() is None:
                child.terminate()
            child.wait(timeout=10)
            code = 0
        raise SystemExit(code)
    except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
        parser.exit(1, f"团队演示准备失败：{error}\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Small, explicitly authorized live test on fixed synthetic inputs; no publication."""
from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import argparse

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT/"src"))
from gov_mcp.classification import ClassificationError, JevProvider, ENDPOINT as OFFICIAL_ENDPOINT, classify_corpus, questions_for, validate_response
from gov_mcp.jev_gateway import VercelJevProvider, MODEL, GATEWAY_MODEL


def corpus_for(cases):
    return {"data_class": "synthetic", "dataset_id": "jev-live-engineering-examples", "assets": [
        {"asset_id": c["id"], "source_id": c["id"], "sha256": hashlib.sha256(c["text"].encode()).hexdigest(),
         "data_class": "synthetic", "title": c["title"], "modality": "text", "segments": [
             {"asset_id": c["id"], "segment_id": c["id"]+"-s1", "content": c["text"], "locator": {"kind": "line", "line": 1}}]}
        for c in cases]}


def set_metrics(pairs):
    tp = sum(len(set(a)&set(b)) for a, b in pairs)
    fp = sum(len(set(a)-set(b)) for a, b in pairs)
    fn = sum(len(set(b)-set(a)) for a, b in pairs)
    return {"exact_matches": sum(set(a)==set(b) for a,b in pairs), "total": len(pairs),
            "true_positive": tp, "false_positive": fp, "false_negative": fn,
            "micro_f1": 2*tp/(2*tp+fp+fn) if 2*tp+fp+fn else 1.0}


def run_suite(provider):
    config = json.loads((ROOT/"config/preparation/classification.json").read_text("utf-8"))
    examples = json.loads((ROOT/"config/preparation/classification.examples.json").read_text("utf-8"))
    if examples["data_class"] != "synthetic" or len(examples["cases"]) != 9: raise ValueError("FIXED_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_REQUIRED")
    cases = examples["cases"]
    report = {"checked_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "status": "running",
        "scope": "direct Jev only, no translation; nine engineering examples, not independent business accuracy",
        "input_translation_enabled": False,
        "data_class": "synthetic", "provider": provider.name, "model": MODEL,
        "endpoint": OFFICIAL_ENDPOINT if provider.name == "jev" else "https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/typesafe/v1/systemone",
        "transport_model": MODEL if provider.name == "jev" else GATEWAY_MODEL,
        "max_http_calls": 32, "max_request_bytes": 16000, "other_model_calls": 0,
        "business_rules_published": False, "workflow_heartbeat_auto_enabled": False}
    try:
        checks = {"supported": "模拟原文是否明确要求提交申请表？", "unsupported": "模拟原文是否明确要求缴费100元？",
                  "contradiction": "模拟原文是否明确表示不用提交申请表？"}
        questions = {k: {"type": "noul", "instructions": v} for k, v in checks.items()}
        smoke = validate_response(provider.evaluate({"data_class": "synthetic", "text": "模拟原文：申请时须提交申请表。仅供工程测试。"}, questions, MODEL), questions, MODEL)
        report["support_smoke"] = {"answers": smoke["answers"], "expected_positive": ["supported"],
            "expected_negative": ["unsupported", "contradiction"], "all_expected":
            smoke["answers"]["supported"]["noul"] >= .8 and all(smoke["answers"][k]["noul"] <= .2 for k in ("unsupported", "contradiction"))}
        run = classify_corpus(corpus_for(cases), config, provider)
        report["classification"] = run
        if run["summary"]["status"] != "completed":
            raise ClassificationError(next(iter(run["summary"]["error_codes"]), "CLASSIFICATION_FAILED"))
        pairs, domains, purposes, routes = [], [], [], []
        for case, record in zip(cases, run["records"]):
            pairs.append({"id": case["id"], "expected_type": case["document_type"], "actual_type": record["document_type"]["choice"],
                          "confidence": record["document_type"]["confidence"], "status": record["status"]})
            domains.append((record["domains"]["labels"], case["domains"]))
            purposes.append((record["purposes"]["labels"], case["purposes"]))
            routes.append((record["routes"], case["routes"]))
        report["metrics"] = {"document_types": {"correct": sum(p["actual_type"]==p["expected_type"] for p in pairs), "total": len(pairs), "cases": pairs},
            "domains": set_metrics(domains), "purposes": set_metrics(purposes), "routes": set_metrics(routes),
            "pending_review_fraction": run["summary"]["pending_review_fraction"]}
        # Reverse only the Choice options: 9 extra requests, not a second full suite.
        reversed_results = []
        for case, original in zip(cases, run["documents"]):
            state = {"title": case["title"], "segments": [{"segment_id": case["id"]+"-s1", "content": case["text"]}]}
            qs = questions_for(config, "document", True)
            answer = validate_response(provider.evaluate(state, qs, MODEL), qs, MODEL)
            choice = answer["answers"]["document_type"]
            reversed_results.append({"id": case["id"], "original": original["windows"][0]["document_type"]["choice"],
                                     "reversed": choice["choice"], "confidence": choice["confidence"]})
        report["option_order"] = {"cases": reversed_results, "changed": sum(r["original"] != r["reversed"] for r in reversed_results), "total": len(cases)}
        originals = {s["segment_id"] for a in corpus_for(cases)["assets"] for s in a["segments"]}
        routed = {s["segment_id"] for bundle in run["bundles"].values() for s in bundle}
        report["all_originals_preserved"] = originals == routed
        report["status"] = "completed"  # Quality metrics are reported separately; not a quality pass.
    except ClassificationError as error:
        report.update(status="blocked" if str(error) in {"MISSING_API_KEY", "PAYMENT_REQUIRED", "ACCESS_DENIED", "AUTHENTICATION_FAILED", "ACCESS_RESTRICTED"} else "failed", error_code=str(error))
    report["http_attempts"] = provider.attempts
    report["receipts"] = deepcopy(provider.receipts)
    report["known_success_cost_usd"] = str(provider.known_cost) if hasattr(provider, "known_cost") else None
    report["cost_complete"] = bool(provider.receipts) and all(r["status"] == "ok" and r["cost_usd"] is not None for r in provider.receipts)
    report["cost_scope"] = ("official response token usage only; monetary cost unknown, verify TypeSafe billing"
        if provider.name == "jev" else "reported successful-response cost only; failed attempts may also be billed")
    return report


def create_provider(provider_name, key_file=None):
    """Credentials are provider-specific; never reuse a gateway key for TypeSafe."""
    field = "TYPESAFE_API_KEY" if provider_name == "jev" else "AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY"
    key = os.environ.get(field, "")
    if not key and key_file is not None and key_file.exists():
        key = json.loads(key_file.read_text("utf-8-sig")).get(field, "")
    return JevProvider(key, max_calls=32) if provider_name == "jev" else VercelJevProvider(key)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--live", action="store_true", help="Explicitly allow Jev network calls on synthetic examples")
    parser.add_argument("--provider", choices=["jev", "vercel_jev_live"], default="jev", help="Default: TypeSafe official API; gateway requires explicit selection")
    parser.add_argument("--key-file", type=Path, help="Optional server-side JSON with the selected provider's credential field")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.live: parser.error("--live is required; ordinary regression tests never call providers")
    key_file = args.key_file or ROOT/(".runtime/jev/official.credentials.json" if args.provider == "jev" else ".runtime/jev/credentials.json")
    output = args.output or ROOT/("evidence/jev-official/latest.json" if args.provider == "jev" else "evidence/jev-live/latest.json")
    report = run_suite(create_provider(args.provider, key_file))
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sources = [ROOT/"src/gov_mcp/jev_gateway.py", ROOT/"src/gov_mcp/classification.py", Path(__file__).resolve(),
               ROOT/"config/preparation/classification.json", ROOT/"config/preparation/classification.examples.json"]
    report["source_sha256"] = {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sources}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+"\n", "utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: report.get(k) for k in ("status", "error_code", "http_attempts", "known_success_cost_usd")}, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0 if report["status"] == "completed" else 1

"""Bounded natural-clock heartbeat and official candidate update test, no models."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'src'))
from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import Fetcher, AccessStopped, schedule, worker_once
from gov_mcp.knowledge_lock import process_lock
from gov_mcp.public_preview import read, write, source_digest
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory
from run_new_knowledge_experiment import configured_proxy_request
from check_project_heartbeat import inspect

RUNTIME = ROOT / '.runtime/heartbeat-update-experiment-20261018'
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'evidence/heartbeat-update-experiment'
SOURCE = 'NJ-ID-RENEWAL-CYCLE-2026'
OWNER = 'knowledge-live-heartbeat-test'


class BoundedOfficialFetcher(Fetcher):
    def __init__(self, store):
        super().__init__(store)
        self.requests = []

    def _request(self, url, headers):
        # This transport only allows the two existing fixed official hosts and
        # paths. Fetcher's source policy narrows this test to Nanjing alone.
        if len(self.requests) >= 4:
            raise AccessStopped('Bounded experiment HTTP budget exhausted')
        record = {'at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'url': url}
        self.requests.append(record)
        try:
            status, response_headers, raw = configured_proxy_request(url, headers)
            record.update(http_status=status, bytes=len(raw), sha256=source_digest(raw),
                          conditional_request=bool(headers))
            if url.endswith('/robots.txt'):
                (RUNTIME / ('robots-' + str(len(self.requests)) + '.txt')).write_bytes(raw)
            return status, response_headers, raw
        except Exception as error:
            record.update(error_type=type(error).__name__)
            raise AccessStopped('Live transport failed; no automatic retry') from None


def configure(store):
    snapshot = read(ROOT / '.runtime/new-knowledge-experiment-20261018/snapshot.json')
    binding = next(b for b in snapshot['bindings'] if b['spec']['source_id'] == SOURCE)
    spec = binding['spec']
    basis = 'Official public text; private bounded engineering update test; no business review or publication'
    config = {'id': SOURCE, 'label': 'Nanjing official renewal cycle bounded update test', 'enabled': True,
        'origin': 'https://www.nanjing.gov.cn', 'allowed_paths': ['/hdjl/hygq/202601/t20260105_5757179.html'],
        'seeds': [spec['url']], 'interval_seconds': 60, 'delay_seconds': 5, 'discover_links': False,
        'content_selector': spec['selector'], 'metadata': dict(binding['document']['metadata'],
            effective_from=None, effective_to=None, usage_basis=basis, scope_confirmed=False),
        'access_review': {'approved': True, 'reviewer': 'codex_automated_technical_access_screen',
            'actor_kind': 'machine', 'checked_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'usage_basis': basis, 'business_review_completed': False, 'purpose': 'bounded_private_engineering_test'}}
    store.register(config)
    return binding


def observe(store, started):
    with store.db() as db:
        worker = db.execute('SELECT heartbeat,progress FROM workers WHERE id=?', (OWNER,)).fetchone()
        counts = {name: db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' + name).fetchone()[0]
                  for name in ('documents', 'revisions', 'chunks', 'reviews', 'versions', 'heads')}
        jobs = [dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT id,state,attempts,error FROM jobs')]
        source = dict(db.execute('SELECT last_success,next_check,paused_reason FROM sites WHERE id=?', (SOURCE,)).fetchone())
    return {'elapsed_seconds': round(time.monotonic()-started, 3), 'observed_at': time.time(),
            'worker': dict(worker) if worker else None, 'counts': counts, 'jobs': jobs, 'source': source}


def resume_due_check():
    prior = read(OUTPUT / 'live-result.json')
    marker = RUNTIME / 'timing-repair.json'
    failed = {key for key, value in prior['checks'].items() if not value}
    if (marker.exists() or failed != {'two_scheduled_official_checks'} or len(prior['requests']) != 2
            or any(r.get('http_status') != 200 for r in prior['requests'])):
        raise ValueError('Repair only allowed once for an early tick after successful HTTP; no remote failure retry')
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME)
    binding = next(b for b in read(ROOT / '.runtime/new-knowledge-experiment-20261018/snapshot.json')['bindings']
                   if b['spec']['source_id'] == SOURCE)
    with process_lock(RUNTIME / 'worker.lock') as acquired:
        if not acquired:
            raise ValueError('Existing worker preserved')
        with store.db() as db:
            source = db.execute('SELECT paused_reason,next_check FROM sites WHERE id=?', (SOURCE,)).fetchone()
        if source['paused_reason'] != 'Bounded experiment completed; no recurring task registered':
            raise ValueError('External or operator pause must not be cleared')
        delay = source['next_check']-time.time()+0.02
        if delay > 60:
            raise ValueError('Unexpected future due time; no forced scheduling')
        write(OUTPUT / 'before-timing-repair.json', prior)
        write(marker, {'reason': 'Tick was 5.5ms before persisted next_check; wait for the real due time',
                       'http_budget_total': 4, 'time_or_due_mutations': False})
        fetcher = BoundedOfficialFetcher(store)
        fetcher.requests = prior['requests']
        observations, snapshots = prior['observations'], prior['existing_service_heartbeats']
        try:
            if delay > 0:
                time.sleep(delay)
            with store.db() as db:
                db.execute('UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=NULL WHERE id=?', (SOURCE,))
            schedule(store)
            worker_once(store, fetcher, owner=OWNER)
            observation = observe(store, time.monotonic())
            observation['elapsed_seconds'] = round(observation['observed_at']-observations[0]['observed_at']+observations[0]['elapsed_seconds'], 3)
            observation['timing_repair'] = True
            observations.append(observation)
            snapshots.append(inspect())
        finally:
            with store.db() as db:
                db.execute("UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=COALESCE(paused_reason,'Bounded experiment completed; no recurring task registered') WHERE id=?", (SOURCE,))
                db.execute("UPDATE workers SET progress='completed' WHERE id=?", (OWNER,))
                store.log(db, 'bounded_test_stopped', {'source': SOURCE, 'http_attempts': len(fetcher.requests)})
        return finish_report(store, binding, fetcher, observations, snapshots)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--live', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--resume-due-check', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.live == args.resume_due_check:
        parser.error('Choose initial --live or the once-only diagnosed --resume-due-check')
    if args.resume_due_check:
        return resume_due_check()
    if RUNTIME.exists() and any(RUNTIME.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError('Prior experiment preserved; no automatic reset or repeated live test')
    store = KnowledgeStore.initialize(RUNTIME)
    ensure_private_directory(RUNTIME)
    binding = configure(store)
    fetcher = BoundedOfficialFetcher(store)
    observations, snapshots = [], []
    with process_lock(RUNTIME / 'worker.lock') as acquired:
        if not acquired:
            raise ValueError('Another bounded test owns this runtime')
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            for tick in range(3):
                remaining = started + tick*30 - time.monotonic()
                if tick == 2:
                    with store.db() as db:
                        due = db.execute('SELECT next_check FROM sites WHERE id=?', (SOURCE,)).fetchone()[0]
                    remaining = max(remaining, due-time.time()+0.02)
                if remaining > 0:
                    time.sleep(remaining)
                # No fabricated clock, forced next_check or direct ingestion.
                schedule(store)
                worker_once(store, fetcher, owner=OWNER)
                observations.append(observe(store, started))
                snapshots.append(inspect())
                write(RUNTIME / 'observations.json', observations)
                print(json.dumps({'tick': tick+1, 'elapsed': observations[-1]['elapsed_seconds'],
                                  'counts': observations[-1]['counts'], 'jobs': observations[-1]['jobs']}), flush=True)
                if any(job['error'] for job in observations[-1]['jobs']):
                    break
        finally:
            with store.db() as db:
                db.execute("UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=COALESCE(paused_reason,'Bounded experiment completed; no recurring task registered') WHERE id=?", (SOURCE,))
                db.execute("UPDATE workers SET progress='completed' WHERE id=?", (OWNER,))
                store.log(db, 'bounded_test_stopped', {'source': SOURCE, 'http_attempts': len(fetcher.requests)})
        return finish_report(store, binding, fetcher, observations, snapshots)


def finish_report(store, binding, fetcher, observations, snapshots):
    with store.db() as db:
        audit = [{'at': row['at'], 'action': row['action'], 'data': json.loads(row['data'])}
                 for row in db.execute('SELECT * FROM audit ORDER BY id')]
        latest = db.execute('SELECT id FROM revisions ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1').fetchone()
        verified = None
        if latest:
            row, _ = store._verify(db, latest[0], require_review=False)
            _, chunks = store._content(db, row['id'])
            expected = binding['document']['selected_clauses']
            verified = {'raw_matches_shared_catalog': row['sha256'] == binding['spec']['original_sha256'],
                'all_quotes_match': len(chunks) == len(expected) and all(
                    c['locator'] == e['locator'] and source_digest(c['text'].encode()) == e['text_sha256'] for c,e in zip(chunks,expected)),
                'revision_state': row['state']}
    success = [a for a in audit if a['action'] == 'check_succeeded']
    checks = {'three_real_clock_heartbeats': len(observations) >= 3 and observations[-1]['elapsed_seconds'] >= 60,
        'worker_heartbeat_advances': len(observations) >= 3 and observations[-1]['worker']['heartbeat'] > observations[0]['worker']['heartbeat'],
        'two_scheduled_official_checks': len(success) == 2,
        'unchanged_source_no_duplicate_revision': len(observations) >= 3 and observations[0]['counts']['revisions'] == observations[-1]['counts']['revisions'] == 1,
        'official_original_and_quotes_match': bool(verified and verified['raw_matches_shared_catalog'] and verified['all_quotes_match']),
        'candidate_only': bool(verified and verified['revision_state'] == 'pending_review') and
            all(o['counts']['reviews'] == o['counts']['versions'] == o['counts']['heads'] == 0 for o in observations)}
    result = {'status': 'PASS_BOUNDED_UPDATE' if all(checks.values()) else 'INCOMPLETE', 'checks': checks,
        'observations': observations, 'existing_service_heartbeats': snapshots, 'requests': fetcher.requests,
        'candidate_verification': verified, 'audit': audit, 'model_calls': 0, 'permanent_schedule_created': False,
        'test_source_paused_after_completion': True,
        'limits': 'About one minute of natural-clock candidate acquisition/recheck; no observed official policy change, no formal publication or long-term uptime claim'}
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write(OUTPUT / 'live-result.json', result)
    print(json.dumps({'status': result['status'], 'checks': checks, 'http_attempts': len(fetcher.requests)}), flush=True)
    return 0 if all(checks.values()) else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

def resume_due_check():
    prior = read(OUTPUT / 'live-result.json')
    marker = RUNTIME / 'timing-repair.json'
    failed = {key for key, value in prior['checks'].items() if not value}
    if (marker.exists() or failed != {'two_scheduled_official_checks'} or len(prior['requests']) != 2
            or any(r.get('http_status') != 200 for r in prior['requests'])):
        raise ValueError('Repair only allowed once for an early tick after successful HTTP; no remote failure retry')
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME)
    binding = next(b for b in read(ROOT / '.runtime/new-knowledge-experiment-20261018/snapshot.json')['bindings']
                   if b['spec']['source_id'] == SOURCE)
    with process_lock(RUNTIME / 'worker.lock') as acquired:
        if not acquired:
            raise ValueError('Existing worker preserved')
        with store.db() as db:
            source = db.execute('SELECT paused_reason,next_check FROM sites WHERE id=?', (SOURCE,)).fetchone()
        if source['paused_reason'] != 'Bounded experiment completed; no recurring task registered':
            raise ValueError('External or operator pause must not be cleared')
        delay = source['next_check']-time.time()+0.02
        if delay > 60:
            raise ValueError('Unexpected future due time; no forced scheduling')
        write(OUTPUT / 'before-timing-repair.json', prior)
        write(marker, {'reason': 'Tick was 5.5ms before persisted next_check; wait for the real due time',
                       'http_budget_total': 4, 'time_or_due_mutations': False})
        fetcher = BoundedOfficialFetcher(store)
        fetcher.requests = prior['requests']
        observations, snapshots = prior['observations'], prior['existing_service_heartbeats']
        try:
            if delay > 0:
                time.sleep(delay)
            with store.db() as db:
                db.execute('UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=NULL WHERE id=?', (SOURCE,))
            schedule(store)
            worker_once(store, fetcher, owner=OWNER)
            observation = observe(store, time.monotonic())
            observation['elapsed_seconds'] = round(observation['observed_at']-observations[0]['observed_at']+observations[0]['elapsed_seconds'], 3)
            observation['timing_repair'] = True
            observations.append(observation)
            snapshots.append(inspect())
        finally:
            with store.db() as db:
                db.execute("UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=COALESCE(paused_reason,'Bounded experiment completed; no recurring task registered') WHERE id=?", (SOURCE,))
                db.execute("UPDATE workers SET progress='completed' WHERE id=?", (OWNER,))
                store.log(db, 'bounded_test_stopped', {'source': SOURCE, 'http_attempts': len(fetcher.requests)})
        return finish_report(store, binding, fetcher, observations, snapshots)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--live', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--resume-due-check', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.live == args.resume_due_check:
        parser.error('Choose initial --live or the once-only diagnosed --resume-due-check')
    if args.resume_due_check:
        return resume_due_check()
    if RUNTIME.exists() and any(RUNTIME.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError('Prior experiment preserved; no automatic reset or repeated live test')
    store = KnowledgeStore.initialize(RUNTIME)
    ensure_private_directory(RUNTIME)
    binding = configure(store)
    fetcher = BoundedOfficialFetcher(store)
    observations, snapshots = [], []
    with process_lock(RUNTIME / 'worker.lock') as acquired:
        if not acquired:
            raise ValueError('Another bounded test owns this runtime')
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            for tick in range(3):
                remaining = started + tick*30 - time.monotonic()
                if tick == 2:
                    with store.db() as db:
                        due = db.execute('SELECT next_check FROM sites WHERE id=?', (SOURCE,)).fetchone()[0]
                    remaining = max(remaining, due-time.time()+0.02)
                if remaining > 0:
                    time.sleep(remaining)
                # No fabricated clock, forced next_check or direct ingestion.
                schedule(store)
                worker_once(store, fetcher, owner=OWNER)
                observations.append(observe(store, started))
                snapshots.append(inspect())
                write(RUNTIME / 'observations.json', observations)
                print(json.dumps({'tick': tick+1, 'elapsed': observations[-1]['elapsed_seconds'],
                                  'counts': observations[-1]['counts'], 'jobs': observations[-1]['jobs']}), flush=True)
                if any(job['error'] for job in observations[-1]['jobs']):
                    break
        finally:
            with store.db() as db:
                db.execute("UPDATE sites SET paused_reason=COALESCE(paused_reason,'Bounded experiment completed; no recurring task registered') WHERE id=?", (SOURCE,))
                db.execute("UPDATE workers SET progress='completed' WHERE id=?", (OWNER,))
                store.log(db, 'bounded_test_stopped', {'source': SOURCE, 'http_attempts': len(fetcher.requests)})
        return finish_report(store, binding, fetcher, observations, snapshots)

def finish_report(store, binding, fetcher, observations, snapshots):
    with store.db() as db:
        audit = [{'at': row['at'], 'action': row['action'], 'data': json.loads(row['data'])}
                 for row in db.execute('SELECT * FROM audit ORDER BY id')]
        latest = db.execute('SELECT id FROM revisions ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1').fetchone()
        verified = None
        if latest:
            row, _ = store._verify(db, latest[0], require_review=False)
            _, chunks = store._content(db, row['id'])
            expected = binding['document']['selected_clauses']
            verified = {'raw_matches_shared_catalog': row['sha256'] == binding['spec']['original_sha256'],
                'all_quotes_match': len(chunks) == len(expected) and all(
                    c['locator'] == e['locator'] and source_digest(c['text'].encode()) == e['text_sha256'] for c,e in zip(chunks,expected)),
                'revision_state': row['state']}
    success = [a for a in audit if a['action'] == 'check_succeeded']
    checks = {'three_real_clock_heartbeats': len(observations) >= 3 and observations[-1]['elapsed_seconds'] >= 60,
        'worker_heartbeat_advances': len(observations) >= 3 and observations[-1]['worker']['heartbeat'] > observations[0]['worker']['heartbeat'],
        'two_scheduled_official_checks': len(success) == 2,
        'unchanged_source_no_duplicate_revision': len(observations) >= 3 and observations[0]['counts']['revisions'] == observations[-1]['counts']['revisions'] == 1,
        'official_original_and_quotes_match': bool(verified and verified['raw_matches_shared_catalog'] and verified['all_quotes_match']),
        'candidate_only': bool(verified and verified['revision_state'] == 'pending_review') and
            all(o['counts']['reviews'] == o['counts']['versions'] == o['counts']['heads'] == 0 for o in observations)}
    result = {'status': 'PASS_BOUNDED_UPDATE' if all(checks.values()) else 'INCOMPLETE', 'checks': checks,
        'observations': observations, 'existing_service_heartbeats': snapshots, 'requests': fetcher.requests,
        'candidate_verification': verified, 'audit': audit, 'model_calls': 0, 'permanent_schedule_created': False,
        'test_source_paused_after_completion': True,
        'limits': 'About one minute of natural-clock candidate acquisition/recheck; no observed official policy change, no formal publication or long-term uptime claim'}
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write(OUTPUT / 'live-result.json', result)
    print(json.dumps({'status': result['status'], 'checks': checks, 'http_attempts': len(fetcher.requests)}), flush=True)
    return 0 if all(checks.values()) else 1
