"""Check actual publisher discovery, dated source relations and restored evidence."""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import httpx

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import parse_html, select_paragraph_keywords
from gov_mcp.knowledge_review import development_registry
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from record_duration_update_assessment import SOURCES, EXCLUSIONS


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    assessment = json.loads((ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/duration-update-assessments.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    supplement = json.loads((ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/duration-reference-supplement.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    backup = json.loads((ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/full-backup-restore.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    restored = KnowledgeStore(backup["restore"]["restored_to"], read_only=True)
    checks = {"assessment_and_supplement_hashes_match": True, "latest_source_originals_and_restore_match": True,
        "all_literal_anchors_match": True, "six_hour_directory_and_daily_owner_use_normal_jobs": True,
        "two_index_pages_and_explicit_owner_deduplication": True, "deployed_background_worker_processed_owner": True,
        "2026_selection_and_three_date_layers_preserved": True,
        "scope_exclusions_are_verified_and_not_repeal_claims": True, "ai_and_development_status_truthful": True,
        "old_development_references_and_model_results_preserved": True, "publication_policy_and_registry_preserved": True,
        "no_approvals_or_published_versions_created": True, "live_read_only_service_retains_stop": True}
    for value, key in ((assessment,"assessment_sha256"), (supplement,"content_sha256")):
        checks["assessment_and_supplement_hashes_match"] &= fingerprint({k:v for k,v in value.items() if k != key}) == value[key]
    with store.db() as db, restored.db() as saved:
        for key, (source_id, url) in SOURCES.items():
            binding = assessment["sources"][key]
            row, _ = store._verify(db, binding["revision"], require_review=False)
            copy, _ = restored._verify(saved, binding["revision"], require_review=False)
            latest = db.execute("SELECT r.id FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? AND d.url=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (source_id,url)).fetchone()[0]
            checks["latest_source_originals_and_restore_match"] &= latest == row["id"] and row["sha256"] == binding["original_sha256"] and row["body_sha256"] == binding["body_sha256"] and dict(row) == dict(copy)
            if key in EXCLUSIONS:
                store._verify_exclusion(db, row["id"])
                restored._verify_exclusion(saved, row["id"])
                reason = db.execute("SELECT reason FROM exclusions WHERE revision_id=?", (row["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                checks["scope_exclusions_are_verified_and_not_repeal_claims"] &= reason == EXCLUSIONS[key]
        for finding in assessment["findings"]:
            checks["ai_and_development_status_truthful"] &= finding["business_release_approval"] is False
            for anchor in finding["anchors"]:
                row = db.execute("SELECT locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? AND ordinal=?", (anchor["revision"],anchor["ordinal"])).fetchone()
                copy = saved.execute("SELECT locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? AND ordinal=?", (anchor["revision"],anchor["ordinal"])).fetchone()
                text = row["text"]
                checks["all_literal_anchors_match"] &= (anchor["revision"] == assessment["sources"][anchor["source_key"]]["revision"] and tuple(row) == tuple(copy)
                    and row["locator"] == anchor["locator"] and 0 <= anchor["start"] < anchor["end"] <= len(text)
                    and fingerprint(text.encode()) == anchor["parent_text_sha256"] and fingerprint(text[anchor["start"]:anchor["end"]].encode()) == anchor["span_sha256"])
        index = db.execute("SELECT * FROM sites WHERE id='HN-INTERPRETATION-DISCOVERY'").fetchone()
        owner = db.execute("SELECT * FROM sites WHERE id='HN-MEASURES-2026'").fetchone()
        ic, oc = json.loads(index["config"]), json.loads(owner["config"])
        jobs = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,site_id,state,error,owner FROM jobs WHERE site_id IN ('HN-INTERPRETATION-DISCOVERY','HN-MEASURES-2026')")]
        checks["six_hour_directory_and_daily_owner_use_normal_jobs"] = (ic["enabled"] and oc["enabled"] and ic["interval_seconds"] == 21600 and oc["interval_seconds"] == 86400
            and index["last_success"] is not None and owner["last_success"] is not None and not index["paused_reason"] and not owner["paused_reason"]
            and len(jobs) == 8 and all(j["state"] == "done" and not j["error"] for j in jobs))
        cycle = db.execute("SELECT MAX(id) FROM discovery_cycles WHERE site_id=?", (index["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        visits = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT url,kind FROM discovery_visits WHERE cycle_id=?", (cycle,))]
        checks["two_index_pages_and_explicit_owner_deduplication"] = (sum(v["kind"] == "index" for v in visits) == 2 and ic["discovery_max_pages"] == 3 and ic["discovery_max_links"] == 10
            and ic["discovery_document_owners"] == {SOURCES["HN2026"][1]: "HN-MEASURES-2026"}
            and db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE url=?", (SOURCES["HN2026"][1],)).fetchone()[0] == 1)
        binding = assessment["sources"]["HN2026"]
        row, chunks = store._content(db, binding["revision"])
        metadata = json.loads(row["metadata"])
        original = store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]
        parsed,_ = parse_html(original.read_bytes(),oc["content_selector"])
        selected = select_paragraph_keywords(parsed,oc["include_paragraph_keywords"],oc["paragraph_expected_count"])
        fields = metadata["source_observation"]["fields"]
        checks["deployed_background_worker_processed_owner"] = any(j["site_id"] == "HN-MEASURES-2026" and j["owner"] == "knowledge-worker" and j["state"] == "done" for j in jobs) and "meta:lastmodifiedtime" in fields
        checks["2026_selection_and_three_date_layers_preserved"] = (selected == chunks and len(chunks) == 2
            and fields["block:page_date"] == ["2026-05-05"] and fields["meta:lastmodifiedtime"] == ["2026-05-11 09:23"]
            and metadata["effective_from"] is None and metadata["published_at"] is None and not metadata["scope_confirmed"]
            and "从受理之日起到领证之日" in chunks[0]["text"] and "本省户籍居民" in chunks[0]["text"]
            and "中考、高考特殊时期急需用证考生" in chunks[0]["text"] and "5个工作日" in chunks[0]["text"])
        checks["no_approvals_or_published_versions_created"] = all(db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "+name).fetchone()[0] == 0 for name in ("reviews","snapshot_evaluations","versions","heads"))
        checks["publication_policy_and_registry_preserved"] = fingerprint((store.root/"publication-policy.json").read_bytes()) == assessment["policy_file_sha256"] and development_registry(db) == development_registry(saved) and len(development_registry(db)) == 40
    for name, expected in assessment["preserved_development_files"].items():
        checks["old_development_references_and_model_results_preserved"] &= fingerprint((ROOT/name).read_bytes()) == expected
    checks["ai_and_development_status_truthful"] &= (assessment["reviewer_kind"] == supplement["author_kind"] == "ai" and not assessment["human_review_completed"]
        and not assessment["business_release_ready"] and not supplement["ready_for_business_publication"]

"""Verify a saved public rendered guide separately from an HTTP shell or approved corpus."""
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    private = store.root / "source-research/erqi-portal-guide-20261018"
    before = read(private / "before-main.json")
    if store.status()["counts"] != before["counts"]:
        raise SystemExit("主库已有后续更新；保留最初网页观察阶段回执，不用当前状态覆盖")
    report = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/erqi-rendered-guide-observation-20261018.json")
    raw = (private / "guide-dom-snapshot.txt").read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    receipt = read(private / "normal-fetch-receipt.json")
    response = (private / "normal-response.html").read_bytes()
    materials = text.split("  - generic: 申请材料\n", 1)[1].split("  - generic: 收费信息\n", 1)[0]
    row = next(line.strip()[7:-2] for line in materials.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('- row "1 '))
    source = report["source"]
    checks = {
        "report_digest_matches": fingerprint({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "content_sha256"}) == report["content_sha256"],
        "rendered_capture_digest_and_anchors_match": fingerprint(raw) == report["rendered_capture"]["sha256"] and len(raw) == report["rendered_capture"]["bytes"] and all(anchor["text"] in text and fingerprint(anchor["text"].encode()) == anchor["text_sha256"] for anchor in report["anchors"]),
        "exact_region_authority_local_variant_bound": source["url"] == receipt["url"] and source["url"].endswith("9BA34BC110B96284D26CE82456A51500?region=410103000000") and 'generic "郑州市二七区"' in text and 'generic: 申领居民身份证（换领）' in text and 'cell "郑州市公安局二七分局"' in text and source["away_variant_selected"] is False,
        "single_material_row_reproduced_without_unconditional_waiver": report["material_table"]["rendered_row"] == row and sum(line.strip().startswith('- row "1 ') for line in materials.splitlines()) == 1 and '居民户口簿' not in materials and report["conclusions"]["household_book_unconditionally_waived"] is False,
        "normal_http_shell_not_rendered_guide_original": receipt == report["normal_fetch_attempt"] and receipt["status"] == 200 and fingerprint(response) == receipt["sha256"] == "6da53882860f1e469292f932ec3f4ddbeeba2c4df964581411c527d628192eb1" and not any(receipt[k] for k in ["contains_guide_title", "contains_implementation_authority", "contains_material_row"]) and source["guide_body_normally_acquired"] is False and source["guide_original_sha256"] is None,
        "date_download_screenshot_and_popovers_not_invented": source["publication_date"] is None and source["update_date"] is None and all(report["unconfirmed"][k] is False for k in ["guide_download_obtained", "screenshot_saved", "material_popovers_read", "sample_doc_obtained"]),
        "conflicts_and_branch_limits_retained": {r["id"] for r in report["limitations"]} == {"household_book_relationship", "statutory_days", "fee_exemption", "online_and_service_time", "away_faq", "template_quality"} and all(r["unresolved"] for r in report["limitations"]) and all(v is False for v in report["conclusions"].values()),
        "draft_and_scope_files_unchanged": all(fingerprint((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == sha for path, sha in before["file_sha256"].items()),
        "main_corpus_counts_unchanged": store.status()["counts"] == before["counts"],
    }
    with store.db() as db:
        checks["source_configs_and_gate_rows_unchanged"] = {r["id"]: fingerprint(r["config"].encode()) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,config FROM sites")} == before["configs"] and {t: db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM " + t).fetchone()[0] for t in before["gates"]} == before["gates"]
        checks["observation_not_inserted_in_candidate_corpus"] = db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE url=?", (source["url"],)).fetchone()[0] == 0
    result = {"schema": 1, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks, "counts": store.status()["counts"], "new_rendered_guide_observations": 1, "new_normally_archived_guide_originals": 0, "business_approvals": 0, "business_publications": 0, "limits": "Local saved-capture provenance and preservation checks only; no policy currentness, unconditional material waiver or independent business acceptance certified."}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/erqi-rendered-guide-observation-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not result["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify the captured Erqi time explanations and preserve the reviewed comparison sources."""
import io
import json
import re
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from verify_erqi_material_capture import dialog_body, jpeg_dimensions


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    private = store.root / "source-research/erqi-service-metadata-20261018"
    before = read(private / "before-main.json")
    report = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/erqi-service-metadata-capture-20261018.json")
    expected = dict(before["counts"])
    for key, value in {"revisions": 1, "chunks": 6, "latest_chunks": 3}.items():
        expected[key] += value
    if store.status()["counts"] != expected:
        raise SystemExit("主库已有后续更新或数量差异；保留时限取证阶段回执，先核对当前状态")
    backup = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/full-backup-restore.json")
    restored = KnowledgeStore(backup["restore"]["restored_to"], read_only=True)
    with store.db() as db:
        row, _ = store._verify(db, report["revision"], require_review=False)
        _, chunks = store._content(db, row["id"])
        prior, _ = store._verify(db, report["prior_revision"], require_review=False)
        _, old_chunks = store._content(db, prior["id"])
        config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (report["source_id"],)).fetchone()[0])
        metadata = json.loads(row["metadata"])
        configs = {r["id"]: fingerprint(r["config"].encode()) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,config FROM sites")}
        old_revisions = {r["id"]: fingerprint(dict(r)) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM revisions WHERE id<>?", (row["id"],))}
        gates = {t: [fingerprint(dict(r)) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM " + t)] for t in before["gates"]}
        latest = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        comparison = True
        comparison_texts = []
        for binding in report["existing_reviewed_comparison_bindings"]:
            original, _ = store._verify(db, binding["revision"])
            _, parts = store._content(db, original["id"])
            selected = next(c for c in parts if c["locator"] == binding["locator"])
            doc = db.execute("SELECT site_id,url FROM documents WHERE id=?", (original["document_id"],)).fetchone()
            current = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (original["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            comparison &= current == binding["revision"] and doc["site_id"] == binding["source_id"] and doc["url"] == binding["url"] and original["sha256"] == binding["original_sha256"] and fingerprint(selected["text"].encode()) == binding["text_sha256"]
            comparison_texts.append(selected["text"])
    raw = (store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]).read_bytes()
    prior_raw = (store.root / "originals" / prior["sha256"][:2] / prior["sha256"]).read_bytes()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
        manifest = json.loads(archive.read("capture-manifest.json"))
        assets = {name: archive.read(name) for name in archive.namelist() if name != "capture-manifest.json"}
        unique_members = len(archive.namelist()) == len(assets) + 1 == 10
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(prior_raw)) as archive:
        prior_assets = {name: archive.read(name) for name in archive.namelist() if name != "capture-manifest.json"}
    expanded = assets["expanded-basic-ax.txt"].decode("utf-8")
    start = expanded.index("heading 编码信息, Value: 3")
    code_section = expanded[start:expanded.index("161 link Description: 收起", start)]
    codes = re.findall(r"^\s+\d+ text (.+)$", code_section, re.M)
    expected_texts = ["\n".join(codes), dialog_body(assets["commitment-explanation-ax.txt"], "承诺办理时限"), dialog_body(assets["statutory-explanation-ax.txt"], "法定办理时限")]
    catalog_entry = next(r for r in read(ROOT / "data/knowledge/candidate-catalog.json")["documents"] if r["source_id"] == report["source_id"])
    checks = {
        "report_and_private_receipt_match": fingerprint({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "content_sha256"}) == report["content_sha256"] and {k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "content_sha256"} == read(private / "archive-receipt.json"),
        "latest_capture_bundle_and_all_assets_bound": latest == row["id"] and raw == (private / "capture-bundle.zip").read_bytes() and fingerprint(raw) == report["capture_archive_sha256"] == row["sha256"] and len(raw) == report["capture_archive_bytes"] and unique_members and manifest == report["manifest"] == metadata["source_observation"]["capture_manifest"] and manifest["file_inventory"] == {name: {"bytes": len(value), "sha256": fingerprint(value)} for name, value in assets.items()},
        "previous_assets_and_all_three_material_chunks_preserved": all(assets[name] == value for name, value in prior_assets.items()) and chunks[:3] == old_chunks and len(old_chunks) == 3,
        "three_new_complete_literal_selections_match": [c["text"] for c in chunks[3:]] == expected_texts and report["new_selected_clauses"] == [{"locator": c["locator"], "text_sha256": fingerprint(c["text"].encode()), "characters": len(c["text"])} for c in chunks[3:]],
        "specific_item_identity_codes_bound": codes[0] == "编码信息" and len(codes) == 9 and dict(zip(codes[1::2], codes[2::2])) == report["visible_codes"] == metadata["source_observation"]["service_metadata"]["visible_codes"] and report["visible_codes"]["业务办理项编码"] == "11410100MB1K20802F400070911000201",
        "time_labels_exclusions_and_statute_reference_kept_separate": "text 60个工作日" in expanded and "text 6个工作日" in expanded and "补件、上报（转报）" in expected_texts[1] and expected_texts[2] == "《中华人民共和国居民身份证法》第十二条" and report["visible_time_labels"] == {"commitment_workdays": 6, "statutory_workdays": 60},
        "new_dialogs_bound_to_same_region_authority_and_source": all(report["url"] in assets[name].decode("utf-8") and "郑州市二七区" in assets[name].decode("utf-8") and "郑州市公安局二七分局" in assets[name].decode("utf-8") for name in ["expanded-basic-ax.txt", "commitment-explanation-ax.txt", "statutory-explanation-ax.txt"]),
        "observed_screenshot_retained_as_jpeg": jpeg_dimensions(assets["commitment-explanation.jpg"]) == (1280, 720) and assets["commitment-explanation.jpg"] == (private / "commitment-explanation.jpg").read_bytes(),
        "reviewed_law_and_provincial_end_to_end_measure_remain_current_bindings": comparison and len(comparison_texts) == 2 and "之日起六十日内" in comparison_texts[0] and "从受理之日起到领证之日" in comparison_texts[1] and "15个工作日" in comparison_texts[1],
        "capture_is_pending_with_conflicts_dates_and_coverage_unapproved": row["state"] == "pending_review" and metadata["scope_confirmed"] is False and metadata["conflict"] is True and all(metadata[k] is None for k in ["published_at", "effective_from", "effective_to"]) and metadata["source_observation"]["service_metadata"]["page_update_date_observed"] is False and all(v is False for k, v in report["interpretation"].items() if k != "commitment_excludes_generic_extra_steps"),
        "no_new_source_or_automatic_collection_or_http_original_claim": set(configs) == set(before["configs"]) and all(configs[key] == value for key, value in before["configs"].items() if key != report["source_id"]) and config["enabled"] is False and config["access_review"]["automatic_fetch_approved"] is False and metadata["archive_format"] == "agent_created_zip_capture_bundle_not_government_original" and report["normal_http_guide_originals_added"] == 0,
        "all_old_revisions_and_review_publication_rows_unchanged": old_revisions == before["revisions"] and gates == before["gates"],
        "draft_scope_and_publication_policy_bytes_unchanged": all(fingerprint((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == sha for path, sha in before["file_sha256"].items()),
        "catalog_exports_correct_latest_capture_identity": catalog_entry["revision"] == row["id"] and catalog_entry["metadata"]["acquisition_kind"] == "public_browser_accessibility_capture" and catalog_entry["state"] == "pending_review",
    }
    with restored.db() as db:
        copied, _ = restored._verify(db, row["id"], require_review=False)
        _, copied_chunks = restored._content(db, row["id"])
    checks["full_restore_preserves_latest_package_metadata_and_six_chunks"] = backup["passed"] is True and copied["sha256"] == row["sha256"] and copied["metadata"] == row["metadata"] and copied["state"] == "pending_review" and copied_chunks == chunks and len(chunks) == 6
    try:
        store.candidate("郑州市二七区", "demo-id-renewal")
    except ValueError as error:
        checks["unreviewed_content_still_blocks_formal_candidate"] = str(error) == "Unreviewed or changed content"
    else:
        checks["unreviewed_content_still_blocks_formal_candidate"] = False
    result = {"schema": 1, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks, "counts": store.status()["counts"], "new_selected_clauses": 3, "new_sources": 0, "normal_http_guide_originals_added": 0, "business_approvals": 0, "business_publications": 0, "model_requests": 0, "limits": "Capture identity, exact observed text and preservation; no six-day end-to-end or postal guarantee, currentness certification, policy override or business acceptance."}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/erqi-service-metadata-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not result["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Check the fee-clause review and pending original, without approving a release."""

import argparse
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import parse_html, select_paragraph_keywords
from gov_mcp.knowledge_pdf import checked_text, extract_document
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="核对收费分支资料，不执行模型、改写草案或发布")
    parser.add_argument("--review-packet",required=True,type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update",read_only=True)
    report = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/fee-first-issue-and-waiver-review-20261017.json")
    private = store.root / "source-research/fees-20261017"
    before = read(private / "before-main-data.json")
    readiness = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/review-readiness.json")
    assert fingerprint(args.review_packet.read_bytes()) == readiness["review_packet_sha256"]
    packet = read(args.review_packet)
    holdout = packet["holdout_design_draft"]
    if holdout["stale_source_keys"] != ["F18"]:
        parser.error("本回执绑定首次申领复核后、F18迁移前的阶段；不覆盖历史阶段结果")
    with store.db() as db:
        row,digest = store._verify(db,report["first_issue"]["revision"],require_review=True)
        _,chunks = store._content(db,row["id"])
        metadata = json.loads(row["metadata"])
        waiver,_ = store._verify(db,report["hardship_original"]["revision"],require_review=False)
        waiver_meta = json.loads(waiver["metadata"])
        _,waiver_chunks = store._content(db,waiver["id"])
        config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?",(report["first_issue"]["source_id"],)).fetchone()[0])
        waiver_config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?",(report["hardship_original"]["source_id"],)).fetchone()[0])
        gates = {t:db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+t).fetchone()[0] for t in before["formal_gates"]}
        original_configs_preserved = all(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?",(k,)).fetchone()[0] == v for k,v in before["source_configs"].items())
        states = dict(db.execute("SELECT state,count(*) FROM revisions WHERE rowid IN (SELECT max(rowid) FROM revisions GROUP BY document_id) GROUP BY state").fetchall())
        pending = [json.loads(r[0]) for r in db.execute("SELECT metadata FROM revisions WHERE state='pending_review' AND rowid IN (SELECT max(rowid) FROM revisions GROUP BY document_id)")]
    raw = (store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]).read_bytes()
    parsed,_ = parse_html(raw,config["content_selector"],min_text_length=8)
    selected = select_paragraph_keywords(parsed,config["include_paragraph_keywords"],config["paragraph_expected_count"])
    original = report["hardship_original"]
    pdf_path = store.root / "originals" / waiver["sha256"][:2] / waiver["sha256"]
    pdf = PdfReader(pdf_path,strict=True)
    native = [p.extract_text() or "" for p in pdf.pages]
    try:
        extract_document(pdf_path)
    except ValueError as error:
        ordinary_parser_refused_blank = str(error) == "Missing text layer; explicit OCR source configuration required"
    else:
        ordinary_parser_refused_blank = False
    checks = {
        "review_and_original_are_bound":digest == report["first_issue"]["review_digest"] and fingerprint(raw) == before["first_issue_revision"]["sha256"],
        "complete_first_clause_matches_canonical_parser":chunks == selected and len(chunks) == 1,
        "legal_start_comes_from_selected_clause":metadata["effective_from"] == "2018-04-01" and chunks[0]["text"] == "一、自2018年4月1日起，停征首次申领居民身份证工本费。",
        "ambiguous_publication_is_not_fabricated":metadata["published_at"] is None and metadata["document_signed_at"] == "2018-04-12" and not metadata.get("date_basis"),
        "source_observation_is_immutable":metadata["source_observation"] == json.loads(before["first_issue_revision"]["metadata"])["source_observation"],
        "scoped_ai_review_is_not_a_renewal_fee_waiver":metadata["source_fact_assessment"] == report["first_issue"]["assessment"] and report["human_review_completed"] is False and metadata["source_fact_assessment"]["current_applicability"] == "national_first_issue_fee_suspension_only_not_renewal_waiver",
        "new_original_was_normally_acquired":original["receipt"]["normal_fetcher"] is True and original["receipt"]["status"] == 200 and fingerprint(pdf_path.read_bytes()) == original["original_sha256"],
        "native_body_and_blank_second_page_are_exact":len(native) == 2 and not native[1].strip() and len(waiver_chunks) == 1 and waiver_chunks[0]["text"] == checked_text(native[0]) and fingerprint(waiver_chunks[0]["text"].encode()) == original["native_text_sha256"],
        "all_pages_visual_observation_is_hash_bound":[fingerprint((private/f"waiver-2004-page-{i}.png").read_bytes()) for i in [1,2]] == original["visual_page_png_sha256"] and original["blank_page_visually_checked"] == 2,
        "ordinary_pdf_parser_was_not_weakened":ordinary_parser_refused_blank,
        "hardship_current_applicability_is_still_pending":waiver["state"] == "pending_review" and waiver_meta["source_fact_assessment"]["business_approval"] is False and waiver_meta["scope_confirmed"] is False,
        "manual_pdf_source_is_not_automatically_collected":waiver_config["enabled"] is False,
        "existing_source_configs_and_policy_preserved":original_configs_preserved and fingerprint((store.root/"publication-policy.json").read_bytes()) == before["policy_sha256"],
        "one_new_review_without_formal_release":gates == dict(before["formal_gates"],reviews=before["formal_gates"]["reviews"]+1),
        "F18_staleness_is_visible_without_approval":holdout["live_binding_checks"]["sources_match_latest"] is False and holdout["automatic_approval"] is False,
        "readiness_exposes_scoped_fee_review":readiness["recorded_reviewed_source_count"] == 3 and len(readiness["reviewed_fee_clauses"]) == 1 and readiness["reviewed_fee_clauses"][0]["revision"] == row["id"],
    }
    integrity = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/holdout-draft-integrity.json")
    failed = sorted(k for k,v in integrity["checks"].items() if not v)
    checks["draft_verifier_withholds_current_integrity"] = integrity["draft_integrity_passed"] is False and failed == sorted(["latest_originals_and_literal_anchor_spans_match","actual_export_contains_both_drafts_and_preserves_empty_approvals"])
    prior = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/archive/holdout-v3-bound-integrity-20261017.json")
    checks["prior_bound_v3_receipt_preserved"] = prior["draft_integrity_passed"] is True and prior["draft_sha256"] == holdout["reference_draft"]["content_sha256"]
    backup = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/full-backup-restore.json")
    restored = KnowledgeStore(backup["restore"]["restored_to"],read_only=True)
    with restored.db() as db:
        copied,copied_digest = restored._verify(db,row["id"],require_review=True)
        copied_waiver,_ = restored._verify(db,waiver["id"],require_review=False)
    checks["full_restore_preserves_review_and_pending_original"] = copied_digest == digest and copied["metadata"] == row["metadata"] and copied_waiver["metadata"] == waiver["metadata"] and copied_waiver["state"] == "pending_review" and backup["restore"]["services_started"] is False
    result = {"schema":1,"captured_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"passed":all(checks.values()),"checks":checks,
        "first_issue_reviewed_revision":row["id"],"hardship_pending_revision":waiver["id"],"counts":store.status()["counts"],
        "latest_states":states,"pending_without_effective_from":sum(not m.get("effective_from") for m in pending),
        "formal_gates":gates,"draft_stale_sources":holdout["stale_source_keys"],"expected_draft_failed_checks":failed,
        "new_model_runs":0,"reference_frozen":False,"independence_certified":False,"business_acceptance_completed":False}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/fee-boundary-review-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n")
    print(json.dumps({"passed":result["passed"],"checks":checks,"states":states,"pending_without_effective_from":result["pending_without_effective_from"]},ensure_ascii=False))
    if not result["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify original fee clauses, background classification and unresolved PDF quality."""
import argparse
import json
import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore,fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_backup import restore_bundle
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import observe_html,parse_html,select_paragraph_groups,select_paragraph_keywords,worker_once
from gov_mcp.knowledge_pdf import extract_document
from nexent_api import ROOT,RUNTIME


def read(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description="核对收费原文、背景排除及困难减免待核质量；不执行模型或发布")
    parser.add_argument("--review-packet",type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    source=read(ROOT/"evaluation/knowledge/national-fee-foundation-review-20261017.json")
    store=KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME/"knowledge-update",read_only=True)
    private=store.root/"source-research/fee-currentness-20261017"
    before=read(private/"before-main.json")
    if any(fingerprint((ROOT/path).read_bytes())!=digest for path,digest in before["untouched_files"].items()):
        parser.error("评测草案已有后续迁移，不覆盖收费原件阶段历史回执")
    readiness=read(ROOT/"evidence/knowledge-update/review-readiness.json")
    assert fingerprint(args.review_packet.read_bytes())==readiness["review_packet_sha256"]
    with store.db() as db:
        row,digest=store._verify(db,source["revision"],require_review=True)
        latest=db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1",(row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        _,chunks=store._content(db,row["id"])
        metadata=json.loads(row["metadata"])
        site=db.execute("SELECT * FROM sites WHERE id=?",(source["source_id"],)).fetchone();config=json.loads(site["config"])
        job=db.execute("SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE site_id=?",(source["source_id"],)).fetchone()
        gates={t:db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+t).fetchone()[0] for t in before["gates"]}
        if latest!=row["id"] or gates!=dict(before["gates"],reviews=before["gates"]["reviews"]+1):parser.error("来源或闸门有后续变化，不覆盖本阶段回执")
        if job is None or job["state"] in ("queued","running"):parser.error("已排队正常复查尚未终结；查看同一作业，不重复请求")
        backgrounds=[]
        for binding in source["background_dispositions"]:
            store._verify_exclusion(db,binding["revision"])
            r,c=store._content(db,binding["revision"])
            scfg=json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?",(binding["source_id"],)).fetchone()[0])
            backgrounds.append((r,c,scfg))
        waiver,_=store._verify(db,source["waiver_quality_revision"],require_review=False);_,waiver_chunks=store._content(db,waiver["id"])
        waiver_config=json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id='FEE-WAIVER-2004-ZJ-LEAD'").fetchone()[0])
        stopped={sid:dict(db.execute("SELECT * FROM sites WHERE id=?",(sid,)).fetchone()) for sid in before["stopped_sources"]}
        fee2018,digest2018=store._verify(db,source["assessment"]["basis"]["first_issue_reviewed_revision"],require_review=True)
    original=(store.root/"originals"/row["sha256"][:2]/row["sha256"]).read_bytes()
    parsed,_=parse_html(original,config["content_selector"])
    checks={
        "normal_government_copies_have_exact_receipts":all(read(private/(name+"-receipt.json"))["status"]==200 and read(private/(name+"-receipt.json"))["normal_fetcher"] is True and fingerprint((private/(name+suffix)).read_bytes())==read(private/(name+"-receipt.json"))["sha256"] for name,suffix in [("qg-fee-2003",".html"),("sc-fee-2003",".pdf"),("tangyin-fee",".html")]),
        "review_digest_and_ai_scope_are_bound":digest==source["review_digest"] and metadata["source_fact_assessment"]==source["assessment"] and source["human_review_completed"] is False,
        "real_group_configuration_selects_complete_original_paragraphs":chunks==select_paragraph_groups(parsed,config["include_paragraph_keyword_groups"]) and [c["locator"] for c in chunks]==["正文段落3","正文段落4","正文段落7","正文段落8"],
        "commencement_is_explicit_and_republication_not_substituted":metadata["effective_from"]=="2004-01-01" and "2004年1月1日" in chunks[-1]["text"] and metadata["published_at"] is None and metadata["document_signed_at"]=="2003-12-30" and metadata["source_observation"]["fields"]["meta:pubdate"]==["2025-12-24"],
        "first_issue_suspension_review_is_preserved":digest2018==source["assessment"]["basis"]["first_issue_review_digest"] and fee2018["state"]=="reviewed",
        "real_background_watch_recheck_preserves_review":job["state"]=="done" and job["attempts"]==1 and job["error"] is None and config["enabled"] is True and site["paused_reason"] is None and site["last_success"] is not None,
        "previously_stopped_sources_are_not_resumed":all(stopped[sid]["config"]==old["config"] and stopped[sid]["paused_reason"]==old["paused_reason"] for sid,old in before["stopped_sources"].items()),
    }
    sc,sc_chunks,scfg=backgrounds[0];ty,ty_chunks,tycfg=backgrounds[1]
    checks["independent_pdf_copy_is_reference_not_another_rule"]=sc_chunks==extract_document(private/"sc-fee-2003.pdf")["chunks"] and sc["state"]=="excluded" and scfg["enabled"] is False and len(sc_chunks)==2
    norm=lambda s:re.sub(r"\s+","",s)
    sc1,sc2=map(lambda c:norm(c["text"]),sc_chunks)
    checks["financial_and_commencement_clauses_match_pdf_without_rewriting_spelling"]=(norm(chunks[0]["text"])[norm(chunks[0]["text"]).index("因此，同意"):]==sc1[sc1.index("因此，同意"):sc1.index("公安机关为居民办理临时")]
        and norm(chunks[1]["text"])==sc1[sc1.index("公安机关为居民办理临时"):sc1.index("二、")]
        and norm(chunks[2]["text"])==sc2[sc2.index("四、"):sc2.index("五、")]
        and norm(chunks[3]["text"])==sc2[sc2.index("五、"):sc2.index("国家发展改革委")]
        and "聚酯" in chunks[0]["text"] and "聚脂" in sc1)
    checks["both_pdf_pages_have_bound_visual_observation"]=source["assessment"]["basis"]["sc_pdf_visual_pages"]==[1,2] and source["assessment"]["basis"]["sc_png_sha256"]==[fingerprint((private/f"sc-fee-2003-page-{i}.png").read_bytes()) for i in [1,2]]
    ty_raw=(private/"tangyin-fee.html").read_bytes();ty_parsed,_=parse_html(ty_raw,tycfg["content_selector"])
    cells=json.loads(ty["metadata"])["source_fact_assessment"]["table_cells"]
    checks["other_county_directory_has_citations_not_invented_amounts"]=ty["state"]=="excluded" and tycfg["enabled"] is False and json.loads(ty["metadata"])["region"]=="汤阴县" and ty_chunks==select_paragraph_keywords(ty_parsed,tycfg["include_paragraph_keywords"],1) and len(cells)==8 and cells[6]==cells[7]=="财综〔2007〕34号，财税〔2018〕37号" and not re.search(r"(?:20|40|10)元",ty_chunks[0]["text"])
    wm=json.loads(waiver["metadata"]);quality=source["waiver_quality_note"]
    native=(store.root/"source-research/fees-20261017/waiver-2004-page-1-native.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    checks["waiver_native_visual_difference_is_recorded_without_text_correction"]=waiver_chunks==before["waiver_chunks"] and waiver["body_sha256"]==before["waiver"]["body_sha256"] and wm["extraction_quality_notes"]==[quality] and native[quality["start"]:quality["end"]]==quality["native_literal"]=="观" and quality["visual_reading"]=="现" and fingerprint(native.encode())==quality["parent_native_text_sha256"] and quality["start"]<native.index("一、")
    checks["hardship_eligibility_and_blank_page_parser_remain_unapproved"]=waiver["state"]=="pending_review" and wm["scope_confirmed"] is False and wm["source_fact_assessment"]["business_approval"] is False and waiver_config["enabled"] is False
    try:extract_document(store.root/"source-research/fees-20261017/waiver-2004.pdf")
    except ValueError:blank_rejected=True
    else:blank_rejected=False
    checks["hardship_eligibility_and_blank_page_parser_remain_unapproved"] &= blank_rejected
    holdout=read(args.review_packet)["holdout_design_draft"]
    checks["draft_and_formal_gates_preserved"]=all(fingerprint((ROOT/p).read_bytes())==h for p,h in before["untouched_files"].items()) and set(holdout["stale_source_keys"])=={"NATIONAL","F18","WINDOW"} and holdout["automatic_approval"] is False and fingerprint((store.root/"publication-policy.json").read_bytes())==before["policy_sha256"] and gates==dict(before["gates"],reviews=8)
    exported={d["source_id"]:d for d in read(ROOT/"data/knowledge/candidate-catalog.json")["documents"]}
    checks["actual_export_preserves_new_review_and_pending_quality_notes"]=readiness["recorded_reviewed_source_count"]==6 and exported[source["source_id"]]["revision"]==row["id"] and exported["FEE-WAIVER-2004-ZJ-LEAD"]["metadata"]["extraction_quality_notes"]==[quality]
    backup=read(ROOT/"evidence/knowledge-update/full-backup-restore.json")
    restored=restore_bundle(backup["backup"]["directory"],ROOT/".runtime/knowledge-update-restores"/("fee-foundation-"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]));clone=KnowledgeStore(restored["restored_to"])
    with clone.db() as db:
        copied,copied_digest=clone._verify(db,row["id"],require_review=True)
        quality_copy,_=clone._verify(db,waiver["id"],require_review=False)
        for binding in source["background_dispositions"]:clone._verify_exclusion(db,binding["revision"])
    checks["full_restore_preserves_review_exclusions_and_quality_notes"]=copied_digest==digest and copied["metadata"]==row["metadata"] and quality_copy["metadata"]==waiver["metadata"] and restored["services_started"] is False
    try:clone.candidate("郑州市二七区","demo-id-renewal")
    except ValueError as error:candidate_error=str(error)
    else:candidate_error=None
    checks["remaining_unreviewed_evidence_still_blocks_candidate"]=candidate_error=="Unreviewed or changed content"
    class Fixture:
        def __init__(self,payload):self.payload=payload
        def fetch(self,c,url):
            assert c["id"]==source["source_id"] and url==source["url"]
            return 200,{"content-type":"text/html"},self.payload,url
    def replay(payload):
        with clone.db() as db:
            assert db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE state='queued'").fetchone()[0]==0
            assert db.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='queued',attempts=0,due=0,lease_until=NULL WHERE site_id=?",(source["source_id"],)).rowcount==1
        worker_once(clone,fetcher=Fixture(payload),owner="isolated-fee-foundation-replay")
        with clone.db() as db:return db.execute("SELECT r.* FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1",(source["source_id"],)).fetchone()
    same=replay(original);checks["same_body_replay_preserves_review"]=same["id"]==row["id"] and same["state"]=="reviewed"
    changed_raw=original.replace("每证20元".encode(),"每证21元".encode());assert changed_raw!=original
    changed=replay(changed_raw);cm=json.loads(changed["metadata"])
    checks["real_selection_still_captures_synthetic_amount_change_and_withholds_approval"]=changed["id"]!=row["id"] and changed["state"]=="pending_review" and cm["effective_from"] is None and cm["published_at"] is None
    result={"schema":1,"captured_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"passed":all(checks.values()),"checks":checks,"revision":row["id"],"counts":store.status()["counts"],"formal_gates":gates,"draft_stale_sources":holdout["stale_source_keys"],"candidate_error":candidate_error,"new_model_runs":0,"replay_network_requests":0,"synthetic_change_is_not_a_policy":True,"business_acceptance_completed":False,"windows_task_touched":False}
    (ROOT/"evidence/knowledge-update/fee-foundation-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n")
    print(json.dumps({"passed":result["passed"],"checks":checks},ensure_ascii=False))
    if not result["passed"]:raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__=="__main__":main()

"""Check the fee/norm identity evidence and restored original selections, read-only."""

import argparse
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import httpx

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_review import development_registry
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from record_fee_norm_evidence import SPECS, selected_chunks


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="核对收费依据链和规范原件身份，不批准发布")
    parser.add_argument("--research-directory", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    research = Path(args.research_directory).resolve()
    assessment = json.loads((ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/fee-norm-identity-assessments.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    backup = json.loads((ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/full-backup-restore.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    restored = KnowledgeStore(backup["restore"]["restored_to"], read_only=True)
    checks = {"assessment_hash_matches": fingerprint({k:v for k,v in assessment.items() if k != "assessment_sha256"}) == assessment["assessment_sha256"],
        "truthful_ai_review_and_no_release_claim": assessment["reviewer_kind"] == "ai" and not assessment["human_review_completed"] and not assessment["business_release_ready"],
        "latest_revisions_and_originals_match": True, "original_selections_reproduce": True,
        "all_anchors_reproduce_and_survive_restore": True, "references_disabled_and_excluded": True,
        "both_primary_policies_acquired_and_monitored_normally": True,
        "dates_and_fee_branch_boundaries_preserved": True, "pdf_visual_observation_matches_cached_images": True,
        "current_validity_not_invented": True, "policy_registry_and_prior_model_records_preserved": True,
        "no_approvals_or_published_versions_created": True, "live_unpublished_query_retains_stop": True}
    with store.db() as db, restored.db() as saved:
        for source_id, binding in assessment["sources"].items():
            row, _ = store._verify(db, binding["revision"], require_review=False)
            copy, _ = restored._verify(saved, binding["revision"], require_review=False)
            latest = db.execute("SELECT r.id FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (source_id,)).fetchone()[0]
            checks["latest_revisions_and_originals_match"] &= latest == row["id"] and row["sha256"] == binding["original_sha256"] and row["state"] == binding["state"] and dict(row) == dict(copy)
            source = db.execute("SELECT * FROM sites WHERE id=?", (source_id,)).fetchone()
            config = json.loads(source["config"])
            meta = json.loads(row["metadata"])
            if source_id in SPECS:
                original = store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]
                expected = selected_chunks(source_id, original)
                _, actual = store._content(db, row["id"])
                _, recovered = restored._content(saved, row["id"])
                checks["original_selections_reproduce"] &= expected == actual == recovered
                checks["references_disabled_and_excluded"] &= not config["enabled"] and config["metadata"]["collection_role"] == "governance_reference" and row["state"] == "excluded"
                store._verify_exclusion(db, row["id"])
                checks["current_validity_not_invented"] &= meta["effective_from"] is None and meta["effective_to"] is None and not meta["scope_confirmed"]
            if source_id.startswith("MOF-"):
                jobs = list(db.execute("SELECT state,error FROM jobs WHERE site_id=?", (source_id,)))
                checks["both_primary_policies_acquired_and_monitored_normally"] &= (config["enabled"] and config["interval_seconds"] == 86400 and config["delay_seconds"] >= 5
                    and source["last_success"] is not None and not source["paused_reason"] and bool(jobs)
                    and all(r["state"] == "done" and not r["error"] for r in jobs)
                    and meta["source_observation"]["media_type"] == "text/html" and not meta["scope_confirmed"]
                    and config.get("metadata_selectors") == {"displayed_publication": {"class": "laiyuan"}})
        for finding in assessment["findings"]:
            checks["truthful_ai_review_and_no_release_claim"] &= not finding["business_approval"]
            for anchor in finding["anchors"]:
                chunk = db.execute("SELECT locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? AND ordinal=?", (anchor["revision"], anchor["chunk_ordinal"])).fetchone()
                copy = saved.execute("SELECT locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? AND ordinal=?", (anchor["revision"], anchor["chunk_ordinal"])).fetchone()
                text = chunk["text"]
                checks["all_anchors_reproduce_and_survive_restore"] &= (anchor["revision"] == assessment["sources"][anchor["source_id"]]["revision"]
                    and tuple(chunk) == tuple(copy) and chunk["locator"] == anchor["locator"] and 0 <= anchor["start"] < anchor["end"] <= len(text)
                    and fingerprint(text.encode()) == anchor["text_sha256"] and fingerprint(text[anchor["start"]:anchor["end"]].encode()) == anchor["span_sha256"])
        fee_id = assessment["sources"]["MOF-FEE-2007"]["revision"]
        first_id = assessment["sources"]["MOF-FIRST-ISSUE-2018"]["revision"]
        fee_meta = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT metadata FROM revisions WHERE id=?", (fee_id,)).fetchone()[0])
        first_meta = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT metadata FROM revisions WHERE id=?", (first_id,)).fetchone()[0])
        first = db.execute("SELECT text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=?", (first_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        fee = db.execute("SELECT text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? AND ordinal=1", (fee_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        checks["dates_and_fee_branch_boundaries_preserved"] = (fee_meta["document_signed_at"] == "2007-02-14" and first_meta["document_signed_at"] == "2018-04-12"
            and fee_meta["effective_from"] is None and first_meta["effective_from"] is None
            and fee_meta["initial_page_observations"]["page_date"] == "2008-05-19" and first_meta["initial_page_observations"]["page_date"] == "2018-08-20"
            and fee_meta["source_observation"]["fields"]["meta:pubdate"] == ["2007-09-29 08:17:00"]
            and first_meta["source_observation"]["fields"]["meta:pubdate"] == ["2018-04-16 17:37:00"]
            and any("2008年05月19日" in t for t in fee_meta["source_observation"]["fields"]["block:displayed_publication"])
            and any("2018年08月20日" in t for t in first_meta["source_observation"]["fields"]["block:displayed_publication"])
            and first == "一、自2018年4月1日起，停征首次申领居民身份证工本费。"
            and all(t in fee for t in ("换领第二代居民身份证", "每证20元", "遗失补领、损坏换领", "每证40元", "临时居民身份证", "每证10元")))
        for n, sha in assessment["norm_pdf"]["rendered_page_sha256"].items():
            checks["pdf_visual_observation_matches_cached_images"] &= fingerprint((research / f"norm-page-{n}.png").read_bytes()) == sha
        checks["current_validity_not_invented"] &= (assessment["norm_pdf"]["pages_visually_inspected"] == [1,45,64]
            and assessment["current_erqi_applicability"] == "not_established" and len(assessment["remaining"]) == 4)
        checks["policy_registry_and_prior_model_records_preserved"] = (fingerprint((store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()) == assessment["policy_file_sha256"]
            and development_registry(db) == development_registry(saved) and len(development_registry(db)) == 40)
        checks["no_approvals_or_published_versions_created"] = all(db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "+name).fetchone()[0] == 0 for name in ("reviews", "snapshot_evaluations", "versions", "heads"))
    for name, expected in assessment["preserved_development_files"].items():
        checks["policy_registry_and_prior_model_records_preserved"] &= fingerprint((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == expected
    with httpx.Client(trust_env=False, timeout=10) as http:
        response = http.get("http://127.0.0.1:8772/api/search", params={"q":"身份证到期换领费用", "region":"郑州市二七区", "matter":"demo-id-renewal"})
        response.raise_for_status()
        answer = response.json()
        checks["live_unpublished_query_retains_stop"] = answer["message_code"] == "NO_PUBLISHED_KNOWLEDGE" and not answer["citations"] and answer["knowledge_version"] is None
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks,
        "assessment_sha256": assessment["assessment_sha256"], "sources": len(assessment["sources"]), "new_originals": 5,
        "findings": len(assessment["findings"]), "anchors": sum(len(f["anchors"]) for f in assessment["findings"]),
        "counts": store.status()["counts"], "business_accuracy_measured": False, "model_trials_started": 0,
        "scope": "Original identity, exact selected cells/pages/paragraphs, source chain and restoration. No current Erqi fee/material approval or independent business acceptance."}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/fee-norm-identity-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "checks": checks, "counts": report["counts"]}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not report["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify an independent government-hosted webprint PDF without approving local eligibility."""
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_pdf import extract_document
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def item_spans(text):
    starts = [re.search(r"(?m)^[ \t]*(" + marker + r")", text).start(1) for marker in ["一、", "二、", "三、", "四、", "五、"]]
    starts.append(text.index("中华人民共和国财政部", starts[-1]))
    return [{"item": i + 1, "start": start, "end": starts[i + 1] - (len(text[start:starts[i + 1]]) - len(text[start:starts[i + 1]].rstrip())), "text": text[start:starts[i + 1]].rstrip()} for i, start in enumerate(starts[:-1])]


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    private = store.root / "source-research/fee-waiver-langxi-20261018"
    before = read(private / "before-main.json")
    report = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/fee-waiver-official-copy-20261018.json")
    expected = dict(before["counts"])
    for key, value in {"sites": 1, "documents": 1, "revisions": 2, "chunks": 6, "latest_chunks": 3}.items():
        expected[key] += value
    if store.status()["counts"] != expected:
        raise SystemExit("主库已有后续更新或数量差异；保留减免副本阶段回执，先核对当前状态")
    receipts = read(private / "fetch-receipts.json")
    parent, raw = (private / "parent.html").read_bytes(), (private / "fee-waiver.pdf").read_bytes()
    parsed = extract_document(private / "fee-waiver.pdf")
    page = parsed["chunks"][0]["text"]
    items = item_spans(page)
    backup = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/full-backup-restore.json")
    restored = KnowledgeStore(backup["restore"]["restored_to"], read_only=True)
    with store.db() as db:
        row, _ = store._verify(db, report["revision"], require_review=False)
        store._verify_exclusion(db, row["id"])
        _, chunks = store._content(db, row["id"])
        config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (report["source_id"],)).fetchone()[0])
        metadata = json.loads(row["metadata"])
        old, _ = store._verify(db, report["comparison"]["prior_revision"], require_review=False)
        _, old_chunks = store._content(db, old["id"])
        old_items = item_spans(old_chunks[0]["text"])
        configs = {r["id"]: fingerprint(r["config"].encode()) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,config FROM sites")}
        old_revisions = {r["id"]: fingerprint(dict(r)) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM revisions WHERE id NOT IN (?,?)", (row["id"], report["initial_revision"]))}
        gates = {t: [fingerprint(dict(r)) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM " + t)] for t in before["gates"]}
        first, _ = store._verify(db, "rev-e41c61067fe70ce4ce221dbf")
        _, first_chunks = store._content(db, first["id"])
    fold = lambda value: re.sub(r"\s+", "", value)
    selected = [items[i] for i in [0, 1, 4]]
    catalog = next(r for r in read(ROOT / "data/knowledge/candidate-catalog.json")["documents"] if r["source_id"] == report["source_id"])
    checks = {
        "report_digest_and_private_receipt_match": fingerprint({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "content_sha256"}) == report["content_sha256"] and {k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "content_sha256"} == read(private / "archive-receipt.json"),
        "both_exact_linked_entries_normally_fetched_once": receipts == report["normal_fetch_receipts"] and len(receipts) == 2 and all(r["normal_fetcher"] is True and r["attempted_once"] is True and r["status"] == 200 and r["body_acquired"] is True for r in receipts) and receipts[0]["sha256"] == fingerprint(parent) and receipts[1]["sha256"] == fingerprint(raw) == row["sha256"] and len(raw) == receipts[1]["bytes"] == 813961,
        "parent_public_iframe_contains_the_exact_pdf_path": report["parent"]["iframe_src"] in parent.decode("utf-8") and report["url"].endswith("/file_xc/4/202403/202403046c77205b1c9546488e541d934f100c9f.pdf") and report["parent"]["iframe_src"].endswith("?file=/file_xc/4/202403/202403046c77205b1c9546488e541d934f100c9f.pdf"),
        "pdf_original_header_and_strict_single_page_extraction_match": raw.startswith(b"%PDF-") and (store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]).read_bytes() == raw and len(parsed["chunks"]) == 1 and parsed["extraction"]["method"] == "pdf_text_layer" and fingerprint(page.encode()) == report["pdf_observation"]["native_page_text_sha256"],
        "all_source_text_ranges_reproduce_the_three_full_selected_items": [c["text"] for c in chunks] == [s["text"] for s in selected] and all(page[s["start"]:s["end"]] == s["text"] for s in selected) and report["selected_spans"] == [{k: s[k] for k in ["item", "start", "end"]} | {"text_sha256": fingerprint(s["text"].encode())} for s in selected],
        "five_items_match_prior_pdf_only_under_explicit_whitespace_fold": all(fold(new["text"]) == fold(prior["text"]) for new, prior in zip(items, old_items)) and old["sha256"] == report["comparison"]["prior_original_sha256"] and report["comparison"]["normalization"] == "whitespace_removal_only_no_glyph_or_punctuation_repair" and len(items) == len(old_items) == 5,
        "exemption_reduction_proof_and_renewal_conditions_preserved": "免收工本费" in chunks[0]["text"] and "减半征收工本费" in chunks[1]["text"] and all("初次申请领取和换领" in c["text"] and "有效证明" in c["text"] for c in chunks[:2]) and "2004年1月1日" in fold(chunks[2]["text"]),
        "webprint_dates_not_relabelled_as_current_legal_approval": metadata["document_type"] == "official_webprint_copy" and metadata["effective_from"] is None and metadata["published_at"] is None and report["dates"]["parent_page_date"] == "2024-03-04" and report["dates"]["printed_site_banner_date"] == "2022-01-14" and report["dates"]["document_stated_execution_date"] == "2004-01-01" and report["dates"]["first_publication_verified"] is False,
        "complete_render_is_bound_and_ai_visual_observation_attributed": fingerprint((private / "page-1.png").read_bytes()) == report["pdf_observation"]["page_png_sha256"] and report["pdf_observation"]["visual_pages_checked"] == [1] and report["reviewer_kind"] == "ai" and report["human_review_completed"] is False,
        "copy_is_excluded_disabled_and_not_an_additional_answer_rule": row["state"] == "excluded" and config["enabled"] is False and metadata["scope_confirmed"] is False and metadata["collection_role"] == "governance_reference" and metadata["source_fact_assessment"]["business_approval"] is False and catalog["state"] == "excluded" and catalog["metadata"]["document_type"] == "official_webprint_copy",
        "all_old_sources_revisions_reviews_drafts_and_policy_preserved": {k: v for k, v in configs.items() if k != report["source_id"]} == before["configs"] and old_revisions == before["revisions"] and gates == before["gates"] and all(fingerprint((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == sha for path, sha in before["file_sha256"].items()),
        "first_issue_suspension_boundary_kept": any("首次申领" in c["text"] and "停征" in c["text"] for c in first_chunks) and first["state"] == "reviewed" and report["conclusions"]["first_issue_fee_reintroduced"] is False,
        "current_local_eligibility_and_original_glyph_difference_still_unresolved": all(value is False for value in report["conclusions"].values()) and old["state"] == "pending_review" and metadata["source_fact_assessment"]["current_applicability"] == "unknown",
    }
    try:
        extract_document(store.root / "source-research/fees-20261017/waiver-2004.pdf")
    except ValueError as error:
        checks["original_blank_page_parser_limit_not_weakened"] = str(error) == "Missing text layer; explicit OCR source configuration required"
    else:
        checks["original_blank_page_parser_limit_not_weakened"] = False
    with restored.db() as db:
        copied, _ = restored._verify(db, row["id"], require_review=False)
        restored._verify_exclusion(db, row["id"])
        _, copied_chunks = restored._content(db, row["id"])
    checks["full_restore_preserves_new_pdf_metadata_selection_and_exclusion"] = backup["passed"] is True and copied["sha256"] == row["sha256"] and copied["metadata"] == row["metadata"] and copied_chunks == chunks
    result = {"schema": 1, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks, "counts": store.status()["counts"], "new_normally_archived_pdf_copies": 1, "new_business_rules": 0, "business_approvals": 0, "business_publications": 0, "model_requests": 0, "limits": "Original/source-copy and literal-condition corroboration only; no current Erqi relief eligibility, proof-sharing procedure, glyph repair or new visitor answer rule."}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/fee-waiver-copy-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not result["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Replay the HTTP intake lifecycle with an explicit fake verifier, never cloud AI."""
from copy import deepcopy
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))

from starlette.testclient import TestClient
from gov_mcp.decision.server import create_app
from gov_mcp.decision.workflow import Workflow


class ContractVerifier:
    def __init__(self): self.calls = []
    def enabled(self): return True
    def verify(self, template, values):
        self.calls.append(deepcopy(values))
        return {"model": "deepseek-contract-replay-not-real", "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0}, "output": {
            "fields": [{"id": field["id"], "value": values[field["id"]],
                "display": next(option["label"] for option in field["options"] if type(option["value"]) is type(values[field["id"]]) and option["value"] == values[field["id"]])}
                for field in template["fields"]], "unknown_fields": sorted(key for key, value in values.items() if value is None)}}


def run(output):
    checks = []
    def check(name, value):
        checks.append({"name": name, "passed": bool(value)})
        if not value: raise AssertionError(name)
    origin = "http://127.0.0.1:8780"
    verifier = ContractVerifier()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ict-intake-replay-") as root:
        workflow = Workflow(Path(root))
        app = create_app(workflow, "fixture-professional", "fixture-service", start_worker=False, form_verifier=verifier)
        with TestClient(app, base_url=origin, headers={"Origin": origin}) as client:
            check("未登录不能访问草稿", client.get("/api/forms/state").status_code == 403)
            client.post("/login", json={"role": "citizen"})
            form = client.post("/api/forms/start", json={}).json()
            check("首题与独立入口可用", form["question"]["id"] == "reason" and client.get("/guided-form").status_code == 200)
            for field, answer in [("reason", "到期了"), ("age_group", "成年人"), ("self_service", "我自己"), ("electronic_verified", "未验证")]:
                form = client.post("/api/forms/answer", json={"form_id": form["id"], "revision": form["revision"], "field_id": field, "answer": answer}).json()
            check("逐项填写不调用核查或创建咨询", not verifier.calls and not workflow.rows("query"))
            payload = {"form_id": form["id"], "revision": form["revision"], "consent": False}
            check("外发同意必需", client.post("/api/forms/review", json=payload).json()["error"] == "FORM_EGRESS_CONSENT_REQUIRED")
            payload["consent"] = True
            form = client.post("/api/forms/review", json=payload).json()
            check("原回答仅留本地，核查只接收代码", verifier.calls == [{"reason": "expiry", "age_group": "adult", "self_service": True, "electronic_verified": None}])
            check("未知不补全，结果必须人工检查", form["review"]["unknown_fields"] == ["electronic_verified"] and not workflow.rows("query"))
            submit = {"form_id": form["id"], "revision": form["revision"], "review_id": form["review"]["review_id"], "branch_id": "branch-adult-self", "acknowledge": False}
            check("人工确认不可跳过", client.post("/api/forms/submit", json=submit).json()["error"] == "FORM_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED")
            submit["acknowledge"] = True
            response = client.post("/api/forms/submit", json=submit)
            check("进入现有咨询而非正式政务提交", response.status_code == 200 and response.json()["receipt"]["official_submission"] is False)
            receipt = response.json()["receipt"]
            check("未知保持追问而非纸质表默认", response.json()["answer"]["follow_up"]["enabled"])
            check("提交后原回答清除", response.json()["form"]["answers"] == {})
            check("重复提交不新增咨询", client.post("/api/forms/submit", json=submit).json()["receipt"] == receipt and len(workflow.rows("query")) == 1)
            check("查询历史仍受会话归属限制", client.get("/api/history", params={"task_id": receipt["task_id"]}).status_code == 200)
            workflow.configure_demo(actor="demo-professional")
            workflow.set_profile("changed", actor="demo-professional")
            workflow.heartbeat(force=True)
            history = client.get("/api/history", params={"task_id": receipt["task_id"]}).json()
            check("表单回执继续经过当前暂停门", bool(history["current_availability"]["paused"]))
            client.post("/logout", json={})
            check("退出使草稿与历史读取失效", client.get("/api/forms/state").status_code == 403 and client.get("/api/history", params={"task_id": receipt["task_id"]}).status_code == 403)
    paths = [ROOT/"src/gov_mcp/decision"/name for name in ("intake.py", "intake.html", "intake.js", "intake.css", "server.py", "workflow.py")]
    paths += [ROOT/"config/decision/intake-form.json", ROOT/"config/decision/connections.json", Path(__file__).resolve()]
    report = {"mode": "synthetic_http_contract_replay", "actual_remote_model_calls": 0, "real_deepseek_quality_verified": False,
        "official_submission": False, "passed": sum(item["passed"] for item in checks), "total": len(checks), "checks": checks,
        "source_sha256": {path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths}}
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", "utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "total": report["total"], "actual_remote_model_calls": 0}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT/"evidence/guided-intake-20261018/verification.json")
    run(parser.parse_args().output)

"""Verify this attributed source review, draft staleness and isolated replay."""

import argparse
import json
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_backup import restore_bundle
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import parse_html, select_paragraph_keywords, worker_once
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="核对省厅服务信息复核及隔离重放，不执行模型或发布")
    parser.add_argument("--review-packet", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-business-reference-draft.json").get("draft_revision", 2) >= 3:
        parser.error("该脚本核对D26迁移前的历史状态；请使用verify_holdout_draft.py，不覆盖原阶段回执")
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    assessment = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/henan-service-review-20261017.json")
    before = read(store.root / "source-research/henan-service-review-20261017/before.json")
    backup = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/full-backup-restore.json")
    readiness = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/review-readiness.json")
    assert fingerprint(args.review_packet.read_bytes()) == readiness["review_packet_sha256"]
    packet = read(args.review_packet)
    checks = {}
    with store.db() as db:
        row, digest = store._verify(db, assessment["revision"], require_review=True)
        _, chunks = store._content(db, row["id"])
        metadata = json.loads(row["metadata"])
        latest = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        config = json.loads(db.execute("SELECT config FROM sites WHERE id=?", (assessment["source_id"],)).fetchone()[0])
        _, old_chunks = store._content(db, assessment["previous_revision"])
        counts = {t: db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM " + t).fetchone()[0]
                  for t in ("reviews", "snapshot_evaluations", "versions", "heads")}
    raw = (store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]).read_bytes()
    parsed, _ = parse_html(raw, config["content_selector"], min_text_length=8,
                           excluded_selectors=config.get("excluded_content_selectors"))
    selected = select_paragraph_keywords(parsed, config["include_paragraph_keywords"], config["paragraph_expected_count"])
    checks["review_is_latest_and_digest_bound"] = latest == row["id"] and digest == assessment["review_digest"]
    checks["original_bytes_unchanged"] = fingerprint(raw) == before["revision"]["sha256"] == row["sha256"]
    checks["canonical_worker_selection_is_complete_first_measure"] = selected == chunks == old_chunks[:1] and len(chunks) == 1
    checks["unselected_background_still_in_original_and_history"] = len(old_chunks) == 2 and old_chunks[1] in parsed
    checks["source_observation_is_immutable"] = metadata["source_observation"] == json.loads(before["revision"]["metadata"])["source_observation"]
    checks["publication_date_is_explicitly_not_legal_commencement"] = (metadata["date_basis"] == assessment["date_basis"]
        and metadata["published_at"] == "2026-05-05" and metadata["effective_from"] is None
        and metadata["effective_to"] is None and metadata["date_basis"]["legal_commencement_established"] is False)
    checks["review_identity_and_scope_are_honest"] = (metadata["source_fact_assessment"] == assessment["assessment"]
        and assessment["reviewer_kind"] == "ai" and assessment["human_review_completed"] is False
        and metadata["scope_confirmed"] is True)
    checks["one_new_source_review_without_publication"] = counts == dict(before["gates"], reviews=before["gates"]["reviews"] + 1)
    checks["publication_policy_preserved"] = fingerprint((store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()) == before["policy_sha256"]
    catalog = read(ROOT / "data/knowledge/candidate-catalog.json")
    exported = next(d for d in catalog["documents"] if d["source_id"] == assessment["source_id"])
    checks["catalog_exports_exact_date_basis_and_scoped_selection"] = (exported["revision"] == row["id"]
        and exported["metadata"]["date_basis"] == metadata["date_basis"] and len(exported["selected_clauses"]) == 1)
    checks["readiness_reports_actual_service_review"] = (readiness["recorded_reviewed_source_count"] == 2
        and len(readiness["reviewed_service_information"]) == 1
        and readiness["reviewed_service_information"][0]["revision"] == row["id"])
    holdout = packet["holdout_design_draft"]
    checks["stale_D26_binding_is_detected_without_approval"] = (holdout["stale_source_keys"] == ["D26"]
        and holdout["live_binding_checks"]["sources_match_latest"] is False
        and holdout["live_binding_checks"]["development_registry_matches"] is True
        and holdout["automatic_approval"] is False)
    draft_checks = read(ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/holdout-draft-integrity.json")
    failed = sorted(k for k, v in draft_checks["checks"].items() if not v)
    checks["draft_verifier_truthfully_withholds_integrity"] = (draft_checks["draft_integrity_passed"] is False and failed == sorted([
        "latest_originals_and_literal_anchor_spans_match", "actual_export_contains_both_drafts_and_preserves_empty_approvals"]))
    manifest = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/archive/holdout-v2-before-service-review-20261017/manifest.json")
    checks["v2_archive_and_active_semantics_preserved"] = (fingerprint({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k != "content_sha256"}) == manifest["content_sha256"]
        and all(fingerprint((ROOT / item["path"]).read_bytes()) == item["sha256"]
            and read(ROOT / item["path"]) == read(ROOT / item["source_path"]) for item in manifest["files"]))
    parent = ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update-restores"
    ensure_private_directory(parent)
    restored = restore_bundle(backup["backup"]["directory"], parent / ("henan-service-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]))
    clone = KnowledgeStore(restored["restored_to"])
    with clone.db() as db:
        copied, copied_digest = clone._verify(db, row["id"], require_review=True)
        copied_metadata = json.loads(copied["metadata"])
        queued = db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE state='queued'").fetchone()[0]
    checks["full_restore_preserves_service_review_and_date_basis"] = (copied_digest == digest
        and copied_metadata == metadata and restored["services_started"] is False and queued == 0)
    try:
        clone.candidate("郑州市二七区", "demo-id-renewal")
    except ValueError as error:
        candidate_error = str(error)
    else:
        candidate_error = None
    checks["other_pending_sources_still_prevent_candidate"] = candidate_error == "Unreviewed or changed content"

    class ArchivedFixture:
        def __init__(self, payload):
            self.payload = payload
            self.calls = 0

        def fetch(self, actual_config, url):
            assert actual_config["id"] == assessment["source_id"] and url == assessment["url"]
            self.calls += 1
            return 200, {"content-type": "text/html"}, self.payload, url

    def replay(payload):
        with clone.db() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='queued',attempts=0,due=0,lease_until=NULL WHERE site_id=?", (assessment["source_id"],))
        fixture = ArchivedFixture(payload)
        assert worker_once(clone, fetcher=fixture, owner="isolated-service-review-replay") is True
        with clone.db() as db:
            job = db.execute("SELECT state,error FROM jobs WHERE site_id=?", (assessment["source_id"],)).fetchone()
            actual = db.execute("SELECT r.* FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (assessment["source_id"],)).fetchone()
        return fixture.calls == 1 and job["state"] == "done" and job["error"] is None, actual

    ok, same = replay(raw)
    checks["actual_config_unchanged_replay_preserves_review"] = ok and same["id"] == row["id"] and same["state"] == "reviewed"
    changed_raw = raw.replace("15个工作日".encode(), "14个工作日".encode())
    assert changed_raw != raw
    ok, changed = replay(changed_raw)
    changed_metadata = json.loads(changed["metadata"])
    checks["synthetic_body_change_requires_new_review"] = (ok and changed["id"] != row["id"] and changed["state"] == "pending_review"
        and changed_metadata.get("date_basis") is None and changed_metadata["effective_from"] is None
        and changed_metadata["published_at"] is None)
    with store.db() as db:
        final, final_digest = store._verify(db, row["id"], require_review=True)
        final_counts = {t:db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM " + t).fetchone()[0] for t in counts}
    checks["isolation_did_not_change_live_review_or_publication"] = final_digest == digest and final_counts == counts
    report = {"schema": 1, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": all(checks.values()),
        "checks": checks, "revision": row["id"], "counts": store.status()["counts"], "formal_gates": counts,
        "draft_stale_sources": holdout["stale_source_keys"], "expected_draft_failed_checks": failed,
        "isolated_replay_uses_archived_then_synthetically_mutated_bytes": True,
        "fixture_is_not_a_new_policy": True, "network_requests_by_replay": 0, "new_model_runs": 0,
        "candidate_error": candidate_error, "business_acceptance_completed": False,
        "windows_task_touched": False}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/henan-service-review-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"passed":report["passed"],"checks":checks,"new_model_runs":0},ensure_ascii=False))
    if not report["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
