"""Compare literal source-unit proposals on the frozen pending-archive development corpus."""

import argparse
import json
import re
import uuid
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_classify import TOPICS
from gov_mcp.knowledge_retrieval import VERSION as RANKER_VERSION, query_grams, score_literal
from gov_mcp.knowledge_structure import VERSION as STRUCTURE_VERSION, structure
from gov_mcp.knowledge_units import VERSION, materialize, propose
from gov_mcp.knowledge_query import (VERSION as SIGNAL_VERSION, V2_VERSION as SIGNAL_V2_VERSION, V3_VERSION as SIGNAL_V3_VERSION,
    question_signals, source_topics, signal_text, question_demands, intent_source_key, intent_source_key_v3)
from private_runtime import ensure_private_directory
from verify_knowledge_shadow_retrieval import validate_reference


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def parent_keys(unit):
    return {(unit["revision_id"], span["locator"]) for span in unit["spans"]}


PROFILES = ("literal", "topic_priority_v1", "specific_topic_phase_v1", "intent_normalized_v1", "intent_normalized_v2", "intent_normalized_v3")


def topic_codes(text):
    return {code for code, _, terms in TOPICS if any(term in text for term in terms)}


def rank_units(question, corpus, profile="literal"):
    if not isinstance(question, str) or not question.strip() or len(question) > 300:
        raise ValueError("问题须为1至300字")
    if profile not in PROFILES:
        raise ValueError("未知检索开发配置")
    if profile in ("intent_normalized_v2", "intent_normalized_v3"):
        return rank_intent_units(question, corpus, profile)
    grams = query_grams(question)
    intent = question_signals(question) if profile == "intent_normalized_v1" else None
    topics = topic_codes(question) if profile != "literal" else set()
    topics = topics-{"eligibility"} if profile == "specific_topic_phase_v1" else topics-{"eligibility"} or topics
    collection_intent = profile == "specific_topic_phase_v1" and (
        any(term in question for term in ("代领", "邮寄", "送达", "领证", "领取新证"))
        or ("领取" in question and any(term in question for term in ("新证", "窗口")) and "申请领取" not in question))
    if intent:
        collection_intent = intent["collection"]
        topics = intent["topics"]
    ranked = []
    for unit in corpus:
        unit_topics = source_topics(unit["text_for_ranking"]) if intent else topic_codes(unit["text_for_ranking"])
        priority = len(topics & unit_topics) if topics else 0
        if intent and intent["primary"] in unit_topics:
            priority += len(topics)+1
        score = score_literal(grams, unit["text_for_ranking"])
        phase_priority = 0
        if collection_intent:
            hints = structure(signal_text(unit["text_for_ranking"]) if intent else unit["text_for_ranking"])
            kinds = {m["kind"] for m in hints["markers"]}
            if not hints["truncated"] and "phase:collection" in kinds:
                phase_priority = 1 if "phase:application" in kinds else 2
        if phase_priority or priority or score:
            ranked.append((phase_priority, priority, score, unit))
    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], -item[1], -item[2], item[3]["revision_id"], item[3]["spans"][0]["locator"],
                                 item[3]["spans"][0]["range"][0], item[3]["id"]))
    selected, bindings = [], set()
    for _, _, _, unit in ranked:
        parents = parent_keys(unit)
        if not parents or len(bindings | parents) > 5:
            continue  # Never drop half a cross-page unit to fit the parent-citation budget.
        selected.append(unit)
        bindings.update(parents)
        if len(selected) == 5:
            break
    return selected


def rank_intent_units(question, corpus, profile="intent_normalized_v2"):
    identity = "身份证" in signal_text(question)
    scorer = intent_source_key_v3 if profile == "intent_normalized_v3" else intent_source_key
    def ordered(text):
        scored = [(scorer(text, unit, identity), unit) for unit in corpus]
        scored = [(key, unit) for key, unit in scored if key[0] or key[1] or key[-1]]
        scored.sort(key=lambda pair: (tuple(-part for part in pair[0]), pair[1]["revision_id"],
            pair[1]["spans"][0]["locator"], pair[1]["spans"][0]["range"][0], pair[1]["id"]))
        return [unit for _, unit in scored]
    selected, bindings, identifiers = [], set(), set()
    def add(unit):
        identifier = (unit["revision_id"], unit["id"])
        parents = parent_keys(unit)
        if identifier in identifiers:
            return True
        if not parents or len(bindings | parents) > 5 or len(selected) == 5:
            return False
        selected.append(unit)
        bindings.update(parents)
        identifiers.add(identifier)
        return True
    demands = question_demands(question)
    if len(demands) > 1:
        for clause in demands:
            for unit in ordered(clause):
                if add(unit):
                    break
    for unit in ordered(question):
        add(unit)
        if len(selected) == 5:
            break
    return selected


def build_units(corpus, bindings):
    grouped = defaultdict(list)
    for chunk in corpus:
        grouped[chunk["revision_id"]].append(chunk)
    units, proposals = [], []
    for binding in bindings:
        items = grouped[binding["revision_id"]]
        chunks = [{"locator": c["locator"], "category": c["category"], "text": c["quote"]} for c in items]
        if fingerprint(chunks) != binding["body_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("冻结片段与原修订正文指纹不同")
        proposal = propose(chunks)
        if not proposal["coverage_complete"]:
            raise ValueError("单元提案不完整，不能静默缩小对照语料")
        proposals.append({"revision_id": binding["revision_id"], "source_id": binding["source_id"], "proposal": proposal})
        for unit in materialize(proposal, chunks):
            units.append({**unit, "revision_id": binding["revision_id"], "source_id": binding["source_id"],
                          "source_title": items[0].get("title")})
    return units, proposals


def evaluate_units(cases, corpus, profile="literal"):
    rows, group_suggestions = [], []
    available = set().union(*(parent_keys(u) for u in corpus)) if corpus else set()
    for case in cases:
        targets = {(e["revision"], e["locator"]) for e in case["archived_evidence"]}
        if not targets <= available:
            raise ValueError("参考定位缺失，不能缩小参考分母")
        selected = rank_units(case["question"], corpus, profile)
        parents = set().union(*(parent_keys(u) for u in selected)) if selected else set()
        rows.append({"case_id": case["id"], "question": case["question"], "ai_reference_behavior": case["expected_behavior"],
            "target_count": len(targets), "covered_parent_locators": len(targets & parents),
            "parent_locator_coverage_at5": len(targets & parents)/len(targets) if targets else None,
            "max_possible_parent_locator_coverage_at5": min(5, len(targets))/len(targets) if targets else None,
            "selected_units": [{"unit_id": u["id"], "revision_id": u["revision_id"], "source_id": u["source_id"],
                "heading_surface": u["heading_surface"], "spans": u["spans"], "flags": u["flags"],
                "text_sha256": u["text_sha256"]} for u in selected],
            "selected_parent_locator_count": len(parents),
            "missing_parent_locators": [{"revision_id": r, "locator": l} for r, l in sorted(targets-parents)],
            "unit_span_relevance_gold_available": False})
        for unit in corpus:
            refs = parent_keys(unit)
            if len(refs) > 1 and refs <= targets:
                group_suggestions.append({"case_id": case["id"], "unit_id": unit["id"], "revision_id": unit["revision_id"],
                    "parent_locators": sorted(locator for _, locator in refs), "relation": "literal_continuation_proposal",
                    "relevance_to_question": "unknown", "necessary_or_alternative": "unknown", "approved": False})
    positive = [r for r in rows if r["ai_reference_behavior"] == "conditional_answer" and r["target_count"]]
    return {"records": rows, "case_count": len(rows), "conditional_cases_with_targets": len(positive),
        "conditional_mean_parent_locator_coverage_at5": sum(r["parent_locator_coverage_at5"] for r in positive)/len(positive) if positive else None,
        "reference_group_suggestions": group_suggestions, "reference_denominators_changed": False}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="保留原始页码/位置的检索单元开发对照，不发布")
    parser.add_argument("--baseline-run", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", choices=PROFILES, default="literal")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{8}", args.baseline_run):
        parser.error("需要已存在的精确开发运行编号")
    output = ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update"
    baseline = json.loads((output / ("shadow-retrieval-"+args.baseline_run+".json")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    store = KnowledgeStore(ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    frozen = store.root / "shadow-retrieval" / args.baseline_run
    snapshot = json.loads((frozen / "corpus-frozen.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    reference_bytes = (frozen / "reference-frozen.json").read_bytes()
    if fingerprint(snapshot) != baseline["corpus_sha256"] or fingerprint(reference_bytes) != baseline["reference_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("开发语料或参考冻结指纹不匹配")
    reference = json.loads(reference_bytes)
    validate_reference(reference)
    before = store.status()["counts"]
    policy_bytes = (store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()
    with store.db() as db:
        for binding in snapshot["bindings"]:
            row, _ = store._verify(db, binding["revision_id"], require_review=False)
            if any(row[key] != binding[key] for key in ("body_sha256",)) or row["sha256"] != binding["original_sha256"] or fingerprint(row["metadata"]) != binding["metadata_sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("原归档与冻结来源绑定不匹配")
    units, proposals = build_units(snapshot["chunks"], snapshot["bindings"])
    result = evaluate_units(reference["cases"], units, args.profile)
    run_id = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")+"-"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    private = store.root / "source-units" / run_id
    ensure_private_directory(private)
    private_value = {"proposals": proposals, "materialized_units": units}
    (private / "units-frozen.json").write_text(json.dumps(private_value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    checks = {"all_units_reproduce_source_spans": all(p["proposal"]["coverage_complete"] for p in proposals),
        "citation_parent_budget_respected": all(r["selected_parent_locator_count"] <= 5 and len(r["selected_units"]) <= 5 for r in result["records"]),
        "counts_unchanged": before == store.status()["counts"],
        "publication_policy_unchanged": policy_bytes == (store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()}
    report = {"run_id": run_id, "baseline_run_id": args.baseline_run, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "kind": "literal_source_unit_development", "unit_algorithm_version": VERSION, "ranker_version": RANKER_VERSION,
        "development_rank_profile": args.profile, "topic_dictionary_sha256": fingerprint(TOPICS),
        "literal_structure_algorithm_version": STRUCTURE_VERSION,
        "query_signal_version": {"intent_normalized_v1": SIGNAL_VERSION, "intent_normalized_v2": SIGNAL_V2_VERSION, "intent_normalized_v3": SIGNAL_V3_VERSION}.get(args.profile),
        "query_signal_source_sha256": fingerprint((ROOT / "src/gov_mcp/knowledge_query.py").read_bytes()) if args.profile.startswith("intent_") else None,
        "topic_dictionary_modified_for_this_experiment": False,
        "corpus_sha256": baseline["corpus_sha256"], "reference_sha256": baseline["reference_sha256"],
        "private_unit_snapshot_sha256": fingerprint(private_value), "source_documents": len(proposals),
        "source_chunks": len(snapshot["chunks"]), "derived_units": len(units),
        "cross_page_units": sum(len(parent_keys(u)) > 1 for u in units),
        "baseline_conditional_mean_parent_locator_coverage_at5": baseline["conditional_reference_mean_locator_coverage_at5"],
        **result, "checks": checks, "passed_integrity_checks": all(checks.values()),
        "human_review_completed": False, "formal_retrieval_recall_measured": False, "business_release_ready": False,
        "production_query_changed": False, "official_publication_performed": False, "model_requests": 0,
        "scope": "Literal source-unit proposals on the exact earlier frozen AI development corpus. Every part remains an exact original span. "
            "Cross-page joins are proposed reading continuations, not a single contiguous source quote or approved applicability. "
            "Coverage uses unchanged coarse parent-locator targets; it does not prove that the selected span contains the relevant claim. "
            "No source-unit semantic relevance gold, independent accuracy or native business acceptance is claimed."}
    encoded = json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    (output / ("source-unit-development-"+run_id+".json")).write_text(encoded, encoding="utf-8")
    (output / "source-unit-development.json").write_text(encoded, encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ("run_id", "source_documents", "source_chunks", "derived_units", "cross_page_units",
        "conditional_mean_parent_locator_coverage_at5", "passed_integrity_checks", "business_release_ready")}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not report["passed_integrity_checks"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="保留原始页码/位置的检索单元开发对照，不发布")
    parser.add_argument("--baseline-run", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", choices=PROFILES, default="literal")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{8}", args.baseline_run):
        parser.error("需要已存在的精确开发运行编号")
    output = ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update"
    baseline = json.loads((output / ("shadow-retrieval-"+args.baseline_run+".json")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    store = KnowledgeStore(ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    frozen = store.root / "shadow-retrieval" / args.baseline_run
    snapshot = json.loads((frozen / "corpus-frozen.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    reference_bytes = (frozen / "reference-frozen.json").read_bytes()
    if fingerprint(snapshot) != baseline["corpus_sha256"] or fingerprint(reference_bytes) != baseline["reference_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("开发语料或参考冻结指纹不匹配")
    reference = json.loads(reference_bytes)
    validate_reference(reference)
    before = store.status()["counts"]
    policy_bytes = (store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()
    with store.db() as db:
        for binding in snapshot["bindings"]:
            row, _ = store._verify(db, binding["revision_id"], require_review=False)
            if any(row[key] != binding[key] for key in ("body_sha256",)) or row["sha256"] != binding["original_sha256"] or fingerprint(row["metadata"]) != binding["metadata_sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("原归档与冻结来源绑定不匹配")
    units, proposals = build_units(snapshot["chunks"], snapshot["bindings"])
    result = evaluate_units(reference["cases"], units, args.profile)
    run_id = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")+"-"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    private = store.root / "source-units" / run_id
    ensure_private_directory(private)
    private_value = {"proposals": proposals, "materialized_units": units}
    (private / "units-frozen.json").write_text(json.dumps(private_value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    checks = {"all_units_reproduce_source_spans": all(p["proposal"]["coverage_complete"] for p in proposals),
        "citation_parent_budget_respected": all(r["selected_parent_locator_count"] <= 5 and len(r["selected_units"]) <= 5 for r in result["records"]),
        "counts_unchanged": before == store.status()["counts"],
        "publication_policy_unchanged": policy_bytes == (store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()}
    report = {"run_id": run_id, "baseline_run_id": args.baseline_run, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "kind": "literal_source_unit_development", "unit_algorithm_version": VERSION, "ranker_version": RANKER_VERSION,
        "development_rank_profile": args.profile, "topic_dictionary_sha256": fingerprint(TOPICS),
        "literal_structure_algorithm_version": STRUCTURE_VERSION,
        "query_signal_version": {"intent_normalized_v1": SIGNAL_VERSION, "intent_normalized_v2": SIGNAL_V2_VERSION, "intent_normalized_v3": SIGNAL_V3_VERSION}.get(args.profile),
        "query_signal_source_sha256": fingerprint((ROOT / "src/gov_mcp/knowledge_query.py").read_bytes()) if args.profile.startswith("intent_") else None,
        "topic_dictionary_modified_for_this_experiment": False,
        "corpus_sha256": baseline["corpus_sha256"], "reference_sha256": baseline["reference_sha256"],
        "private_unit_snapshot_sha256": fingerprint(private_value), "source_documents": len(proposals),
        "source_chunks": len(snapshot["chunks"]), "derived_units": len(units),
        "cross_page_units": sum(len(parent_keys(u)) > 1 for u in units),
        "baseline_conditional_mean_parent_locator_coverage_at5": baseline["conditional_reference_mean_locator_coverage_at5"],
        **result, "checks": checks, "passed_integrity_checks": all(checks.values()),
        "human_review_completed": False, "formal_retrieval_recall_measured": False, "business_release_ready": False,
        "production_query_changed": False, "official_publication_performed": False, "model_requests": 0,
        "scope": "Literal source-unit proposals on the exact earlier frozen AI development corpus. Every part remains an exact original span. "
            "Cross-page joins are proposed reading continuations, not a single contiguous source quote or approved applicability. "
            "Coverage uses unchanged coarse parent-locator targets; it does not prove that the selected span contains the relevant claim. "
            "No source-unit semantic relevance gold, independent accuracy or native business acceptance is claimed."}
    encoded = json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    (output / ("source-unit-development-"+run_id+".json")).write_text(encoded, encoding="utf-8")
    (output / "source-unit-development.json").write_text(encoded, encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ("run_id", "source_documents", "source_chunks", "derived_units", "cross_page_units",
        "conditional_mean_parent_locator_coverage_at5", "passed_integrity_checks", "business_release_ready")}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not report["passed_integrity_checks"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)

"""Verify derived-unit storage, exact spans, backup and a separately authored AI image observation."""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_classify import VERSION
from gov_mcp.knowledge_quality import publication_policy
from gov_mcp.knowledge_structure import VERSION as STRUCTURE_VERSION, structure
from gov_mcp.knowledge_units import VERSION as UNIT_VERSION, materialize


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(ROOT / ".runtime/knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    backup = json.loads((ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/full-backup-restore.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    restored = KnowledgeStore(backup["restore"]["restored_to"], read_only=True)
    observation = json.loads((ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/source-unit-ai-visual-observation.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    checks = {"all_latest_revision_proposals_present": True, "proposal_hashes_match": True,
        "all_unit_spans_reproduce_source": True, "literal_markers_reproduce_source": True,
        "scope_and_obligations_not_approved": True,
        "restored_proposals_match_live": True, "prior_ai_visual_observation_bound_to_source": True,
        "cached_images_match_the_observed_bytes": True, "two_selected_unit_boundaries_match_observation": True,
        "ocr_missing_numbers_not_corrected": True, "publication_policy_lineage_matches": True}
    parents = units = spans = cross = markers = 0
    selected_source = None
    with store.db() as db:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM classification_proposals WHERE taxonomy_version=? AND revision_id IN "
            "(SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE rowid IN (SELECT MAX(rowid) FROM revisions GROUP BY document_id))", (VERSION,))]
        live_history = {(r["revision_id"], r["taxonomy_version"], r["sha256"]) for r in db.execute("SELECT revision_id,taxonomy_version,sha256 FROM classification_proposals")}
        latest = {r[0] for r in db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE rowid IN (SELECT MAX(rowid) FROM revisions GROUP BY document_id)")}
        checks["all_latest_revision_proposals_present"] = {r["revision_id"] for r in rows} == latest
        for row in rows:
            proposal = json.loads(row["suggestions"])
            checks["proposal_hashes_match"] &= fingerprint(proposal) == row["sha256"]
            raw, chunks = store._content(db, row["revision_id"])
            store._verify(db, row["revision_id"], require_review=False)
            by_locator = {c["locator"]: c["text"] for c in chunks}
            for section in proposal["sections"]:
                checks["literal_markers_reproduce_source"] &= section["source_structure"] == structure(by_locator[section["locator"]])
                markers += len(section["source_structure"]["markers"])
            p = proposal["retrieval_units"]
            values = materialize(p, chunks)  # Rejects changed proposals and checks all source coverage.
            parents += len(chunks)
            units += len(values)
            spans += sum(len(u["spans"]) for u in values)
            cross += sum(len({s["parent_ordinal"] for s in u["spans"]}) > 1 for u in values)
            checks["scope_and_obligations_not_approved"] &= (p["scope_inferred"] is False and p["human_review_completed"] is False
                and p["business_release_ready"] is False and p["material_obligations"] == p["current_effectivity"] == "unknown")
            source = db.execute("SELECT site_id FROM documents WHERE id=?", (raw["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            if source == "HN-MEASURES-2021-PDF":
                selected_source = (raw, values)
    with restored.db() as db:
        saved = {(r["revision_id"], r["taxonomy_version"], r["sha256"]) for r in db.execute("SELECT revision_id,taxonomy_version,sha256 FROM classification_proposals")}
    checks["restored_proposals_match_live"] = saved == live_history
    raw, values = selected_source
    checks["prior_ai_visual_observation_bound_to_source"] = (observation["reviewer_kind"] == "ai"
        and observation["human_review_completed"] is False and observation["current_effectivity_approved"] is False
        and observation["raw_sha256"] == raw["sha256"] and observation["body_sha256"] == raw["body_sha256"]
        and observation["unit_algorithm_version"] == UNIT_VERSION)
    scans = json.loads((ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/henan-scan-ocr.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    render_record = next(r for r in scans["records"] if r["source_id"] == "HN-MEASURES-2021-PDF")
    observed_images = {r["name"]: r["sha256"] for r in observation["images"]}
    for name in ("page-5.png", "page-6.png"):
        actual = fingerprint((store.root / "intake-2026-10-16/henan-measures-2021-pages" / name).read_bytes())
        checks["cached_images_match_the_observed_bytes"] &= actual == observed_images[name] == render_record["rendered_page_hashes"][name] and raw["sha256"] == render_record["raw_sha256"]
    chosen = [next(u for u in values if u["heading_surface"] and word in u["heading_surface"]) for word in ("省内通办", "压缩身份证")]
    checks["two_selected_unit_boundaries_match_observation"] = ([u["id"] for u in chosen] == observation["unit_ids"]
        and [p["locator"] for p in chosen[0]["parts"]] == ["PDF第5页（OCR待核对）"]
        and [p["locator"] for p in chosen[1]["parts"]] == ["PDF第5页（OCR待核对）", "PDF第6页（OCR待核对）"]
        and all(word not in u["text_for_ranking"] for word in ("特殊群体", "旅馆", "交通违法", "上门受理") for u in chosen)
        and all(word in chosen[1]["text_for_ranking"] for word in ("40 日", "30 日")))
    checks["ocr_missing_numbers_not_corrected"] = all(u["heading_surface"].startswith("、") and "ocr_heading_number_missing_not_corrected" in u["flags"] for u in chosen)
    plan = json.loads((ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/model-prevalidation-plan.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    policy_sha = fingerprint(publication_policy(store))
    policy_unchanged = policy_sha == plan["publication_policy_sha256"]
    transition = ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/review-contract-upgrade.json"
    change = json.loads(transition.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if transition.exists() else {}
    checks["publication_policy_lineage_matches"] = policy_unchanged or (
        change.get("passed") is True and change.get("previous_policy_sha256") == plan["publication_policy_sha256"]
        and change.get("policy_sha256") == policy_sha and change.get("quality_thresholds_unchanged") is True)
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "taxonomy_version": VERSION,
        "documents": len(rows), "canonical_parent_chunks": parents, "derived_units": units, "source_spans": spans,
        "literal_structure_version": STRUCTURE_VERSION, "literal_markers": markers,
        "classification_history_records_compared": len(live_history),
        "cross_page_proposals": cross, "counts": store.status()["counts"], "checks": checks, "passed": all(checks.values()),
        "visual_observation_sha256": fingerprint(observation), "human_review_completed": False,
        "publication_policy_sha256": policy_sha, "policy_unchanged_since_model_plan": policy_unchanged,
        "policy_transition_audit_sha256": fingerprint(transition.read_bytes()) if not policy_unchanged and transition.exists() else None,
        "scope": "Source/proposal/backup integrity across latest archives and binding to the separately recorded AI observation of two scanned units only. No other visual boundary, current policy, material relationship or business acceptance is approved."}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/source-unit-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "documents": len(rows), "units": units, "checks": checks}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not report["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Capture real unconfigured resource results in the separate fault instance."""

import asyncio
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import httpx
from mcp import ClientSession
from mcp.client.sse import sse_client

from nexent_api import NexentAPI, ROOT, RUNTIME


async def collect(user):
    token = (RUNTIME / "m1/missing-config/mcp-token.txt").read_text(encoding="ascii").strip()
    def factory(**kwargs):
        return httpx.AsyncClient(trust_env=False, **kwargs)
    records = []
    async with sse_client("http://127.0.0.1:8768/sse", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token},
                          httpx_client_factory=factory) as streams:
        async with ClientSession(*streams) as client:
            await client.initialize()
            for name in ("get_environment_status", "query_knowledge_graph", "prepare_update"):
                response = await client.call_tool("govx_" + name, {"tenant_id": user["tenant_id"], "user_id": user["user_id"]})
                value = response.structuredContent or json.loads(response.content[0].text)
                assert (value["status"], value["message_code"]) == ("ERROR", "CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIGURED")

"""Capture a single native govx run and strict terminal/route evidence."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import httpx

from m1_assessment import assess_m1
from nexent_api import NexentAPI, ROOT, RUNTIME
from gov_mcp.extension import ExtensionStore


def run(role, label, state, *, terminal=None, runtime_url="http://127.0.0.1:5014", connection_failure=False):
    accounts = json.loads((RUNTIME / "m1/accounts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    api = NexentAPI(runtime_base=runtime_url)
    events, failed = [], None
    path = RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/tool-audit.jsonl"
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        ready = False
        for _ in range(30):
            try:
                ready = api.http.get(api.runtime_base + "/health/ready", timeout=3).is_success
            except httpx.HTTPError:
                pass
            if ready:
                break
            time.sleep(1)
        if not ready:
            raise RuntimeError("M1 native runtime is not ready; no model run was started")
        user = api.login(accounts[role])
        principal = hashlib.sha256(f"{user['tenant_id']}\0{user['user_id']}".encode()).hexdigest()
        conversation = api.runtime_call("PUT", "/conversation/create", {"title": "M1-" + label})["data"]["conversation_id"]
        offset = path.stat().st_size
        payload = {"query": "空白技术验收，请按真实身份执行并在 EMPTY/BLOCKED/ERROR 后停止。", "conversation_id": conversation,
            "agent_id": state["agents"]["govx_coordinator"], "model_id": state["models"][state["active_model"]],
            "version_no": state["versions"]["govx_coordinator"], "is_debug": False, "history": [],
            "requested_output_tokens": 1024, "enable_plan": False, "enable_automation_tool": False}
        try:
            with api.http.stream("POST", api.runtime_base + "/agent/run", json=payload,
                                 headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + api.token}, timeout=httpx.Timeout(120, connect=10)) as response:
                response.raise_for_status()
                for line in response.iter_lines():
                    if time.perf_counter() - start > 240:
                        raise TimeoutError("M1 native total deadline")
                    if line.startswith("data:") and line[5:].strip():
                        events.append(json.loads(line[5:].strip()))
        except (httpx.HTTPError, TimeoutError, ValueError) as error:
            failed = type(error).__name__
            api.http.get(api.runtime_base + f"/agent/stop/{conversation}", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + api.token}, timeout=10).raise_for_status()
        with path.open("rb") as source:
            source.seek(offset)
            audit = [json.loads(line) for line in source if line.strip()]
        audit = [a for a in audit if a["principal_sha256"] == principal]
        if terminal:
            finals = [e.get("content") for e in events if e.get("type") == "final_answer" and not e.get("depth", 0)]
            try:
                value = finals[0] if len(finals) == 1 and isinstance(finals[0], dict) else json.loads("".join(finals))
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                value = None
            passed = (isinstance(value, dict) and (value.get("status"), value.get("message_code")) == terminal and
                value.get("items") == value.get("citations") == [] and value.get("knowledge_version") is None and
                not any(e.get("type") in ("subagent_start", "subagent_end", "error", "max_steps_reached") for e in events))
            if connection_failure:
                passed = (passed and not audit and value.get("data", {}).get("attempts") == 1 and
                    value.get("data", {}).get("phase") == "mcp_connection" and
                    not any(e.get("type") == "tool" or e.get("type", "").startswith("model_output") for e in events))
            else:
                passed = (passed and len(audit) == 1 and audit[0]["tool"] == "govx_get_environment_status" and
                    all(value.get(k) == audit[0]["result"].get(k) for k in ("status", "items", "citations", "knowledge_version", "message_code", "data")))
                if terminal[1] == "TOOL_TIMEOUT":
                    passed = passed and value.get("data", {}).get("attempts") == 2
            assessment = {"passed": passed, "result": value, "stop_reasons": [terminal[1] if passed else "TERMINAL_CONTRACT_NOT_MET"]}
        else:
            business_role = "staff" if role == "staff" else "citizen"
            child = "govx_staff_assistant" if business_role == "staff" else "govx_citizen_assistant"
            assessment = assess_m1(events, audit, business_role, principal, state["agents"][child])
        if failed:
            assessment["passed"] = False
            assessment["stop_reasons"].append(failed)
        record = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "conversation_id": conversation,
            "account_role": role, "runtime_url": runtime_url, "events": events, "audit": audit, "principal_sha256": principal,
            "duration_ms": round((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000, 2),
            "extension_counts": ExtensionStore(RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/extension.sqlite3").counts(), **assessment}
        (ROOT / f"evidence/m1-native-{label}.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(label, "PASS" if record["passed"] else "FAIL", record["stop_reasons"], flush=True)
        return record
    finally:
        api.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--role", default="staff")
    parser.add_argument("--label", default="staff")
    parser.add_argument("--terminal-code")
    parser.add_argument("--terminal-status", default="BLOCKED")
    parser.add_argument("--runtime-url", default="http://127.0.0.1:5014")
    parser.add_argument("--connection-failure", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    state = json.loads((RUNTIME / "m1/nexent-state.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    record = run(args.role, args.label, state,
                 terminal=(args.terminal_status, args.terminal_code) if args.terminal_code else None,
                 runtime_url=args.runtime_url, connection_failure=args.connection_failure)
    raise SystemExit(0 if record["passed"] else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Actual sidecar native storage lock, connection outage and post-fault recovery."""

import json
import hashlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import httpx

from gov_mcp.core import BlankStore
from gov_mcp.extension import ExtensionStore
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from verify_m1_native import run


@contextmanager
def extension_lock(docker):
    marker = "/tmp/gov-m1-lock-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    code = """import pathlib,select,sqlite3,sys
db=sqlite3.connect('/runtime/extension.sqlite3',timeout=2)
try:
    db.execute('BEGIN EXCLUSIVE')
    pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text('LOCKED')
    select.select([sys.stdin],[],[],300)
finally:
    db.rollback()
    db.close()
    pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).unlink(missing_ok=True)
"""
    process = subprocess.Popen([docker, "exec", "-i", "govx-blank-mcp", "python", "-c", code, marker],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    try:
        for _ in range(40):
            if process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Extension lock ended before acquisition")
            probe = subprocess.run([docker, "exec", "govx-blank-mcp", "test", "-f", marker], capture_output=True, timeout=5)
            if probe.returncode == 0:
                break
            time.sleep(.25)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Extension lock acquisition not confirmed")
        yield marker
    finally:
        try:
            process.communicate(input=b"\n", timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.kill()
            process.communicate(timeout=5)
            raise RuntimeError("Extension lock release not confirmed")
        if process.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError("Extension lock process failed")


def require_service(url):
    with httpx.Client(trust_env=False, timeout=3) as client:
        for _ in range(30):
            try:
                if client.get(url).is_success:
                    return
            except httpx.HTTPError:
                pass
            time.sleep(1)
    raise RuntimeError("Service recovery readiness not confirmed")


def capture_ui(expected_code):
    proc = subprocess.run([shutil.which("npx.cmd") or "npx", "--yes", "--package", "@playwright/cli", "playwright-cli",
        "-s=workbench", "run-code", "--filename", "scripts/m1_fault_ui.js"], cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=60)
    if proc.returncode or "### Error" in proc.stdout:
        raise RuntimeError("Actual browser fault operation failed")
    value = json.loads(proc.stdout.split("### Result", 1)[1].split("###", 1)[0].strip())
    assert value["result"]["status"] == "ERROR" and value["result"]["message_code"] == expected_code
    assert value["result"]["data"]["role"] == "citizen" and value["role_text"] == "已核定业务角色：群众"
    entries = [json.loads(line) for line in (RUNTIME / "m1/workbench-audit.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    value["workbench_audit"] = next(a for a in reversed(entries) if a["result"] == value["result"])
    if expected_code == "TOOL_TIMEOUT":
        audit = [json.loads(line) for line in (RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/tool-audit.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
        value["mcp_audit"] = next(a for a in audit if a["request_id"] == value["result"]["data"]["request_id"])
        assert value["mcp_audit"]["result"] == value["result"]
        assert value["workbench_audit"]["principal_sha256"] == value["mcp_audit"]["principal_sha256"]
    else:
        assert "request_id" not in value["result"]["data"]
        value["mcp_audit"] = None
    value["screenshot_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256((ROOT / value["screenshot"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return value


def main():
    docker = shutil.which("docker")
    if not docker:
        raise RuntimeError("Docker CLI required")
    sidecar = json.loads((ROOT / "evidence/m1-native-sidecar-success.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if sidecar.get("passed") is not True:
        raise ValueError("Sidecar success path must pass before fault injection")
    state = json.loads((RUNTIME / "m1/nexent-state.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    records = {}
    destination = ROOT / "evidence/m1-native-faults.json"
    report = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": False,
              "runtime_url": "http://127.0.0.1:5016", "records": records}
    def checkpoint():
        destination.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    checkpoint()
    try:
        require_service("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health")
        with extension_lock(docker) as marker:
            print("Govx container lock acquired; running native timeout case.", flush=True)
            report["storage_timeout_ui"] = capture_ui("TOOL_TIMEOUT")
            records["storage_timeout"] = run("fresh_citizen", "storage-timeout", state,
                terminal=("ERROR", "TOOL_TIMEOUT"), runtime_url=report["runtime_url"])
            records["storage_timeout"]["fault"] = {"kind": "actual exclusive SQLite lock inside MCP container",
                "database": ".runtime/m1/mcp/extension.sqlite3", "lock_acquisition_confirmed": True,
                "marker": marker, "release_confirmed": False}
        records["storage_timeout"]["fault"]["release_confirmed"] = True
        checkpoint()
        records["storage_recovery"] = run("fresh_citizen", "storage-recovery", state, runtime_url=report["runtime_url"])
        checkpoint()
        print("Stopping only govx MCP; original MCP and original runtime remain running.", flush=True)
        subprocess.run([docker, "stop", "govx-blank-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
        try:
            stopped = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([docker, "inspect", "govx-blank-mcp"], timeout=10))[0]
            if stopped["State"]["Running"]:
                raise RuntimeError("Govx outage was not confirmed")
            report["connection_timeout_ui"] = capture_ui("CONNECTION_OR_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE")
            records["connection_timeout"] = run("fresh_citizen", "connection-timeout", state,
                terminal=("ERROR", "CONNECTION_TIMEOUT"), runtime_url=report["runtime_url"], connection_failure=True)
            records["connection_timeout"]["fault"] = {"kind": "actual govx container stopped", "outage_confirmed": True,
                "restore_confirmed": False}
            checkpoint()
        finally:
            subprocess.run([docker, "start", "govx-blank-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
            require_service("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health")
        records["connection_timeout"]["fault"]["restore_confirmed"] = True
        records["connection_recovery"] = run("fresh_citizen", "connection-recovery", state, runtime_url=report["runtime_url"])
        report["original_counts"] = BlankStore(RUNTIME / "mcp/business.sqlite3").counts()
        report["extension_counts"] = ExtensionStore(RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/extension.sqlite3").counts()
        report["passed"] = (all(r["passed"] for r in records.values()) and
            not any(report["original_counts"].values()) and not any(report["extension_counts"].values()))
        checkpoint()
        print("M1 native faults", "PASS" if report["passed"] else "FAIL", flush=True)
    except Exception as error:
        report["failure_type"] = type(error).__name__
        checkpoint()
        raise
    raise SystemExit(0 if report["passed"] else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def extension_lock(docker):
    marker = "/tmp/gov-m1-lock-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    code = """import pathlib,select,sqlite3,sys
db=sqlite3.connect('/runtime/extension.sqlite3',timeout=2)
try:
    db.execute('BEGIN EXCLUSIVE')
    pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text('LOCKED')
    select.select([sys.stdin],[],[],300)
finally:
    db.rollback()
    db.close()
    pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).unlink(missing_ok=True)
"""
    process = subprocess.Popen([docker, "exec", "-i", "govx-blank-mcp", "python", "-c", code, marker],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    try:
        for _ in range(40):
            if process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Extension lock ended before acquisition")
            probe = subprocess.run([docker, "exec", "govx-blank-mcp", "test", "-f", marker], capture_output=True, timeout=5)
            if probe.returncode == 0:
                break
            time.sleep(.25)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Extension lock acquisition not confirmed")
        yield marker
    finally:
        try:
            process.communicate(input=b"\n", timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.kill()
            process.communicate(timeout=5)
            raise RuntimeError("Extension lock release not confirmed")
        if process.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError("Extension lock process failed")

    checkpoint()

        with extension_lock(docker) as marker:

            report["storage_timeout_ui"] = capture_ui("TOOL_TIMEOUT")

        checkpoint()

        subprocess.run([docker, "stop", "govx-blank-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)

"""Real native M1 page terminal responses via sidecar routing, with fault cleanup."""

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from nexent_api import NexentAPI, ROOT, RUNTIME
from verify_m1_native_faults import extension_lock, require_service
from verify_native_faults import root_final


def capture(code, principal):
    audit_path = RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/tool-audit.jsonl"
    offset = audit_path.stat().st_size
    proc = subprocess.run([shutil.which("npx.cmd") or "npx", "--yes", "--package", "@playwright/cli", "playwright-cli",
        "-s=m1", "run-code", "--filename", "scripts/m1_native_terminal_ui.js"], cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=180)
    if proc.returncode or "### Error" in proc.stdout:
        (RUNTIME / "m1/browser/native-fault-error.txt").write_text(proc.stdout, encoding="utf-8")
        raise RuntimeError("Native UI terminal operation failed; details retained privately")
    value = json.loads(proc.stdout.split("### Result",1)[1].split("### Ran Playwright code",1)[0].strip())
    with audit_path.open("rb") as source:
        source.seek(offset)
        audit = [json.loads(line) for line in source if line.strip()]
    audit = [a for a in audit if a["principal_sha256"] == principal]
    result = value["result"]
    clean = not any(e["type"] in ("subagent_start","subagent_end","max_steps_reached","error") for e in value["events"])
    passed = clean and result["status"] == "ERROR" and result["message_code"] == code and result["items"] == result["citations"] == []
    if code == "TOOL_TIMEOUT":
        passed = passed and len(audit)==1 and audit[0]["tool"]=="govx_get_environment_status" and result==audit[0]["result"] and result["data"]["attempts"]==2
    else:
        passed = passed and not audit and result["data"]["attempts"]==1 and result["data"]["phase"]=="mcp_connection" and not any(
            e["type"]=="tool" or e["type"].startswith("model_output") for e in value["events"])
    value.update(passed=bool(passed),audit=audit,principal_sha256=principal,
        screenshot_sha256=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/value["screenshot"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    assert type(value["conversation_id"]) is int and value["conversation_id"]>0
    assert root_final(value["events"]) == result
    return value


def main():
    docker = shutil.which("docker")
    api = NexentAPI()
    try:
        user=api.login(json.loads((RUNTIME/"m1/accounts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["fresh_citizen"])
    finally:api.close()
    principal=hashlib.sha256(f"{user['tenant_id']}\0{user['user_id']}".encode()).hexdigest()
    output={"captured_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"passed":False,"source":"actual M1 native UI entry routed to isolated runtime","records":{}}
    dest=ROOT/"evidence/m1-native-ui-faults.json"
    def save():dest.write_text(json.dumps(output,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
    save()
    with extension_lock(docker):
        output["records"]["storage_timeout"]=capture("TOOL_TIMEOUT",principal)
    output["records"]["storage_timeout"]["lock_released"]=True
    save()
    subprocess.run([docker,"stop","govx-blank-mcp"],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=30)
    try:
        output["records"]["connection_timeout"]=capture("CONNECTION_TIMEOUT",principal)
    finally:
        subprocess.run([docker,"start","govx-blank-mcp"],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=30)
        require_service("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health")
    output["records"]["connection_timeout"]["service_restored"]=True
    output["passed"]=all(r["passed"] for r in output["records"].values())
    save()
    print("Native M1 UI fault cases", "PASS" if output["passed"] else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if output["passed"] else 1)


if __name__=="__main__":main()

"""Actual govx SSE checks with platform-authenticated identities; no business fixtures."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import httpx
from mcp import ClientSession
from mcp.client.sse import sse_client

from nexent_api import NexentAPI, ROOT, RUNTIME
from gov_mcp.core import BlankStore
from gov_mcp.extension import ExtensionStore


async def verify(identities):
    token = (RUNTIME / "m1/mcp-token.txt").read_text(encoding="ascii").strip()
    records = []
    def local_client(**kwargs):
        return httpx.AsyncClient(trust_env=False, **kwargs)
    async with sse_client("http://127.0.0.1:8766/sse", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token},
                          httpx_client_factory=local_client) as streams:
        async with ClientSession(*streams) as session:
            await session.initialize()
            listed = await session.list_tools()
            names = {"govx_" + n for n in ("get_environment_status", "search_evidence", "query_knowledge_graph",
                     "check_case_prerequisites", "prepare_update", "publish_update")}
            assert {t.name for t in listed.tools} == names
            cases = [
                ("get_environment_status", "citizen", {}, "OK", "ENVIRONMENT_READY"),
                ("search_evidence", "citizen", {}, "EMPTY", "NO_KNOWLEDGE"),
                ("query_knowledge_graph", "citizen", {}, "EMPTY", "NO_GRAPH"),
                ("check_case_prerequisites", "staff", {}, "BLOCKED", "MISSING_CASE_AND_MATERIALS"),
                ("check_case_prerequisites", "citizen", {}, "BLOCKED", "FORBIDDEN"),
                ("get_environment_status", "tenant_admin", {}, "BLOCKED", "ROLE_NOT_CONFIGURED"),
                ("prepare_update", "citizen", {"inputs": []}, "BLOCKED", "FORBIDDEN"),
                ("publish_update", "citizen", {"confirmed": True}, "BLOCKED", "FORBIDDEN"),
                ("prepare_update", "staff", {"inputs": []}, "BLOCKED", "FORBIDDEN"),
                ("publish_update", "staff", {"confirmed": True}, "BLOCKED", "FORBIDDEN"),
                ("prepare_update", "developer", {"inputs": []}, "EMPTY", "NO_CHANGES"),
                ("prepare_update", "developer", {"inputs": []}, "EMPTY", "NO_CHANGES"),
                ("prepare_update", "developer", {"inputs": []}, "EMPTY", "NO_CHANGES"),
                ("publish_update", "developer", {}, "BLOCKED", "PUBLISH_PREREQUISITES_MISSING"),
                ("publish_update", "developer", {"confirmed": True}, "BLOCKED", "PUBLISH_PREREQUISITES_MISSING"),
                ("publish_update", "developer", {"candidate_id": "nonexistent", "confirmed": True}, "BLOCKED", "CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND"),
            ]
            for name, role, arguments, status, code in cases:
                identity = identities[role]
                response = await session.call_tool("govx_" + name, {"tenant_id": identity["tenant_id"],
                                                    "user_id": identity["user_id"], **arguments})
                assert not response.isError
                value = response.structuredContent or json.loads(response.content[0].text)
                assert (value["status"], value["message_code"]) == (status, code)
                assert value["items"] == value["citations"] == [] and value["knowledge_version"] is None
                records.append({"tool": "govx_" + name, "account_role": role, "result": value})
    return records


def main():
    accounts = json.loads((RUNTIME / "accounts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    api = NexentAPI()
    try:
        identities = {r: api.login(accounts[r]) for r in ("citizen", "staff", "developer", "tenant_admin")}
    finally:
        api.close()
    store = ExtensionStore(RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/extension.sqlite3")
    before = hashlib.sha256(store.path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    records = asyncio.run(verify(identities))
    after = hashlib.sha256(store.path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert before == after and not any(store.counts().values())
    audit = [json.loads(line) for line in (RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/tool-audit.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    index = {r["request_id"]: r for r in audit}
    for record in records:
        entry = index[record["result"]["data"]["request_id"]]
        principal = identities[record["account_role"]]
        assert entry["result"] == record["result"]
        assert entry["principal_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(f"{principal['tenant_id']}\0{principal['user_id']}".encode()).hexdigest()
        record["audit"] = entry
    original_counts = BlankStore(RUNTIME / "mcp/business.sqlite3").counts()
    assert not any(original_counts.values())
    output = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": True,
              "scope": "Live isolated MCP SSE with native login identities; not a replacement for native Agent or UI acceptance",
              "actual_calls": len(records), "records": records, "extension_counts": store.counts(),
              "database_sha256_before": before, "database_sha256_after": after, "original_counts": original_counts}
    (ROOT / "evidence/m1-sse.json").write_text(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"M1 live SSE: {len(records)} calls passed; audit matched; all business/candidate/version counts zero.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    api = NexentAPI()
    try:

    finally:
        api.close()
    store = ExtensionStore(RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/extension.sqlite3")
    before = hashlib.sha256(store.path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    records = asyncio.run(verify(identities))
    after = hashlib.sha256(store.path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert before == after and not any(store.counts().values())
    audit = [json.loads(line) for line in (RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/tool-audit.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    index = {r["request_id"]: r for r in audit}

        principal = identities[record["account_role"]]

        assert entry["principal_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(f"{principal['tenant_id']}\0{principal['user_id']}".encode()).hexdigest()

    original_counts = BlankStore(RUNTIME / "mcp/business.sqlite3").counts()

"""Real workbench permission and authenticated identity checks, no UI replacement."""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import httpx

from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from gov_mcp.extension import ExtensionStore


def main():
    accounts = json.loads((RUNTIME / "m1/accounts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    origin = "http://127.0.0.1:8767"
    records = []
    for role in ("staff", "fresh_citizen", "developer", "tenant_admin"):
        with httpx.Client(base_url=origin, trust_env=False, timeout=20, headers={"Origin": origin}) as client:
            assert client.get("/api/state").status_code == 401
            response = client.post("/api/login", json=accounts[role])
            assert response.status_code == 200
            assert "HttpOnly" in response.headers["set-cookie"] and "SameSite=strict" in response.headers["set-cookie"]
            value = client.get("/api/state").json()
            expected_role = {"staff": "staff", "fresh_citizen": "citizen", "developer": "staff", "tenant_admin": None}[role]
            assert value["data"].get("role") == expected_role
            records.append({"account_role": role, "operation": "state", "result": value})
            value = client.get("/api/workbench").json()
            expected_code = "MISSING_CASE_AND_MATERIALS" if expected_role == "staff" else (
                "ROLE_NOT_CONFIGURED" if expected_role is None else "FORBIDDEN")
            assert value["message_code"] == expected_code
            records.append({"account_role": role, "operation": "workbench", "result": value})
            for name, body in (("prepare_update", {"inputs": []}), ("publish_update", {"confirmed": True})):
                value = client.post("/api/tools/" + name, json=body).json()
                code = ("NO_CHANGES" if name == "prepare_update" else "PUBLISH_PREREQUISITES_MISSING") if role == "developer" else (
                    "ROLE_NOT_CONFIGURED" if expected_role is None else "FORBIDDEN")
                assert value["message_code"] == code
                records.append({"account_role": role, "operation": name, "result": value})
            for name, body in (("prepare_update", {"tenant_id": "forged", "user_id": "forged", "inputs": []}),
                               ("query_knowledge_graph", {"action": "insert"})):
                response = client.post("/api/tools/" + name, json=body)
                assert response.status_code == 400 and response.json()["message_code"] == "INVALID_ARGUMENTS"
                records.append({"account_role": role, "operation": "forged-" + name,
                                "http_status": response.status_code, "result": response.json()})
            response = client.post("/api/tools/prepare_update", json={"inputs": []}, headers={"Origin": "http://evil.example"})
            assert response.status_code == 403
            records.append({"account_role": role, "operation": "cross-origin", "http_status": 403})
            assert client.post("/api/logout", json={}).status_code == 200
            assert client.get("/api/state").status_code == 401
    counts = ExtensionStore(RUNTIME / "m1/mcp/extension.sqlite3").counts()
    assert not any(counts.values())
    output = {"captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed": True,
        "scope": "Live workbench HTTP tests; screenshots and native Agent traces are assessed separately",
        "records": records, "extension_counts": counts}
    (ROOT / "evidence/m1-workbench-api.json").write_text(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print("Workbench: 4 native identities, role/maintenance isolation, injection and CSRF checks passed.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Check pinned aliases through Ollama's real OpenAI compatibility endpoint."""

import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import httpx


def main():
    records = {}
    with httpx.Client(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:11434", trust_env=False, timeout=180) as client:
        for model in ("gov-qwen3-4b:ctx8192-v1", "gov-qwen3-8b:ctx8192-v1"):
            for row in client.get("/api/ps").json()["models"]:
                client.post("/api/generate", json={"model": row["name"], "keep_alive": 0}).raise_for_status()
            info = client.post("/api/show", json={"model": model})
            info.raise_for_status()
            parameters = info.json()["parameters"]
            root = Path.home() / ".ollama/models/manifests/registry.ollama.ai/library/qwen3"
            tag = "4b-q4_K_M" if model.startswith("gov-qwen3-4b:") else "8b-q4_K_M"
            manifest = json.loads((root / tag).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            weights = next(layer["digest"].split(":", 1)[1] for layer in manifest["layers"] if layer["mediaType"] == "application/vnd.ollama.image.model")
            assert "sha256-" + weights in info.json()["modelfile"], "Alias is not backed by the pinned downloaded weights"
            for key, value in (("num_ctx", "8192"), ("temperature", "0.1"), ("num_predict", "1024")):
                assert re.search(rf"{key}\s+{re.escape(value)}\b", parameters), (model, key)
            start = time.perf_counter()
            response = client.post("/v1/chat/completions", json={"model": model,
                "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "技术连通性测试：只输出 READY。"}],
                "temperature": .1, "max_tokens": 1024, "reasoning_effort": "none", "stream": False})
            response.raise_for_status()
            body = response.json()
            message = body["choices"][0]["message"]
            assert "READY" in message["content"]
            assert not message.get("reasoning") and not message.get("reasoning_content") and "<think>" not in message["content"]
            loaded = client.get("/api/ps").json()
            assert len(loaded["models"]) == 1
            assert loaded["models"][0].get("context_length") == 8192
            records[model] = {"parameters": parameters, "details": info.json()["details"],
                "model_info": info.json().get("model_info"), "duration_ms": round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 2),
                "response": body, "loaded": loaded, "scope": "model parameter and OpenAI endpoint check, not Agent acceptance"}
            client.post("/api/generate", json={"model": model, "keep_alive": 0}).raise_for_status()
            print(model, "parameter and non-thinking OpenAI response check PASS", flush=True)
    path = Path("evidence/model-settings.json")
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify a municipal web observation without treating it as an archived original."""
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def main():
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME/"knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    private = store.root/"source-research/zhengzhou-consent-adjustment-20261018"
    report = read(ROOT/"evaluation/knowledge/zhengzhou-undertaking-adjustment-observation-20261018.json")
    before = read(private/"before-observation.json")
    if store.status()["counts"] != before["counts"]:
        raise SystemExit("主库已有后续资料更新；保留2022公告观察阶段回执，不用当前状态覆盖")
    prior = read(ROOT/"evaluation/knowledge/zhengzhou-household-undertaking-facts-20261017.json")
    source, comparison, attempt = report["source"], report["archived_2021_comparison"], report["normal_fetch_attempt"]
    checks = {
        "observation_digest_matches":fingerprint({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k != "content_sha256"}) == report["content_sha256"],
        "page_and_signing_dates_not_invented_as_commencement":source["page_displayed_at"] == "2022-07-01 09:33" and source["body_signed_at"] == "2022-07-01" and source["legal_effective_from"] is None and source["first_publication_verified"] is False,
        "robots_denial_binds_exact_new_entry_and_no_body":attempt == read(private/"normal-fetch-receipt.json") and attempt["url"] == source["url"] and attempt["stop_detail"] == {"phase":"robots", "http_status":403} and attempt["body_acquired"] is False and not (private/"announcement.html").exists(),
        "web_observation_has_no_original_claim":source["original_sha256"] is None and source["body_normally_acquired"] is False and report["kind"] == "official_web_observation_not_archived_candidate_or_current_business_approval",
        "unread_attachment_and_rows_not_certified":all(report["attachment"][key] is False for key in ["file_obtained", "attachment_url_verified", "rows_read", "format_or_macros_inspected"]),
        "only_separate_bounded_observations": [f["id"] for f in report["observed_facts"]] == ["municipal_adjustment_context", "away_condition_proof_cancelled", "renewal_replacement_undertaking_retained"] and all(f["inference_limit"] for f in report["observed_facts"]),
        "business_conclusions_stay_unapproved":all(value is False for key,value in report["conclusions"].items() if key != "new_local_evidence_signal"),
        "drafts_and_scope_bytes_unchanged":all(fingerprint((ROOT/path).read_bytes()) == sha for path,sha in before["file_sha256"].items()),
    }
    with store.db() as db:
        row,_ = store._verify(db, comparison["revision"], require_review=False)
        _,chunks = store._content(db, row["id"])
        anchors = [{"locator":c["locator"], "text_sha256":fingerprint(c["text"].encode()), "characters":len(c["text"])} for c in chunks]
        checks["2021_archive_original_and_all_literal_anchors_bound"] = comparison["revision"] == prior["revision"] and comparison["source_id"] == prior["source_id"] and comparison["original_sha256"] == row["sha256"] == prior["original_sha256"] and comparison["literal_anchors"] == anchors
        row10 = re.sub(r"\s+", "", next(c["text"] for c in chunks if "第10项" in c["locator"]))
        checks["2021_row_10_proof_and_verification_remain_distinct"] = all(term in row10 for term in ["10", "郑州市公安局", "换领、补领居民身份证", "居民户口簿", "现场核查"]) and comparison["adjacent_row_11_is_distinct"] is True
        configs = {r["id"]:fingerprint(r["config"].encode()) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,config FROM sites")}
        checks["source_configs_and_paused_sources_unchanged"] = configs == before["configs"]
        checks["no_new_review_evaluation_version_or_publication"] = {t:db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+t).fetchone()[0] for t in before["gates"]} == before["gates"]
        checks["observation_not_inserted_into_candidate_corpus"] = db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE url=?", (source["url"],)).fetchone()[0] == 0 and store.status()["counts"] == before["counts"]
    result = {"schema":1, "captured_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "passed":all(checks.values()), "checks":checks,
        "normal_fetch_attempts":1, "body_acquired":False, "new_archived_sources":0, "new_observed_local_adjustment":1,
        "new_model_requests":0, "candidate_publications":0, "counts":store.status()["counts"],
        "limits":"Checks prove provenance and preservation only. The web observation does not certify attachment cells, later currentness or Erqi business requirements."}
    (ROOT/"evidence/knowledge-update/municipal-adjustment-observation-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not result["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify legal-text identity, dated directory limits and real candidate-only intake."""

import argparse
import json
import re
import unicodedata
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from gov_mcp.knowledge import KnowledgeStore, fingerprint
from gov_mcp.knowledge_fetch import parse_html, select_articles
from gov_mcp.knowledge_impact import revision_impact
from gov_mcp.knowledge_review import development_registry
from nexent_api import ROOT, RUNTIME
from prepare_national_law_lineage import BASE_LAW, SPECS


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def compact(value):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", value))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="核对版本身份与草案绑定，不批准现行效力或业务发布")
    parser.add_argument("--research-directory", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    research = args.research_directory.resolve()
    before = read(research / "before-canonical-intake.json")
    records = read(research / "intake-records.json")["records"]
    prior_draft = read(research / "holdout-before-refresh.json")
    draft = read(ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/holdout-business-reference-draft.json")
    store = KnowledgeStore(RUNTIME / "knowledge-update", read_only=True)
    checks = {key: True for key in ("two_pinned_normal_originals_match", "both_nonoperational_sources_are_excluded",
        "dated_directory_entry_and_date_types_match", "historical_validity_flag_not_treated_as_version_proof",
        "all_twenty_three_articles_reproduce_existing_original", "four_old_clauses_retained_and_content_equivalent",
        "old_original_and_source_pause_unchanged", "directory_real_job_completed_and_daily_monitor_ready",
        "old_frozen_development_artifacts_unchanged", "working_holdout_questions_unchanged_and_latest_sources_rebound",
        "business_policy_registry_and_zero_approval_state_preserved")}
    findings = []
    with store.db() as db:
        latest = {}
        for key, record in records.items():
            row, _ = store._verify(db, record["revision"], require_review=False)
            expected = db.execute("SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            if expected != row["id"]:
                raise ValueError("Inspected legal-source revision is no longer latest")
            latest[key] = row
        for key, spec in SPECS.items():
            row = latest[key]
            raw = (store.root / "originals" / row["sha256"][:2] / row["sha256"]).read_bytes()
            receipt = read(research / (spec["key"]+"-receipt.json"))
            checks["two_pinned_normal_originals_match"] &= (row["sha256"] == spec["sha256"] == fingerprint(raw)
                and raw == (research / spec["file"]).read_bytes() and receipt["status"] == 200 and receipt["final_url"] == spec["url"])
            store._verify_exclusion(db, row["id"])
            checks["both_nonoperational_sources_are_excluded"] &= row["state"] == "excluded"
        directory = latest["NATIONAL-LAW-DIRECTORY-2026"]
        historical = latest["NATIONAL-LAW-HISTORICAL-2003"]
        expanded = latest["EXISTING-ID-LAW-2011"]
        def chunks(row):
            return [dict(c) for c in db.execute("SELECT ordinal,locator,text FROM chunks WHERE revision_id=? ORDER BY ordinal", (row["id"],))]
        dc, hc, nc = chunks(directory), chunks(historical), chunks(expanded)
        dm, hm, nm = (json.loads(r["metadata"]) for r in (directory, historical, expanded))
        fields = dm["source_observation"]["fields"]
        checks["dated_directory_entry_and_date_types_match"] = (dc[0]["text"] == "39．中华人民共和国居民身份证法（2003年通过，2011年修正）"
            and "截至2026年8月28日" in fields["block:page_title"][0] and "2026-09-18 16:33" in fields["block:page_date_and_source"][0]
            and fields["meta:pubdate"] == ["2026-09-18 16:35"] and dm["effective_from"] is None and dm["effective_to"] is None)
        old = db.execute("SELECT * FROM revisions WHERE id=?", (BASE_LAW,)).fetchone()
        old_chunks = chunks(old)
        raw_law = (store.root / "originals" / old["sha256"][:2] / old["sha256"]).read_bytes()
        parsed, _ = parse_html(raw_law, {"class": "content-txt"}, min_text_length=1)
        reextracted = select_articles(parsed, [c["locator"] for c in nc])
        checks["all_twenty_three_articles_reproduce_existing_original"] = (len(nc) == len(reextracted) == 23
            and all(a["locator"] == b["locator"] and a["text"] == b["text"] for a, b in zip(nc, reextracted, strict=True))
            and nm["scope_confirmed"] is False and expanded["state"] == "pending_review")
        new_by_locator = {c["locator"]: c for c in nc}
        checks["four_old_clauses_retained_and_content_equivalent"] = (len(old_chunks) == 4 and old["body_sha256"] == before["law"]["body_sha256"]
            and all(compact(c["text"]) == compact(new_by_locator[c["locator"]]["text"]) for c in old_chunks))
        historical_by_locator = {c["locator"]: c for c in hc}
        checks["historical_validity_flag_not_treated_as_version_proof"] = (hm["source_observation"]["fields"]["block:reported_validity"] == ["[有效性] 是"]
            and "指纹" not in historical_by_locator["第三条"]["text"] and "指纹信息" in new_by_locator["第三条"]["text"]
            and "人民警察有下列行为" in historical_by_locator["第十九条"]["text"]
            and "金融、电信、交通、教育、医疗" in new_by_locator["第十九条"]["text"] and not hm["scope_confirmed"])
        source = db.execute("SELECT * FROM sites WHERE id='ID-LAW-01'").fetchone()
        checks["old_original_and_source_pause_unchanged"] = (old["sha256"] == expanded["sha256"] == before["law"]["original_sha256"]
            and fingerprint(source["config"].encode()) == before["old_law_source_config_sha256"]
            and source["paused_reason"] == before["old_law_paused_reason"] and not json.loads(source["config"])["enabled"])
        monitor = db.execute("SELECT * FROM sites WHERE id='NATIONAL-LAW-DIRECTORY-2026'").fetchone()
        config = json.loads(monitor["config"])
        jobs = [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT id,state,owner,error FROM jobs WHERE site_id=?", (monitor["id"],))]
        checks["directory_real_job_completed_and_daily_monitor_ready"] = (bool(jobs) and all(j["state"] == "done" and j["error"] is None for j in jobs)
            and config["enabled"] and config["interval_seconds"] == 86400 and monitor["last_success"] is not None and monitor["paused_reason"] is None
            and config["seeds"] == [SPECS[monitor["id"]]["url"]] and config["paragraph_expected_count"] == 1)
        background = []
        for row in db.execute("SELECT r.*,d.site_id FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id "
                "WHERE r.created_at>=1792159820 AND r.created_at<1792160050 ORDER BY r.rowid"):
            previous = db.execute("SELECT * FROM revisions WHERE document_id=? AND rowid<(SELECT rowid FROM revisions WHERE id=?) ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["document_id"], row["id"])).fetchone()
            impact = revision_impact(store, row["id"])
            job = db.execute("SELECT j.id,j.state,j.owner FROM jobs j JOIN documents d ON d.site_id=j.site_id AND d.url=j.url WHERE d.id=?", (row["document_id"],)).fetchone()
            background.append({"site_id": row["site_id"], "revision": row["id"], "previous_revision": previous["id"], "previous_state": previous["state"],
                "same_original": row["sha256"] == previous["sha256"], "same_body": row["body_sha256"] == previous["body_sha256"],
                "changed_metadata": impact["changed_metadata_fields"], "current_state": row["state"], "job_receipt": dict(job) if job else None})
        checks["business_policy_registry_and_zero_approval_state_preserved"] = (fingerprint((store.root / "publication-policy.json").read_bytes()) == before["policy_sha256"]
            and len(development_registry(db)) == 40 and all(db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "+table).fetchone()[0] == 0 for table in ("reviews", "snapshot_evaluations", "versions", "heads")))
        def anchor(row, chunk):
            return {"revision": row["id"], "ordinal": chunk["ordinal"], "locator": chunk["locator"], "start": 0, "end": len(chunk["text"]),
                "parent_text_sha256": fingerprint(chunk["text"].encode()), "span_sha256": fingerprint(chunk["text"].encode())}
        findings = [
            {"id": "dated_edition_identity", "finding": "目录记录截至2026-08-28的2011修正版本身份；网页显示2026-09-18 16:33，meta标16:35，两者不作法律施行日。", "anchors": [anchor(directory, dc[0])]},
            {"id": "validity_badge_is_not_text_edition", "finding": "历史2003文本页面有效性原标记为是，网页显示为现行有效；其第三条缺少2011文本指纹内容，不能单凭页面标签选择法律版本。", "anchors": [anchor(historical, historical_by_locator["第三条"]), anchor(expanded, new_by_locator["第三条"])]},
            {"id": "article_numbers_need_version_binding", "finding": "2003与2011的第十九条指向不同正文，引用必须绑定版本、原件和具体条文，不能只按同名法律及条号拼接。", "anchors": [anchor(historical, historical_by_locator["第十九条"]), anchor(expanded, new_by_locator["第十九条"])]},
            {"id": "original_act_and_amendment_dates_differ", "finding": "2003第22条与2011第23条均提原法2004施行；2011末条另有2012/2013证件过渡内容。不能把原法起始日直接改作2011修改决定起始日，修改决定正常原件链仍未补齐。", "anchors": [anchor(historical, historical_by_locator["第二十二条"]), anchor(expanded, new_by_locator["第二十三条"])]},
            {"id": "same_archived_original_more_complete_extraction", "finding": "既有原件从4条重提取为23条，原件与原四条保留；不是重新抓取暂停来源，也不是已核定当前全部条款。", "anchors": [anchor(expanded, new_by_locator["第十一条"])]}]
    for path, expected in before["preserved_development_files"].items():
        checks["old_frozen_development_artifacts_unchanged"] &= fingerprint((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == expected
    checks["working_holdout_questions_unchanged_and_latest_sources_rebound"] = (before["old_holdout_content_sha256"] == prior_draft["content_sha256"]
        and before["holdout_questions"] == [c["question_sha256"] for c in draft["cases"]]
        and draft["sources"]["LAW"]["revision"] == expanded["id"] and not draft["independence_certified"] and draft["reference_frozen_at"] is None)
    receipts = [read(path) for path in sorted(research.glob("*-receipt.json"))]
    assessment = {"schema": 1, "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "reviewer_kind": "ai", "reviewer": "Codex AI",
        "human_review_completed": False, "current_applicability_after_2026_08_28": "not_certified", "business_release_ready": False,
        "sources": records, "findings": findings, "acquisition_observations": receipts, "background_refresh_observations": background,
        "draft_binding_refresh": {"previous_content_sha256": prior_draft["content_sha256"], "content_sha256": draft["content_sha256"],
            "question_hashes_unchanged": before["holdout_questions"] == [c["question_sha256"] for c in draft["cases"]]},
        "limits": ["目录只覆盖其截止日期，不认证此后现行效力；精确页监测不保证发现另一个URL的新目录。", "SAMR栏目入口为客户端框架，未配置新目录自动发现；未模拟签名或调用模板构建接口。", "暂停来源没有恢复，TLS/证书失败未关闭校验；404和采集失败均不推断法律废止。", "后台另有12份相同原件的观察字段/父修订变化，其中10份曾排除的资料重新待核，未自动沿用排除。", "本地材料、六个月调整、收费关系和独立业务验收仍未解决。"]}
    assessment["assessment_sha256"] = fingerprint(assessment)
    (ROOT / "evaluation/knowledge/national-law-lineage-assessments.json").write_text(json.dumps(assessment, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
    report = {"captured_at": assessment["captured_at"], "passed": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks,
        "new_originals": 2, "existing_law_articles": 23, "source_records": len(records), "findings": len(findings),
        "source_anchors": sum(len(f["anchors"]) for f in findings), "assessment_sha256": assessment["assessment_sha256"],
        "background_refresh_count": len(background), "directory_jobs": jobs, "counts": store.status()["counts"],
        "business_release_ready": False, "scope": "Original/edition identity, extraction, historical exclusion, bounded monitoring and reference separation; not a current-policy or business-accuracy approval."}
    (ROOT / "evidence/knowledge-update/national-law-lineage-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "checks": checks, "counts": report["counts"], "background_refresh_count": len(background)}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if not report["passed"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
