class M2Tools:
    def __init__(self, runtime: Path):
        self.runtime = Path(runtime)
        self.store = M2Store(runtime)
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def principal(self, tenant, user):
        mapping = json.loads((self.runtime / "role-map.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        principal = mapping.get(tenant, {}).get(user)
        if not isinstance(principal, dict) or principal.get("role") not in ("citizen", "staff"):
            raise WorkflowBlocked("ROLE_NOT_CONFIGURED")
        return principal["role"]

    def execute(self, name, tenant_id, user_id, **args):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        role = None
        try:
            role = self.principal(tenant_id, user_id)
            permissions = {
                "get_environment_status": {"citizen", "staff"}, "create_task": {"citizen"},
                "search_evidence": {"citizen", "staff"}, "declare_materials": {"citizen"},
                "create_handoff": {"citizen"}, "list_handoffs": {"staff"},
                "check_case_prerequisites": {"staff"}, "confirm_review": {"staff"}}
            if name not in permissions:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("UNKNOWN_TOOL")
            if role not in permissions[name]:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("FORBIDDEN")
            with self.store.connect(write=name in {"create_task", "declare_materials", "create_handoff", "confirm_review"}) as db:
                value = self.dispatch(db, name, tenant_id, user_id, role, args)
        except WorkflowBlocked as error:
            value = result("BLOCKED", error.code, **error.data)
        except sqlite3.OperationalError as error:
            code = "TOOL_TIMEOUT" if getattr(error, "sqlite_errorcode", 0) & 0xff in (sqlite3.SQLITE_BUSY, sqlite3.SQLITE_LOCKED) else "STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"
            value = result("ERROR", code, attempts=1)
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
            value = result("ERROR", "CONFIG_OR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE")
        value["data"].update(request_id=secrets.token_hex(8), role=role, demo_mode=True,
                             notice=NOTICE, formal_approval=False)
        entry = {"time": now(), "tool": "govm2_" + name, "request_id": value["data"]["request_id"],
                 "principal_sha256": hashlib.sha256(f"{tenant_id}\0{user_id}".encode()).hexdigest(),
                 "role": role, "duration_ms": round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 2), "result": value}
        with self.lock, (self.runtime / "tool-audit.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as log:
            log.write(canonical(entry) + "\n")
        return value

    def task(self, db, tenant, user, role, task_id=None):
        if task_id:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE task_id=? AND tenant_id=?", (task_id, tenant)).fetchone()
        else:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE tenant_id=? AND owner_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (tenant, user)).fetchone()
        if not row or (role == "citizen" and row["owner_id"] != user):
            raise WorkflowBlocked("TASK_NOT_FOUND")
        return row

    def handoff(self, db, tenant, handoff_id=None):
        if handoff_id:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM handoffs WHERE handoff_id=? AND tenant_id=?", (handoff_id, tenant)).fetchone()
        else:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM handoffs WHERE tenant_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (tenant,)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            raise WorkflowBlocked("HANDOFF_NOT_FOUND")
        return row

    def citation(self, row):
        return {"citation_id": row["chunk_id"], "source_id": row["source_id"], "title": row["title"],
                "url": row["url"], "locator": row["locator"], "quote": row["text"],
                "knowledge_version": row["version_id"], "category": row["category"], "region": row["region"],
                "review_status": row["review_status"]}

    def evidence(self, db, task, query):
        rows = db.execute("""SELECT c.*,s.title,s.url,s.review_status FROM chunks c JOIN sources s USING(source_id)
            WHERE c.version_id=? AND c.matter_id=? AND c.region IN ('national','郑州市二七区')""",
            (task["version_id"], task["matter_id"])).fetchall()
        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "", query)
        grams = {normalized[i:i+2] for i in range(max(len(normalized)-1, 0))}
        ranked = [(sum(g in r["text"] for g in grams), r) for r in rows]
        return [self.citation(r) for score, r in sorted(ranked, key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]["chunk_id"])) if score > 0][:4]

    def assessment(self, db, row):
        snapshot = json.loads(row["snapshot_json"])
        declarations = snapshot["materials"]
        # This is a draft presence checklist from the cited local guide. The
        # household-register necessity is explicitly unresolved, never a verdict.
        missing = ["原居民身份证"] if declarations["identity_card"] == "missing" else []
        unknown = ["原居民身份证"] if declarations["identity_card"] == "unknown" else []
        pending = ["居民户口簿在本地成年人到期换领中的具体要求", "原件、共享核实和当前政策版本"]
        value = result("OK", "PREVIEW_ASSESSMENT_COMPLETE", handoff_id=row["handoff_id"],
                       task_id=row["task_id"], state=row["state"], materials=declarations,
                       missing_draft_items=missing, unknown_items=unknown, source_review_pending=pending,
                       ready_for_formal_processing=False, input_origin="simulated_material_presence")
        value["knowledge_version"] = row["version_id"]
        value["citations"] = snapshot["citations"]
        value["data"]["assessment_sha256"] = digest({"handoff": row["handoff_id"], "version": row["version_id"],
            "materials": declarations, "missing": missing, "unknown": unknown, "pending": pending})
        return value

    def dispatch(self, db, name, tenant, user, role, args):
        if name == "get_environment_status":
            version = db.execute("SELECT version_id FROM versions ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
            if not version:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("NO_PREVIEW_KNOWLEDGE")
            value = result("OK", "M2_PREVIEW_READY", matter_id=MATTER,
                matter_name="郑州市二七区成年人本地户籍身份证到期换领（候选范围）",
                source_review_status="pending_business_review", classifications=CATEGORY_LABELS)
            value["knowledge_version"] = version["version_id"]
            return value
        if name == "create_task":
            question = args.get("question", "")
            if not isinstance(question, str) or not question.strip() or len(question) > 300:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("INVALID_QUESTION")
            if re.search(r"\d{17}[\dXx]|[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}", question):
                raise WorkflowBlocked("PERSONAL_DATA_NOT_ALLOWED")
            version = db.execute("SELECT version_id FROM versions ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
            if not version:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("NO_PREVIEW_KNOWLEDGE")
            task_id = "task-" + secrets.token_hex(6)
            materials = {"identity_card": "unknown", "household_register": "unknown"}
            db.execute("INSERT INTO tasks VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (task_id, tenant, user, MATTER,
                version["version_id"], "draft", question.strip(), canonical(materials), now()))
            value = result("OK", "DEMO_TASK_CREATED", task_id=task_id, state="draft", materials=materials)
            value["knowledge_version"] = version["version_id"]
            return value
        if name == "list_handoffs":
            rows = db.execute("SELECT handoff_id,task_id,version_id,state,created_at FROM handoffs WHERE tenant_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC", (tenant,)).fetchall()
            value = result("OK", "HANDOFF_QUEUE", pending_count=sum(r["state"] != "demo_reviewed" for r in rows))
            value["items"] = [dict(r) for r in rows]
            return value
        if name in ("check_case_prerequisites", "confirm_review"):
            row = self.handoff(db, tenant, args.get("handoff_id"))
            value = self.assessment(db, row)
            if name == "confirm_review":
                if args.get("confirmed") is not True or args.get("assessment_sha256") != value["data"]["assessment_sha256"]:
                    raise WorkflowBlocked("CONFIRMATION_OR_ASSESSMENT_MISMATCH")
                previous = db.execute("SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE handoff_id=?", (row["handoff_id"],)).fetchone()
                if previous and previous["assessment_sha256"] != value["data"]["assessment_sha256"]:
                    raise WorkflowBlocked("REVIEW_CONFLICT")
                db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reviews VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)", (row["handoff_id"], user,
                    row["version_id"], value["data"]["assessment_sha256"], "demo_ui_confirmation", now()))
                db.execute("UPDATE handoffs SET state='demo_reviewed' WHERE handoff_id=?", (row["handoff_id"],))
                db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET state='demo_reviewed' WHERE task_id=?", (row["task_id"],))
                value["message_code"] = "DEMO_REVIEW_RECORDED"
                value["data"].update(state="demo_reviewed", confirmation_kind="demo_ui_confirmation", business_rule_review_completed=False)
            return value
        task = self.task(db, tenant, user, role, args.get("task_id"))
        if name == "search_evidence":
            query = args.get("query") or task["question"]
            if not isinstance(query, str) or len(query) > 300:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("INVALID_QUESTION")
            citations = self.evidence(db, task, query)
            value = result("OK" if citations else "EMPTY", "PREVIEW_EVIDENCE_FOUND" if citations else "NO_SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE",
                task_id=task["task_id"], state=task["state"], question=task["question"],
                materials=json.loads(task["materials_json"]), source_review_status="pending_business_review")
            value["knowledge_version"] = task["version_id"]
            value["citations"] = citations
            value["items"] = [{"text": c["quote"], "citation_id": c["citation_id"], "category": c["category"]} for c in citations]
            return value
        if task["state"] != "draft":
            if name == "create_handoff":
                existing = db.execute("SELECT * FROM handoffs WHERE task_id=?", (task["task_id"],)).fetchone()
                if existing and existing["idempotency_key"] == args.get("idempotency_key"):
                    value = result("OK", "HANDOFF_REUSED", task_id=task["task_id"], handoff_id=existing["handoff_id"], state=existing["state"])
                    value["knowledge_version"] = existing["version_id"]
                    return value
            raise WorkflowBlocked("TASK_ALREADY_HANDED_OFF")
        if name == "declare_materials":
            materials = args.get("materials")
            if not isinstance(materials, dict) or set(materials) != {"identity_card", "household_register"} or any(v not in ("present", "missing", "unknown") for v in materials.values()):
                raise WorkflowBlocked("INVALID_MATERIAL_DECLARATION")
            db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET materials_json=? WHERE task_id=?", (canonical(materials), task["task_id"]))
            value = result("OK", "SIMULATED_MATERIALS_SAVED", task_id=task["task_id"], materials=materials)
            value["knowledge_version"] = task["version_id"]
            return value
        key = args.get("idempotency_key")
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{8,80}", key):
            raise WorkflowBlocked("INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY")
        citations = self.evidence(db, task, task["question"])
        if not citations:
            raise WorkflowBlocked("NO_SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE")
        snapshot = {"task_id": task["task_id"], "version_id": task["version_id"], "question": task["question"],
                    "materials": json.loads(task["materials_json"]), "citations": citations, "input_origin": "simulated_material_presence"}
        existing = db.execute("SELECT * FROM handoffs WHERE tenant_id=? AND owner_id=? AND idempotency_key=?", (tenant, user, key)).fetchone()
        if existing:
            raise WorkflowBlocked("IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT")
        handoff_id = "handoff-" + secrets.token_hex(6)
        db.execute("INSERT INTO handoffs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (handoff_id, task["task_id"], tenant, user,
            task["version_id"], key, digest(snapshot), canonical(snapshot), "awaiting_demo_review", now()))
        db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET state='handed_off' WHERE task_id=?", (task["task_id"],))
        value = result("OK", "HANDOFF_CREATED", task_id=task["task_id"], handoff_id=handoff_id, state="awaiting_demo_review")
        value["knowledge_version"] = task["version_id"]
        value["citations"] = citations
        return value

symbols.source:
def dispatch(self, db, name, tenant, user, role, args):
        if name == "get_environment_status":
            version = db.execute("SELECT version_id FROM versions ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
            if not version:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("NO_PREVIEW_KNOWLEDGE")
            value = result("OK", "M2_PREVIEW_READY", matter_id=MATTER,
                matter_name="郑州市二七区成年人本地户籍身份证到期换领（候选范围）",
                source_review_status="pending_business_review", classifications=CATEGORY_LABELS)
            value["knowledge_version"] = version["version_id"]
            return value
        if name == "create_task":
            question = args.get("question", "")
            if not isinstance(question, str) or not question.strip() or len(question) > 300:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("INVALID_QUESTION")
            if re.search(r"\d{17}[\dXx]|[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}", question):
                raise WorkflowBlocked("PERSONAL_DATA_NOT_ALLOWED")
            version = db.execute("SELECT version_id FROM versions ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
            if not version:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("NO_PREVIEW_KNOWLEDGE")
            task_id = "task-" + secrets.token_hex(6)
            materials = {"identity_card": "unknown", "household_register": "unknown"}
            db.execute("INSERT INTO tasks VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (task_id, tenant, user, MATTER,
                version["version_id"], "draft", question.strip(), canonical(materials), now()))
            value = result("OK", "DEMO_TASK_CREATED", task_id=task_id, state="draft", materials=materials)
            value["knowledge_version"] = version["version_id"]
            return value
        if name == "list_handoffs":
            rows = db.execute("SELECT handoff_id,task_id,version_id,state,created_at FROM handoffs WHERE tenant_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC", (tenant,)).fetchall()
            value = result("OK", "HANDOFF_QUEUE", pending_count=sum(r["state"] != "demo_reviewed" for r in rows))
            value["items"] = [dict(r) for r in rows]
            return value
        if name in ("check_case_prerequisites", "confirm_review"):
            row = self.handoff(db, tenant, args.get("handoff_id"))
            value = self.assessment(db, row)
            if name == "confirm_review":
                if args.get("confirmed") is not True or args.get("assessment_sha256") != value["data"]["assessment_sha256"]:
                    raise WorkflowBlocked("CONFIRMATION_OR_ASSESSMENT_MISMATCH")
                previous = db.execute("SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE handoff_id=?", (row["handoff_id"],)).fetchone()
                if previous and previous["assessment_sha256"] != value["data"]["assessment_sha256"]:
                    raise WorkflowBlocked("REVIEW_CONFLICT")
                db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reviews VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)", (row["handoff_id"], user,
                    row["version_id"], value["data"]["assessment_sha256"], "demo_ui_confirmation", now()))
                db.execute("UPDATE handoffs SET state='demo_reviewed' WHERE handoff_id=?", (row["handoff_id"],))
                db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET state='demo_reviewed' WHERE task_id=?", (row["task_id"],))
                value["message_code"] = "DEMO_REVIEW_RECORDED"
                value["data"].update(state="demo_reviewed", confirmation_kind="demo_ui_confirmation", business_rule_review_completed=False)
            return value
        task = self.task(db, tenant, user, role, args.get("task_id"))
        if name == "search_evidence":
            query = args.get("query") or task["question"]
            if not isinstance(query, str) or len(query) > 300:
                raise WorkflowBlocked("INVALID_QUESTION")
            citations = self.evidence(db, task, query)
            value = result("OK" if citations else "EMPTY", "PREVIEW_EVIDENCE_FOUND" if citations else "NO_SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE",
                task_id=task["task_id"], state=task["state"], question=task["question"],
                materials=json.loads(task["materials_json"]), source_review_status="pending_business_review")
            value["knowledge_version"] = task["version_id"]
            value["citations"] = citations
            value["items"] = [{"text": c["quote"], "citation_id": c["citation_id"], "category": c["category"]} for c in citations]
            return value
        if task["state"] != "draft":
            if name == "create_handoff":
                existing = db.execute("SELECT * FROM handoffs WHERE task_id=?", (task["task_id"],)).fetchone()
                if existing and existing["idempotency_key"] == args.get("idempotency_key"):
                    value = result("OK", "HANDOFF_REUSED", task_id=task["task_id"], handoff_id=existing["handoff_id"], state=existing["state"])
                    value["knowledge_version"] = existing["version_id"]
                    return value
            raise WorkflowBlocked("TASK_ALREADY_HANDED_OFF")
        if name == "declare_materials":
            materials = args.get("materials")
            if not isinstance(materials, dict) or set(materials) != {"identity_card", "household_register"} or any(v not in ("present", "missing", "unknown") for v in materials.values()):
                raise WorkflowBlocked("INVALID_MATERIAL_DECLARATION")
            db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET materials_json=? WHERE task_id=?", (canonical(materials), task["task_id"]))
            value = result("OK", "SIMULATED_MATERIALS_SAVED", task_id=task["task_id"], materials=materials)
            value["knowledge_version"] = task["version_id"]
            return value
        key = args.get("idempotency_key")
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{8,80}", key):
            raise WorkflowBlocked("INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY")
        citations = self.evidence(db, task, task["question"])
        if not citations:
            raise WorkflowBlocked("NO_SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE")
        snapshot = {"task_id": task["task_id"], "version_id": task["version_id"], "question": task["question"],
                    "materials": json.loads(task["materials_json"]), "citations": citations, "input_origin": "simulated_material_presence"}
        existing = db.execute("SELECT * FROM handoffs WHERE tenant_id=? AND owner_id=? AND idempotency_key=?", (tenant, user, key)).fetchone()
        if existing:
            raise WorkflowBlocked("IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT")
        handoff_id = "handoff-" + secrets.token_hex(6)
        db.execute("INSERT INTO handoffs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (handoff_id, task["task_id"], tenant, user,
            task["version_id"], key, digest(snapshot), canonical(snapshot), "awaiting_demo_review", now()))
        db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET state='handed_off' WHERE task_id=?", (task["task_id"],))
        value = result("OK", "HANDOFF_CREATED", task_id=task["task_id"], handoff_id=handoff_id, state="awaiting_demo_review")
        value["knowledge_version"] = task["version_id"]
        value["citations"] = citations
        return value

async def identity(request):
        session = sessions.get(request.cookies.get("govm2_session"))
        if not session or session["expires"] <= time.monotonic():
            return None
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(trust_env=False, timeout=10) as client:
                response = await client.get(config_url + "/user/current_user_info", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + session["token"]})
                response.raise_for_status()
                user = response.json()["data"]["user"]
            if not user.get("tenant_id") or not user.get("user_id"):
                return None
            return user, session
        except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
            return None

async def call(name, user, **arguments):
        def factory(**kwargs):
            return httpx.AsyncClient(trust_env=False, **kwargs)
        try:
            async with sse_client(mcp_url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token}, timeout=5,
                                  sse_read_timeout=15, httpx_client_factory=factory) as streams:
                async with ClientSession(*streams) as client:
                    await client.initialize()
                    response = await client.call_tool("govm2_" + name,
                        {"tenant_id": user["tenant_id"], "user_id": user["user_id"], **arguments})
                    value = result("ERROR", "TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED") if response.isError else (response.structuredContent or json.loads(response.content[0].text))
        except Exception:
            value = result("ERROR", "CONNECTION_OR_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE", attempts=1, role=role_for(user))
        record(user, "govm2_" + name, value)
        return value

def source_facts(manifest):
    by_id = {s["source_id"]: s for s in manifest["sources"]}
    def cite(source_id, section_id):
        source = by_id[source_id]
        quote = source["sections"][section_id]["text"]
        return {"source_id": source_id, "section_id": section_id, "quote": quote,
                "start": 0, "end": len(quote), "raw_sha256": source["raw_sha256"],
                "url": source["url"] + "#" + section_id}
    fee = cite("erqi", "section-text_04")
    duration = cite("erqi", "section-text_03")
    materials = cite("erqi", "section-txt1")
    if ("20元/证" not in fee["quote"] or duration["quote"] != "15个工作日"
            or not all(w in materials["quote"] for w in ("居民户口簿", "原居民身份证", "未满十六周岁", "跨户籍所在地市"))):
        raise PreviewError("GUIDE_FACTS_CHANGED_REVIEW_REQUIRED")
    specs = [
        ("fee", "20元/证", "The county guide states a standard renewal fee of 20 CNY per card; this does not establish personal fee-relief eligibility.", fee),
        ("duration", "15个工作日", "The county guide states 15 working days; its relationship to other service commitments remains unverified.", duration),
        ("materials", ["居民户口簿", "原居民身份证"], "The county guide lists a household register and the original resident identity card, with separate conditions for minors and cross-city processing. This is a source description, not a confirmed current checklist.", materials),
        ("address", by_id["minggong"]["sections"]["section-text_05"]["text"], "The Minggong guide gives the window address shown in this claim's value.", cite("minggong", "section-text_05")),
        ("phone", by_id["minggong"]["sections"]["section-text_06"]["text"], "The Minggong guide gives the contact phone number shown in this claim's value.", cite("minggong", "section-text_06")),
    ]
    return [{"id": i, "value": value, "statement": statement, "citation": reference} for i, value, statement, reference in specs]

def _context(self, task=None):
        manifest = check_manifest(self.root)
        gates = read(self.root / "gates.json")
        if (set(gates) != {"mode", "paused_fields", "source_stopped"} or gates["mode"] != "public_preview"
                or type(gates["source_stopped"]) is not bool or gates["source_stopped"]
                or not isinstance(gates["paused_fields"], dict) or not set(PAUSES) <= gates["paused_fields"].keys()
                or any(not isinstance(v, str) or not v.strip() for v in gates["paused_fields"].values())):
            raise PreviewError("CURRENT_PAUSE_GATE_BLOCKED")
        binding = fingerprint({"manifest": manifest, "gates": gates})

def begin_run(self, repair_note=None):
        self._context()
        with self.db() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            runs = db.execute("SELECT * FROM runs ORDER BY ordinal").fetchall()
            if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM flags WHERE name='external_block' OR name='passed'").fetchone():
                raise PreviewError("CAMPAIGN_STOPPED")
            if len(runs) >= 3:
                raise PreviewError("NATIVE_RUN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED")
            if runs and (runs[-1]["status"] != "failed" or not isinstance(repair_note, str) or not 8 <= len(repair_note) <= 300):
                raise PreviewError("DOCUMENTED_REPAIR_REQUIRED")
            if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM tasks WHERE json_extract(payload,'$.status')='verifying'").fetchone():
                raise PreviewError("VERIFICATION_STILL_IN_PROGRESS")
            run_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
            db.execute("INSERT INTO runs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", (run_id, len(runs)+1, "running", repair_note, utcnow()))
            db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO flags VALUES('active_run',?)", (run_id,))
        return run_id

def finalize(self, task_id):
        with self.db() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            task = self._get(db, task_id); manifest, gates, _ = self._context(task)
            if task["status"] not in {"can_finalize", "complete"} or task["facts"] != source_facts(manifest):
                raise PreviewError("VERIFIED_TASK_REQUIRED")
            verification = task["verification"]
            path = self.root / (task_id + "-jev.json")
            if source_digest(path.read_bytes()) != verification["receipt_sha256"] or verification["source_binding"] != task["binding"]:
                raise PreviewError("MODEL_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
            response = read(path)["result"]
            expected = {k: v["noul"] for k, v in response["answers"].items()}
            if expected != verification["probabilities"] or verification["threshold"] != .8:
                raise PreviewError("STORED_VERDICT_CHANGED")
            facts = [{**f, "status": "source_supported" if expected[f["id"]] >= .8 else "needs_review",
                      "support": expected[f["id"]]} for f in task["facts"]]
            answer = {"task_id": task_id, "status": "partial_preview", "mode": "public_preview", "data_class": "public",
                "snapshot_binding": task["binding"], "source_facts": facts,
                "pending_business_conclusions": [{"field": k, "status": "paused", "reason": v} for k, v in gates["paused_fields"].items()],
                "unknown_fields": ["advance_days"], "invented_advance_rejected": expected["invented_advance"] <= .2,
                "portal_evidence": manifest["portal"]["status"], "published": False, "formal_approval": False,
                "notice": "真实公开资料的原文解释预览；待核事项不构成现行办理要求，未提交任何申请。"}
            if task["answer"] is not None and task["answer"] != answer:
                raise PreviewError("PERSISTED_ANSWER_CHANGED")
            task.update(status="complete", answer=answer); self._save(db, task)
            return answer

            references.append({'source_id': context['source_id'], 'url': context['url'], 'locator': chunk['locator'],

"""Serve three authenticated MCP tools over SSE."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import uvicorn
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
from mcp.server.transport_security import TransportSecurityMiddleware, TransportSecuritySettings
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.routing import Route

from gov_mcp.core import BlankStore, GovernmentTools


class BearerGate:
    def __init__(self, app, token: str, security=None):
        self.app = app
        self.token = token
        self.security = security

    async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send):
        if scope["type"] == "http" and scope["path"] != "/health":
            headers = dict(scope.get("headers", []))
            supplied = headers.get(b"authorization", b"")
            if not secrets.compare_digest(supplied, f"Bearer {self.token}".encode("ascii")):
                await JSONResponse({"error": "UNAUTHORIZED"}, status_code=401)(scope, receive, send)
                return
            if self.security:
                rejected = await self.security.validate_request(Request(scope), is_post=scope["method"] == "POST")
                if rejected is not None:
                    await rejected(scope, receive, send)
                    return
        await self.app(scope, receive, send)


def create_app(runtime: Path, token: str):
    if len(token) < 32 or not token.isascii():
        raise ValueError("A dedicated MCP bearer token of at least 32 characters is required")
    runtime.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    roles = runtime / "role-map.json"
    if not roles.exists():
        roles.write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    tools = GovernmentTools(BlankStore(runtime / "business.sqlite3"), roles)
    mcp = FastMCP("gov_blank_mcp", transport_security=TransportSecuritySettings(
        enable_dns_rebinding_protection=True,
        allowed_hosts=["127.0.0.1:*", "localhost:*", "gov-blank-mcp:8765"],
        allowed_origins=["http://127.0.0.1:*", "http://localhost:*"],
    ))

    def record(name: str, operation, tenant_id: str, user_id: str):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        value = operation(tenant_id, user_id)
        value["data"]["request_id"] = secrets.token_hex(8)
        entry = {
            "time": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "tool": name,
            "request_id": value["data"]["request_id"],
            "status": value["status"], "message_code": value["message_code"],
            "duration_ms": round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2),
            "principal_sha256": hashlib.sha256(f"{tenant_id}\0{user_id}".encode()).hexdigest(),
            "result": value,
        }
        with (runtime / "tool-audit.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as log:
            log.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        return value

    @mcp.tool()
    def get_environment_status(tenant_id: str, user_id: str) -> dict:
        """Get environment state and authenticated business role. Identity is injected by Nexent."""
        return record("get_environment_status", tools.get_environment_status, tenant_id, user_id)

    @mcp.tool()
    def search_evidence(tenant_id: str, user_id: str) -> dict:
        """Inspect empty evidence storage. EMPTY is terminal; never retry it or invent evidence."""
        return record("search_evidence", tools.search_evidence, tenant_id, user_id)

    @mcp.tool()
    def check_case_prerequisites(tenant_id: str, user_id: str) -> dict:
        """Check staff permission and missing prerequisites. BLOCKED is terminal, never an approval verdict."""
        return record("check_case_prerequisites", tools.check_case_prerequisites, tenant_id, user_id)

    async def health(request):
        return JSONResponse({"service": "gov_blank_mcp", "status": "UP"})

    app = mcp.sse_app()
    app.router.routes.insert(0, Route("/health", health))
    return BearerGate(app, token, TransportSecurityMiddleware(mcp.settings.transport_security))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8765)
    parser.add_argument("--runtime", type=Path, default=Path(".runtime/mcp"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    token = os.environ.get("GOV_MCP_TOKEN", "")
    if not token:
        token = (args.runtime / "mcp-token.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    uvicorn.run(create_app(args.runtime, token), host=args.host, port=args.port, log_level="warning")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

async def identity(request):
        entry = sessions.get(request.cookies.get("govx_session"))
        if not entry or entry["expires"] <= time.monotonic():
            return None
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(trust_env=False, timeout=10) as client:
                response = await client.get(config_url + "/user/current_user_info",
                    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + entry["token"]})
                response.raise_for_status()
                user = response.json()["data"]["user"]
                if not user.get("tenant_id") or not user.get("user_id"):
                    return None
                return user
        except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError, KeyError):
            return None

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$TaskRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Set-Location -LiteralPath $TaskRoot
$Python = Join-Path $TaskRoot '.venv/Scripts/python.exe'
$Git = (Get-Command git -ErrorAction Stop).Source
$Bash = Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $Git -Parent) -Parent) 'bin/bash.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Bash)) { throw 'Git for Windows Bash was not found beside git.exe.' }
$DockerCandidates = @("$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/DockerDesktop/resources/bin/docker.exe", 'C:/Program Files/Docker/Docker/resources/bin/docker.exe')
$Docker = $DockerCandidates | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $Docker) { throw 'Docker executable not found.' }
$env:PATH = "$(Split-Path -Parent $Docker);$env:PATH"
& $Python scripts/check_native_ready.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native services are not ready; no account operation was attempted.' }
Write-Output 'User-started operation: initialize the local super administrator, sign in through the API, and create one administrator invitation.'
& $Bash scripts/initialize_super_admin.sh
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Platform administrator initialization failed.' }
& $Python scripts/create_admin_invite.py

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$TaskRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Set-Location -LiteralPath $TaskRoot
$Python = Join-Path $TaskRoot '.venv/Scripts/python.exe'
$Git = (Get-Command git -ErrorAction Stop).Source
$Bash = Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $Git -Parent) -Parent) 'bin/bash.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Bash)) { throw 'Git for Windows Bash was not found beside git.exe.' }
$DockerCandidates = @("$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/DockerDesktop/resources/bin/docker.exe", 'C:/Program Files/Docker/Docker/resources/bin/docker.exe')
$Docker = $DockerCandidates | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $Docker) { throw 'Docker executable not found.' }
$env:PATH = "$(Split-Path -Parent $Docker);$env:PATH"
& $Python scripts/check_native_ready.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native services are not ready; no account operation was attempted.' }
Write-Output 'User-started account initialization: create the platform administrator, then register/login the isolated test accounts.'
& $Bash scripts/initialize_super_admin.sh
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Platform administrator initialization failed.' }
& $Python scripts/provision_nexent.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native account and agent initialization failed.' }
Write-Output 'Accounts and agents are ready. Sign in at http://127.0.0.1:3000; private credentials are in .runtime/accounts.json.'

param([switch]$Live)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$previewRoot = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$previewPython = Join-Path $previewRoot '.venv\Scripts\python.exe'
$previewRuntime = Join-Path $previewRoot '.runtime\public-native-preview'
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $previewRuntime 'manifest.json'))) { throw 'Run prepare_public_native_preview.py --prepare first.' }
if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8781 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Port 8781 is occupied; the existing service was preserved.' }
$env:PYTHONPATH = Join-Path $previewRoot 'src'
$previewArgs = @('-m', 'gov_mcp.public_preview_server', '--runtime', ('"' + $previewRuntime + '"'), '--port', '8781')
if ($Live) { $previewArgs += '--live' }
$previewProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $previewPython -ArgumentList $previewArgs -WorkingDirectory $previewRoot -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $previewRuntime 'server.stdout.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $previewRuntime 'server.stderr.log')
@{ pid=$previewProcess.Id; port=8781; live=[bool]$Live; automatic_startup=$false } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $previewRuntime 'server-process.json') -Encoding utf8
Write-Output ('Public preview process started: ' + $previewProcess.Id)

GUIDED CONSULTATION / ENGINEERING ONLY

把情况说清楚，再由你确认

逐项问答 · 格式核查 · 人工检查

返回原工作台
仅限虚构资料的工程演练，不是正式政务申请。不填姓名、证件号、手机号、地址或真实材料。自填答案只在本地匹配选项；无法明确匹配时会请你澄清，不猜测。AI 不验证真实身份，也不替你提交。

另一种填写方式

一次只处理一个问题

  1. 选择预备答案，或用自己的话填写。
  2. 检查原回答与本地规范值，再明确同意 AI 核查。
  3. DeepSeek 只接收选项代码，不接收原回答、会话或身份凭据。
  4. 你检查后再点击提交，生成本地咨询记录和带出处清单。

提问由字段规范驱动，DeepSeek 只在末轮做只读格式核查，避免逐句外发对话。草稿仅在当前登录会话内，30 分钟后不可读取，再次访问时清除；退出或删除即不再可读，不写浏览器本地存储。

逐项引导

请先开始

不填额外个人信息。无法可靠归类时，保留未知或重新选择。

修改任一回答将使 AI 核查与此确认失效。没有已确认适用分支时，不套用别人的材料清单。不会调用正式政务提交接口。

已生成本地咨询记录

原始自填回答已从草稿清除，仅保存规范选项到现有咨询记录；来源变化或冲突仍由原流程暂停门控制。

GOVERNMENT ASSET INTELLIGENCE

政务认知 Agent · 全流程工作台

问答与证据 / 心跳与更新 / 复核与版本
本机工程演练
工程模拟环境：所有资料均为虚构。主控与全部子 Agent 已配置云端 DeepSeek；当前工作台仍使用确定性离线适配器，真实调度待验收。Jev 为独立分类接口；接线状态可在连接页检查。不提供真实办事建议。
新入口：一问一答填表 → DeepSeek 核查 → 人工确认

选择演练入口

群众入口体验逐层选择和带出处的清单；专业人员入口处理更新与发布。

口令保存在项目私有目录 .runtime/agent-workflow/access.json，不是模型 API 密钥。不要提交到仓库。

选择办理情况

工程输入，不能用于冒充真实电子核验。

资料原文检索

候选原文可以检索，但不会自动变成确定要求。
主控组织→检索找依据→规则核验→分环节回答

先选择自己的情况

这里只使用已经确认且当前可用的规则。依据不足时，显示能确认的部分和待核实项。

先接线，最后启用 API

检查只读取本机服务健康状态和模型目录，不生成回答、不调用 Jev、不载入模型。

来源与心跳

存活心跳 30 秒；默认每小时检查，演示模式每分钟。无变化不调用模型、不创建知识版本。

知识版本

回退只切换引用；原文和历史答案保留。旧版本不绕过当前冲突暂停。

咨询记录

复核 / 发布审计

实际工具执行记录

此处记录离线角色调用的真实程序工具。模型调用数始终为 0，不代表已经接通真实多模型推理。

ICT · GOVERNMENT KNOWLEDGE

知识更新工作台

定期发现变化，让每次更新有来源、有复核、有版本。

维护者登录

使用已获本工作台维护权限的 Nexent 账号。服务密钥不能用于确认发布。

来源与检查状态

仅检查已登记、已确认的固定页面和附件。来源配置在本机私有运行目录，修改后重启服务。

运行记录

处理队列

待复核知识候选

自动更新的是资料原文与候选标签。业务知识及本体变更需要逐项核对原文、适用范围和冲突，再由维护者确认。

知识与原文查询

历史版本

回退保留历史记录；检索引用绑定具体版本。

M2 事项协作演示

群众引导 → 保存交接 → 工作人员核验

工程演示 · 官方资料及材料规则待业务复核。页面只记录模拟材料的存在状态，不接收身份证照片、号码或真实申请人资料，不提供正式审批结论。

登录

1. 群众引导

候选范围：郑州市二七区，成年人、本地户籍、本人到期换领。

2. 模拟材料声明与交接

户口簿是否适用于当前分支仍待人工核实；勾选“存在”不代表已经验证材料真实有效。

3. 工作人员核验

本次调用记录


少量资料验证流程；按来源、地区、事项、材料类别、适用条件和知识版本逐步扩充。

diagrams.title: 01 · 项目全景与实现边界
diagrams.subtitle: 箭头表示入口或数据关系；各链路使用独立存储，并非自动串接。

nodes.label: 用户／专业人员
nodes.note: 群众咨询；专业人员复核；网页身份是本地工程身份。

nodes.label: Nexent 主控与子 Agent
nodes.note: 配置端5010、运行端5014；Skill约束工具顺序；是否真实调用须看对应执行证据。

nodes.label: 资料、配置与历史证据
nodes.note: config=契约，data=共享目录，evidence=分阶段证据；目录条目不等于私有原件已部署。

nodes.label: 8780 决策工作台
nodes.note: 默认模拟资料；问答填表、三值条件、检索核验、逐项复核和版本。

nodes.label: 8781／8782 原生公开预览
nodes.note: 独立public入口；固定地区情境、五工具、英译和Jev；原文支持不自动成为现行要求。

nodes.label: 公开资料修订库
nodes.note: registry.KnowledgeStore＋schedule/worker_once；候选归档、原件指纹、复核、评测和范围发布。

nodes.label: M1／M2／资产查询
nodes.note: 早期环境工具、模拟材料交接与多模态资料检索，保留各自工程边界。

nodes.label: 8775 维护引擎／8778回放
nodes.note: Engine＋Worker＋NativeDriver；文件索引和业务规则分别发布，与公开修订库不同。

nodes.label: 贯穿全程的返回门
nodes.note: 角色、数据标签、来源授权、原文定位、版本、当前暂停、人工确认、预算。

diagrams.title: 02 · 请求、角色与隐私边界
diagrams.subtitle: 以8780工作台为准；公开预览及其他服务使用各自Bearer和角色配置。

nodes.label: HTTP 请求
nodes.note: TrustedHost限制localhost、127.0.0.1及host.docker.internal。

nodes.label: 区分 MCP 与网页
nodes.note: MCP校验服务Bearer；网页POST要求同源Origin。

nodes.label: 拒绝请求
nodes.note: 权限失败403；参数／版本／存储校验失败409；超限413；不向页面透传密钥或原始异常。

nodes.label: 接收前限制真实字节
nodes.note: MCP正文≤1MiB，网页≤65536字节；校验Content-Length并逐块累计。

nodes.label: 校验会话及专业角色
nodes.note: 会话4小时；群众最多1024，专业人员64；专业登录需本地令牌。

nodes.label: 任务归属／幂等请求
nodes.note: 群众只读本人任务；request_id同输入才复用；复用仍重读暂停状态；每会话最多200任务。

nodes.label: 递归检查原始数据标签
nodes.note: 在投影或翻译前检查嵌套dict/list/tuple的data_class；不允许借嵌套标签绕过限制。

nodes.label: 调用获准程序工具
nodes.note: 有推理开关和角色能力边界；来源内容只作为数据；日志与响应受控。

diagrams.title: 03 · 一问一答填表与人工确认
diagrams.subtitle: 当前config中form_verifier_enabled=false；完整链路存在，默认不能越过AI核查门。

nodes.label: 创建会话专属表单
nodes.note: 模板只允许synthetic；字段及选项须与固定快照一致；表单30分钟有效。

nodes.label: 按顺序回答／编辑
nodes.note: 回答1–120字符、禁止控制字符；NFKC＋去空白＋casefold；必须唯一匹配选项；原答仅本机会话。

nodes.label: revision递增，旧确认失效
nodes.note: 每次编辑清空reviewed；下一请求须持当前revision；未知选项保留null。

nodes.label: 返回澄清／阻断
nodes.note: 次序错误、无法唯一匹配、过期、版本或字段变化均停止当前操作。

nodes.label: 完整性、同意与AI预算
nodes.note: review必须consent=true；总预算20次、每会话3次；独立开关开启后才核查。

nodes.label: 只读 DeepSeek 格式核查
nodes.note: 只发送当前选项代码与选中映射；无工具、无提交权；只允许official及synthetic。

nodes.label: 逐字段核对模型输出
nodes.note: 字段覆盖、value类型和值、display均精确一致；unknown_fields必须完全等于null字段；再核对版本。

nodes.label: 人工逐项检查并确认
nodes.note: review_id＋revision＋允许叶分支＋acknowledge=true；缓存只限本表单同版本同值，命中也须人工确认。

nodes.label: 进入现有本地咨询
nodes.note: 用expected_head固定版本；返回咨询回执；清空原回答及核查缓存；不是正式政务提交。

edges: 未启用／无同意／预算耗尽

diagrams.title: 04 · 当前完整咨询链路
diagrams.subtitle: Workflow.query执行确定性离线角色；配置DeepSeek路由不意味着此函数自动进行模型推理。

nodes.label: 接收 facts、branch_id、question
nodes.note: question≤2000字符，只作数据；补充任务须存在；可校验expected_head。

nodes.label: 锁定版本与准备草稿
nodes.note: 校验快照指纹；重建当前暂停；固定用户事实、分支、地区、日期和原文依赖。

nodes.label: 计算未找到的证据ID
nodes.note: 从全部草稿要求收集所需span；没有要求／证据则跳过检索。

nodes.label: 检索角色取登记证据
nodes.note: 仅使用固定快照，不由Agent指定任意URL；每轮存任务与角色轨迹。

nodes.label: 独立核验精确原文
nodes.note: 所需ID与请求ID取交集；span必须等于登记内容，text[start:end]必须等于quote。

nodes.label: 仍有缺口且轮次小于3
nodes.note: 仅针对真实缺口补检索；不重复完整材料；最多3轮。

nodes.label: 未取到证据的项降为unknown
nodes.note: EVIDENCE_RETRIEVAL_INCOMPLETE；用户未知字段不自动补全。

nodes.label: 单写事务内返回前重验
nodes.note: 重新读取版本、当前暂停，执行finalize，再持久化答复；异常将任务标failed。

nodes.label: 分环节清单＋待核＋排除＋暂停
nodes.note: 携带引用、版本、缺失字段、候选证据和轨迹；候选不进入确定清单。

diagrams.title: 05 · Nexent分阶段MCP查询状态机
diagrams.subtitle: 上游Nexent推理单独取证；MCP程序工具本身不进行推理。

nodes.label: govkb_open_query
nodes.note: 锁定事实及快照，创建staged任务；有证据需求→needs_retrieval，否则can_finalize。

nodes.label: govkb_retrieve_query
nodes.note: 仅needs_retrieval且已核验轮次<3可取；重复needs_verification直接回同一retrieval。

nodes.label: govkb_verify_query
nodes.note: needs_verification→核验span，累计found_ids和rounds；重复调用复用已核验轮。

nodes.label: govkb_query_state
nodes.note: 只返回已存状态，供主控决定下一工具；不授权任意变更。

nodes.label: needs_retrieval／can_finalize
nodes.note: 有缺口且不足3轮继续；其余可结束，缺证据项保留unknown。

nodes.label: govkb_finalize_query
nodes.note: 只接受can_finalize／complete；每次包括重试都重读当前暂停；首次保存持久化答复。

nodes.label: 历史追溯
nodes.note: 原始答复与current_availability并列；旧快照不能绕过当前暂停。

diagrams.title: 06 · 三值规则、范围与最终分流
diagrams.subtitle: 程序判断资格条件；模型仅提供候选与支持信号。

nodes.label: 校验JSON表达式
nodes.note: 最大深度12、节点128；all/any每组1–16；in列表1–32；运算符及字段白名单。

nodes.label: 校验事实的严格类型
nodes.note: bool不等价于1；数字须有限，日期严格YYYY-MM-DD；非法／缺失事实为unknown。

nodes.label: Kleene三值计算
nodes.note: all：任一false→false，全true→true，其余unknown；any：任一true→true，全false→false；not保留unknown。

nodes.label: 复核状态、地区与生效窗口
nodes.note: 未确认→unknown；地区不符→false；时间未核→unknown；起日含、止日不含。

nodes.label: 构建要求依赖和可溯源路径
nodes.note: 事项→分支→要求→材料／环节／条件／适用范围→规范条款→证据→原件；定位按Unicode码点[start,end)。

nodes.label: 当前依赖暂停优先
nodes.note: 只暂停受影响条目；即便固定旧版本也先检查当前gate。

nodes.label: 未暂停项按三值分流
nodes.note: true→确定清单，false→排除，unknown→待核并提供可选补充字段。

nodes.label: 合成状态与分环节输出
nodes.note: branch_not_applicable / needs_branch_selection / no_confirmed_requirements / partial / ready / paused / insufficient_evidence。

diagrams.title: 07 · 8780模拟更新、冲突暂停与候选
diagrams.subtitle: 此链路读取本仓库fixture；不是官网采集或真实政策更新。

nodes.label: heartbeat记录存活
nodes.note: 默认paused；force可单轮；claim租约120秒、总预算600秒；已有轮占用则already_running。

nodes.label: 优先恢复processing阶段
nodes.note: 每轮至多处理3个包／来源；只处理enabled且approved的到期来源。

nodes.label: 读取模拟来源并计算指纹
nodes.note: baseline / changed / unavailable / noise；同指纹标unchanged；读取失败只记来源失败。

nodes.label: 生成包并立即暂停受影响要求
nodes.note: 新generation；旧未发布包superseded；候选严格绑定现有要求、动作及原文；写block与audit_gate。

nodes.label: discovered → classified
nodes.note: 更新主控规划＋Jev合同回放分类；明确标synthetic_contract_replay_not_jev。

nodes.label: classified → extracted → validated
nodes.note: fixture提取器＋结构检查＋核验角色；冲突清单；原文精确匹配信号不代表真实Jev效果。

nodes.label: 文档及本地稀疏索引更新
nodes.note: 检索索引使用汉字双字组／拉丁词归一化余弦；不是稠密向量；来源guard须仍有效。

nodes.label: awaiting_review
nodes.note: 业务规则不自动发布；候选保留引用；人工期限带时区；失败保留阶段供后续恢复。

edges: 下一轮仅恢复未完成包

diagrams.title: 08 · 8780分项复核、发布及回退
